The Commercial Head – Iberia will initially build the Iberian strategy and organisation for Bimeda to enter Spain and Portugal, and then lead the regional commercial organisation, overseeing a team of Key Account Managers and/or Territory managers / Customer service representatives across the various animal health channels. This role is responsible for shaping the regional commercial strategy, accelerating customer and margin growth and strengthening partnerships across the veterinary industry.

The ideal candidate brings proven commercial leadership experience in the Spanish and Portuguese animal health sector, is a proven team leader, and combines this with strong strategic capabilities and a deep understanding of local market dynamics, including regulation, customer behaviour, and channel evolution.

**Reporting, Location & Scope**

* Reports to: EU Commercial Director
* Location: Based in Spain, with regular travel across Iberia and periodic travel to Bimeda’s European sites.
* Portfolio scope: Bimeda’s livestock and equine range

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**Team Leadership & Development**

* Build, lead and inspire a team of Key Account and/or Territory Managers to cover the Spanish and Portuguese markets
* Build capability in key account management and value-based selling
* Set clear objectives, coach performance, and create a high-performance culture built on accountability and customer focus.
* Take accountability for ensuring compliance with all relevant veterinary medicines regulations across both markets, working closely with Regulatory Affairs and the Responsible Person.

**Commercial Strategy**

* Build and own the local commercial strategy, defining long-term direction for growth across our species portfolios.
* Identify and prioritise high-value opportunities, including new product launches, category expansion, shifts in customer behaviour, and customer group consolidation.
* Ensure strategic alignment with European and global business priorities.
* Define and continuously review the route to market.
* Move quickly to take advantage of fast-moving market opportunities – such as competitor out-of-stock situations, special import opportunities, and short-term supply gaps – to capture volume and grow market share.
* Monitor the competitive landscape, competitor pricing, and wider market trends, using this insight to anticipate threats and identify new sources of growth.

  

**Customer & Market Leadership**

* Oversee relationships with key veterinary corporate groups, buying groups, wholesalers/distributors, and integrators.
* Support Key Account Managers in developing robust joint business plans that deliver growth, category performance, and compliance.
* Guide the team through complex price, volume, and contract negotiations, ensuring sustainable long-term partnerships.
* Oversee all customer contracts and trading agreements being put in place, ensuring terms are clearly documented, commercially sound, and consistently applied across the customer base.
* Apply robust segmentation across customers to ensure focus remains on highest potential customers and products
  

**Performance Management**

* Drive delivery of revenue, margin, and market share targets across Iberia
* Lead accurate demand and sales forecasting, pipeline management, and performance analysis across product segments.
* Ensure pricing, promotional execution, and investment decisions maximise profitability and ROI
* Enable robust gross-to-net (GTN) % evolution and customer-focused rebate management programmes, evolving our go-to-market model where required
* Ensure all customer rebates, discounts, and promotional offers are monitored, accurately accrued, and fully accounted for, so that the true net cost of trade investment is understood and controlled.
* Work with Finance to manage customer credit, debtor days, and working capital, ensuring agreed trading terms are adhered to and overdue accounts are actively managed.
  

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with Marketing, Technical teams, Regulatory, Supply Chain, and Finance to ensure seamless execution of commercial plans.
* Partner with technical and marketing teams to strengthen value propositions and enhance customer outcomes.
* Represent the Iberian markets in regional planning forums, providing market insight and commercial recommendations.

  

**Experience & Skills Required**

Industry Experience

* Strong understanding of veterinary and agricultural channels, including corporate groups, wholesalers, and integrators
* Direct experience of the Spanish and/or Portuguese animal health market, with an established network across veterinary corporate groups, buying groups, and distributors.
* Knowledge of the livestock and equine production-animal sectors, and a working understanding of the Spanish (AEMPS) and Portuguese (DGAV) veterinary medicines regulatory frameworks.

  

Commercial & Leadership Experience

* Proven track record in senior commercial or national sales roles, dealing with large veterinary and trade customers
* Experience managing and developing high-performing commercial teams.
* Demonstrated ability to shape and execute commercial strategy at country or regional level.
* Strong financial acumen with the ability to interpret sales data, margin performance, and investment impact.
* Strong contract negotiation skills, with experience structuring customer agreements, rebates, and trading terms, and a working understanding of the veterinary medicines regulatory environment.
* Third-level qualification in a science, veterinary, agricultural, business, or commercial discipline; a relevant postgraduate or commercial qualification is an advantage.
* Fluency in Spanish is essential; working proficiency in Portuguese is a strong advantage. Professional fluency in English is required for reporting and collaboration within Bimeda’s European and global organisation.

  

**About Bimeda**

Bimeda is a leading global innovator, manufacturer and marketer of veterinary pharmaceuticals and animal health products and has over half a century’s experience in providing science-driven solutions to optimize the health, wellbeing and productivity of the world’s animals.

Bimeda’s global innovation program sees six state-of-the art R&D centers across four continents collaborate on an enviable product development pipeline which anticipates the ever-evolving needs of the animal health industry.

Bimeda’s nine manufacturing facilities across seven countries allow the company to manufacture a broad range of preventative, curative and nutritional products including sterile injectables, vaccinations, nutritional boluses, feed additives, tablets, water-soluble powders, pastes and non-sterile liquids.

Globally, the company focuses on the development, manufacture and commercialization of quality Bimeda-branded products while also being the partner of choice for contract manufacturing and R&D services for prominent companies within the animal health industry.

title: Global Head of Operations Excellence
description:
Galderma is the emerging pure-play dermatology category leader, present in approximately 90 countries. We deliver an innovative, science-based portfolio of premium flagship brands and services that span the full spectrum of the fast-growing dermatology market through Injectable Aesthetics, Dermatological Skincare and Therapeutic Dermatology. Since our foundation in 1981, we have dedicated our focus and passion to the human body's largest organ - the skin - meeting individual consumer and patient needs with superior outcomes in partnership with healthcare professionals. Because we understand that the skin, we are in shapes our lives, we are advancing dermatology for every skin story.

We look for people who focus on getting results, embrace learning and bring a positive energy. They must combine initiative with a sense of teamwork and collaboration. Above all, they must be passionate about doing something meaningful for consumers, patients, and the healthcare professionals we serve every day. We aim to empower each employee and promote their personal growth while ensuring business needs are met now and into the future. Across our company, we embrace diversity and respect the dignity, privacy, and personal rights of every employee.

At Galderma, we actively give our teams reasons to believe in our bold ambition to become the leading dermatology company in the world. With us, you have the ultimate opportunity to gain new and challenging work experiences and create an unparalleled, direct impact.

Further supporting our growth and innovation momentum, we are establishing a new Global Capability Center in Barcelona to deploy new capabilities to effectively support its global commercial and functional teams. Located in the upscale Eixample District in the heart of Barcelona, Galderma’s Global Capability Center offers numerous possibilities for professional development such as exposure to global and cross-functional projects and access to global career opportunities.

**Location: Barcelona or London**

  

**Summary**  
  
Galderma is seeking to reinforce its world-class industrial capacities through the implementation of a global end-to-end lean supply and manufacturing program. Within this framework, we are seeing an experienced Global Head of Operations Excellence to develop, set the pace and accelerate our Operations transformational and continuous improvement strategy with sensitivity towards the organizational structure, culture, people and processes.

Working with Operations functions, and their embedded excellence resources, including Supply Chain, Quality, External Supply, Industrial Development and Plant leadership, you will coordinate and prioritize the required support for the entire Industrial Operations organization and will ensure standardization, where appropriate, in liaison with the other leaders. Knowledge sharing and communication of best practices will also be a key component of this position across Galderma.

**About The Role**

As Global Head of Operations Excellence, reporting to the Global Head of Operations, you will drive knowledge sharing across the organization by establishing key practitioner groups focused on continuous end to end improvements and convergence on identified best practices. By creating collaboration across departments and functions throughout the Operations organization you will ensure alignment of strategy and tactics for successful excellence implementation.

You will be responsible for the design, development and implementation of our global lean supply and manufacturing program with the intent to establish linkage and flow, meet customer demand at lowest cost with perfect quality, consolidate rationalization and enhance organizational agility.

You will be the primary architect and leader of our Operations Excellence Transformation and as such will work to establish programs, practices metrics and standards utilizing lean methodologies, analyze and recommend future state value stream design and also identify opportunities to improve existing practices, procedures and processes toward true north vision. You will lead and mentor leaders and multi-functional teams to implement a standardized excellence methodology to ensure consistent and rigorous application across the business in line with best practice.

Based in Barcelona or London, the position holder will be a member of our Operations Leadership Team, and partner closely with various department to collaborate on all aspects of the company's Manufacturing, Quality, Sourcing/Procurement and Supply Chain strategies.

**Core Responsibilities**

* Design, develop and implement Galderma’s end-to-end Operations Excellence transformation strategy and deploy a program for lean development across our global supply, industrial and manufacturing footprint including coordination of our drive to 85% Overall Equipment Efficiency (OEE)
* Continuously structure, coordinate and update the Operations function annual strategy plan through a clear methodology based on the Hoshin process including dashboard accountability for all Operations functions.
* Conduct Extended Value Stream Baseline analysis, Supplier summit and Kaizen events with site and function leaders to improve performance in the identified areas requiring lean/kaizen support. Provide high level, lean master/sensei support to help build capability and ensure required event objectives are achieved. In addition to that, responsible for progressing lean continuous Improvement (CI) and lean culture penetration.
* Pilot Operations’ evaluation of performance, rationalization and agility through cross functional dashboard ownership and reporting.
* Utilize, drive and promote understanding of Lean and Six-Sigma tools and principals to ensure the delivery of business objectives and a culture of continuous improvement; develop and implement improvement plans, facilitate daily visual management, lean conversion and root cause and corrective action (RCCA)
* Provide expertise, professional advice and guidance to the business in business improvement, drawing from proven industry practice and methodologies
* Work collaboratively, negotiate and engage with key stakeholders to facilitate delivery and compliance with the Lean strategy
* Communicate with stakeholders the impact of market change and potential effects on Lean methodologies. Recommend solutions without compromising quality or service while optimizing cost
* Effectively coach teams to manage for daily performance using visual controls
* Mentor using Gemba walks and other lead standard work toolkits.
* Coach employees to see abnormal conditions and problem solve systematically
* Lead kaizen events to bring Operations to standard, or improve work performance toward true north
* Ensure 5S/RCCA is taught, implemented and adhered throughout the organization.
Coordinate, schedule and facilitate as applicable Lean/Six Sigma activities to enhance cross-functional problems solving; utilize Company tool champions as appropriate for more significant lean events  

**About You**

* Solid experience in highly performing manufacturing structures operating at 85%+ OEE.
* Involvement building and leading successful projects and programs with an understanding of the tactics needed for execution, including overall upskilling and upscaling of manufacturing performance.
* Ambitious, entrepreneurial approach to finding new growth levers for the business
* Outstanding executive presence and presentation skills, with the ability to inspire and engage executives
* Highly organized and comfortable managing multiple work streams at once
* Exceptional critical thinking and ability to professionally advance others’ understanding of lean metrics and goals
* Result and customer focused with a successful record of accomplishments through skilled use of influence, persuasion, negotiation and resolution
* Clear and concise verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to effectively communicate projects status needs across different levels of the organization and different operating environments
* Determined focused leader; ability to quickly establish credibility throughout the organization by effectively balancing strategic as well as on-going operations & execution levels
* Highly collaborative with ability to lead through influence in a matrixed environment
* Relationship builder and can hold people accountable while making them feel energized about the road ahead
* Anticipate the needs of teammates, give and get all the facts making it easy for all to make decisions
Mastery is expected but not limited to JIT, takt, flow, pull, standard work sheet, Jidoka, DMAIC, A3, policy deployment, Toyota production system, TPM, continuous flow, continuous improvement, error proofing, eliminating waste, 5 why’s, heijunka, Kanban, kaizen, linearity, pacemaker, pitch, replenishment system, SWIP, supermarket, standardized work, standard work combo sheet, value stream mapping, visual management.  

**Requirements**

  

* Background in manufacturing, Supply Chain and/or engineering environments within a large global organization, including site manufacturing leadership experience
* Master Black Belt in Six Sigma or equivalent qualification
* Automotive or cost oriented company experience preferred
* Background in people management, project management and digital transformation
* Qualified Trainer certification and experience would be appreciated
* Membership of an industry-related professional body would be advantageous

#### **Accounts Payable Specialist**

##### **About the role**

We’re looking for a **detail-oriented and hands-on Accounts Payable Specialist** to join our Finance team.

Reporting to the Head of Finance, you’ll play a key role in keeping our accounts payable operations accurate, organized, and running smoothly. You’ll be responsible for validating supplier invoices, reconciling accounts, resolving discrepancies, and executing payment batches while working closely with both internal teams and external suppliers.

This is a great opportunity for someone who is **organized, analytical, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment** where accuracy matters.

##### **What you’ll do**

* **Manage and validate supplier invoices**: Receive, review, and validate invoices, ensuring they comply with company policies and tax regulations. Match invoices with purchase orders and delivery receipts, record them in the accounting system, and obtain the necessary approvals before payment.
* **Resolve discrepancies**: Investigate issues such as incorrect pricing, quantity mismatches, missing documentation, or pending approvals. Work directly with suppliers and internal teams to resolve them efficiently.
* **Own AP reconciliations**: Reconcile supplier statements, review outstanding accounts payable balances, and ensure invoices are correctly recorded and paid on time. Keep accurate and up-to-date records of invoices, payments, and reconciliations.
* **Support accounting closing processes**: Collaborate with the Accounting team during month-end and year-end closing, helping ensure AP transactions and supplier accounts are accurately recorded and reconciled, and preparing reports when needed.

At Rover, pets and their people are at the heart of everything we do. We connect pet parents with trusted pet care across the U.S., Canada, Europe, and Australia.

Headquartered in Seattle and Barcelona, we’re a values driven, fast-growing tech company focused on building safe and personalized experiences tailored to the needs of each unique pet. We’re investing in AI as a business accelerator and provide every team member access to AI tools in service of creating better experiences for our community.

We are proud to be recognized as a great place to work, having been named among the 100 Best Companies to Work For in Seattle Business Magazine and Washington’s Best Workplaces in the Puget Sound Business Journal. At Rover we’re committed to creating an accessible, inclusive, and welcoming community, which starts with our employees.

Want to make an impact? Join our pack and come work (and play!) with us.

**About the role**  
Rover is looking for a Director of Product Management to lead the Provider Product Group inside our Global Provider Organization. In this role, you will own the product strategy and execution of Rover's multi-year provider roadmap: concentrating investment on our most successful providers while engaging our broader community of caregivers to strengthen marketplace depth and develop a high quality pipeline.  
You will lead four product teams working in service to our care providers, improving their experience and how they interact with the marketplace at every stage of their journey. This is a high-impact role that requires a unique blend of strategic vision and detailed-oriented, hands-on execution. You will set multi-year product direction and drive rigorous, experiment-led execution. The role carries direct accountability for supply-side revenue, provider retention, and new-customer booking growth.  
This role reports directly to the Senior Director of Supply based in Barcelona, and partners closely with Data Science, Engineering, Design, Trust & Safety, Marketing, Operations, Finance, Legal, and the International Business Team.  
As a people leader, you will manage a team of product managers based primarily in Barcelona and coordinate with cross-functional teams across Europe and the US.

* *This is a hybrid position that has the minimum expectation to work out of our Barcelona Office in the Poblenou neighborhood two days per week on Mondays and Thursdays. For this reason, candidates must be based in Barcelona or willing to relocate.*

### **What you'll own**

Execution is delivered hand-in-hand with cross-functional partners; your job is to define the vision and what good looks like, sequence the bets, hold the alignment, and make sure all investments reinforce each other through excellent execution.

* **Product Strategy and Vision.** Own the multi-year provider product vision: translating Rover's provider strategy into a sequenced product direction and owning the narrative that aligns leadership, product teams, and partners behind it.
* **Roadmap and execution.** Own the product side of the organization's OKRs and the roadmap that delivers them. Ship a steady cadence of well-crafted, experiment-validated launches, landed with quality and followed through after launch until the customer outcome is proven or the outcome is learned.
* **The voice of the provider.** You will be the advocate for what providers actually want and need to grow and run top quality businesses, grounding every roadmap decision in customer research, feedback, and marketplace data, and representing that voice credibly in every executive conversation, including when it's inconvenient.
* **AI adoption.** AI embedded in product features such as assisted tooling, intelligent messaging, personalization and education, as well as fostering AI in how the team works (AI-accelerated discovery, prototyping, execution), while building a culture of AI-native development as the default.
* **Cross-functional leadership.** Hold alignment across Core Product Teams, Design, Engineering, Data Science, Marketing, Operations, Finance, Legal and Trust & Safety, and across regions, so that product investments reinforce each other globally rather than fragmenting by service, brand or country.
* **A team that sets the bar.** Hire, coach and grow a team of product managers who combine judgment, customer centricity, inspiring craft and speed.

### **Minimum qualifications**

* 10+ years of product management experience, with meaningful time in marketplace, platform, or two-sided business contexts. Experience in the supply-side of the marketplace is a plus.
* 5+ years in people management or leadership roles, including managing senior product managers or leading cross-functional groups.
* Experience driving marketplace monetization — pricing, fee, or take-rate models — including designing, testing, and scaling pricing changes with measurable P&L impact.
* Track record of building retention, engagement, and loyalty strategies for a professional user segment (providers, sellers, hosts, drivers, or merchants).  
  Experience partnering with Data Science and Engineering teams to create and execute on shared roadmaps and metrics, with rigorous experimentation practice (A/B frameworks, holdouts, long-horizon measurement).
* Clear and structured written and verbal communication style, with the ability to influence and partner with senior leaders and diverse teams to drive critical decisions.
* Highly proactive, comfortable operating with minimal guidance in uncertain and ambiguous business environments.
* Analytical rigour, with enthusiasm for modeling and measuring the impact of the initiatives you drive. Comfortable working with advanced analytical and visualization tools, such as Mode and Excel.

title: Account Director, Client Solutions (EMEA)
description:
Account Director, Client Solutions (EMEA)
=========================================

**Location:** Remote. Continental Europe or compatible time zone preferred. (roughly UTC-1 to UTC+3)

**Clients:** Global. Primarily EMEA and North American.

**Reports to:** VP of Solutions

**Salary Range:** $80,000 - $150,000 USD annually, plus bonus/commission based on acquisition and growth of client accounts. Compensation dependent on candidate experience and location.

About McGaw

**Our Mission at McGaw.io is to help companies of all sizes realize their customer data is their most valuable business asset, and we help them realize that through customer data infrastructure, high power analytics, marketing automation, personalization, and funnel optimization.**

McGaw.io supports businesses with analytics, marketing automation, customer data platforms, data piping, websites, AB testing, and all sorts of marketing operations. As we derive insights from these technical efforts, we also inform & execute growth strategies that routinely move the needle for our clients.

Our track record is impeccable, and our leadership has supported some of the fastest-growing companies in the world. McGaw.io’s core client base sells online and has complex data and marketing practices that drive our team to dig deeper every day.

Mission
-------

Own a portfolio of client relationships. Set the strategy, keep accounts healthy and profitable, grow them, win new ones, and get the technical work delivered through the team rather than by doing it yourself.

Why this role exists
--------------------

Accounts need a senior owner accountable for whether they renew and whether they grow. Outside North America that accountability sits in the wrong time zone, so the client's executive sponsor talks to us at the end of their day and the relationship runs a meeting behind.

This is the commercial and strategic owner. It is not the technical builder.

Three problems this role solves:

* Nobody outside North America is accountable for account health, retention, and expansion.
* Executive conversations happen at inconvenient hours, so they happen less often.
* Expansion is reactive. Nobody plans the next six months before the current scope runs out, and nobody runs discovery in European hours.

Responsibilities
----------------

**Relationship ownership**

* Own the relationship at executive level. You are who the client's CMO or VP of Growth calls.
* Run the cadence: biweekly client meetings, monthly roadmap and SOW reviews, quarterly business reviews covering results, maturity, next quarter, and risks.
* Keep the client informed before they have to ask. Never surprise them on budget or timeline.

**Strategy and consulting**

* Find where revenue leaks across acquisition, conversion, and retention. Map every problem to pain, metric, impact, and fix.
* Build and defend the growth roadmap with the client, not at them.
* Do the strategic hands-on work yourself: measurement frameworks, KPI definition, funnel and cohort analysis, lifecycle program design, experiment roadmaps, readouts.
* Translate technical decisions into business consequences the client can act on.

**Delegation and project leadership**

* Scope the work, then hand it to architects and engineers with enough detail that it gets built right.
* Manage the project, not the build. Sprint cadence, board hygiene, dependencies, risks, critical path.
* Review delivered work against the client's objectives before it ships. You are not the QA engineer, but you are accountable for whether the client got what they were told they would get.
* Know enough to challenge an estimate and spot a bad technical answer. You do not write the code.

**New business**

* Run pre-sales discovery. Qualify hard, and say no when a prospect is not ready.
* Build and present proposals: scope, phasing, investment, and the business case. Presented live, never sent cold.
* Price work so it delivers profitably. A generous estimate at proposal is a delivery problem in month three.
* Work with Sales through qualification, discovery, and close, then take the account into delivery.

**Commercial**

* Own retention and expansion on your portfolio. You are measured on both.
* Every scope change gets estimated, documented, and confirmed in writing before work starts.
* Run the six-month roadmap cycle so the next engagement is signed before the current one ends.

Skills and experience
---------------------

**Required**

* Fully fluent in English. That is the company's working language.
* Multilingual with professional working proficiency in English as well as German, French, Spanish, or Italian.
* 10+ years in consulting, agency, or professional services. At least 5 owning senior client relationships with a revenue number attached.
* Understand the full marketing lifecycle: demand generation, nurturing, acquisition, retention, and growth, and where revenue leaks between the stages.
* Understand how martech drives marketing, from ads to CDPs to marketing engagement platforms, CRM, and analytics.
* Advise on the systems below: which to use, how they fit together, the tradeoffs, and how to get more from what a client already owns. You do not configure them. You do need to be right about them, and to spot a bad technical answer when you are given one.
* Advanced understanding of marketing and growth analytics, attribution, and how to leverage data to improve marketing returns.
* Track record retaining and expanding accounts, with figures a former manager would confirm.
* Pre-sales experience: discovery, scoping, writing proposals, and presenting them to executive buyers.
* Scope and price technical work profitably.
* Know how European businesses buy, contract, and operate across markets, including procurement, data protection, and consent.

**Systems.** Advisory command of these. Depth in at least three groups.

* Customer data platforms: Segment, Hightouch, RudderStack
* Analytics: Amplitude, Mixpanel, GA4
* Lifecycle and marketing automation: Braze, Customer.io, HubSpot, Marketo, Iterable
* Warehouse and transformation: Snowflake, BigQuery, dbt
* Tag management: Google Tag Manager, server-side GTM
* CRM: Salesforce, HubSpot
* Consent management: OneTrust, Cookiebot, Didomi

**Preferred**

* Accounts across multiple countries or regulatory regimes.
* Work across both European and North American clients.
* Built or seeded a regional practice before.

What you get out of this
------------------------

* You own the full commercial arc of an account, from discovery through renewal and expansion. At a larger firm that is three people's jobs.
* The customer data layer is changing right now. Warehouse-native patterns, composable CDPs, and reverse ETL are replacing a decade of assumptions. You advise on the new pattern while most of the market still sells the old one.
* We work across the full client stack, not just individual systems or specific vendors. That includes telling a client when they already have what they need.
* Many industries and stacks in a year instead of one in five, on both sides of the Atlantic.

Observable indicators
---------------------

**Month 2**

* Onboarded onto your accounts, each with a current-state assessment and named client objectives.
* Time tracked in Harvest weekly, without reminders.
* Every account's decision-maker has met you and knows what you own.

**Month 4**

* Running your accounts independently: meetings, roadmap reviews, budget conversations, scope changes.
* Every account has three or more months of planned roadmap.
* Zero undocumented scope changes.
* Technical work delegated with specs good enough that it does not come back for rework.
* Running discovery calls and contributing to proposals.

**Month 6**

* 90% of client objectives hit within the project timeline.
* Labor efficiency ratio of 3.0 across your portfolio.
* Client approval for a case study or testimonial on at least one account.
* Writing and presenting proposals independently.

**Month 9**

* 80% retention of your accounts in recurring contracts over a rolling three months.
* 20% of your retainers expanded over a rolling 90 days.
* Your proposals deliver at or above target labor efficiency. Your estimates hold up.
* Representing McGaw independently in sales and partner meetings.

What this role is not
---------------------

* Not a hands-on build seat although you will get into the tools if you need to.
* Not a prospecting seat. You run discovery, write and present proposals, own retention and expansion, and earn commission on it. You do not cold prospect.
* Not a people management seat at hire. You direct a project team. Managing a team comes later, if the business grows and you have shown you can.

Values
------

* Never Settle, Be Amazing. Fix it properly, not just enough to close the ticket.
* Get Better Every Day. Ask for feedback and change what you do when you get it.
* Give Context and Set the Stage. Nobody on your account is surprised by what you already knew.
* Let the Data Create Transparency. Recommendations come with evidence. So does bad news.
* Show Hospitality to Build Trust. Clients and teammates get proactive, responsive treatment.

Plus extreme ownership. Own the outcome, surface blockers early, and never hand a problem back to the person who gave it to you.

Benefits
--------

* Flexible PTO
* Flexible hours
* Work remotely
* Monthly per diem for premium health, dental, and vision coverage if not already available
* Maternity and paternity leave
* Retirement contribution of 3% of salary annually.
* Company laptop, monitor, and remote setup equipment
* National holidays off.
* Radically transparent workplace
* Room to act on your own ideas

The job in practice
-------------------

McGaw is a customer data and revenue operations consultancy. Clients come to us with traffic, tools, and data, and no system connecting them. We find where revenue leaks across acquisition, conversion, and retention, then we fix it with our hands on the keyboards.

The CDP is the center of most of our work. We build on Segment, Hightouch, and RudderStack, chosen per client. We work across the full client stack, not just individual systems or specific vendors.

Our clients are in North America and Europe. Your portfolio will be a mix.

**Month 1.** Learn our clients, delivery model, and commercial standards. Meet every stakeholder on your accounts. Shadow client meetings, QBRs, and pre-sales calls.

**Months 2 and 3.** Take ownership of your accounts. Run the meetings, rebuild the roadmaps, take over the budget conversations. An experienced account owner stays close.

**Months 4 to 6.** Run your portfolio independently. Hit your labor efficiency target. Start running discovery and writing proposals.

**After 6 months.** You own the commercial arc on your accounts, from first discovery call through renewal. You help define what the next hires look like.

**What is hard.** You are accountable for delivery you did not perform, done mostly by people in another time zone. Managing that gap is most of the job. Pre-sales competes with delivery, and both are urgent. Work is billable by the hour, so time tracking is not optional. Expansion targets are real and measured.

title: Lead Product Manager - RPG
description:
**Homa is a global mobile game developer and publisher creating games people love.** We partner with studios and internally develop games, having launched over 80 titles, reached over 2 billion downloads, and seen our game All in Hole break into the global top-50 grossing charts. These are milestones, not the finish line.  
  
With deep expertise in product and technology, we built Homa Lab, our proprietary platform that gives developers the market intelligence, data tools, and game tech, with AI built-in, to find product–market fit fast and scale mass-market games into lasting experiences players enjoy for years.  
  
This is our flywheel: Homa Lab helps studios spot the right ideas early, turn them into games quickly, and reach millions of players. Every launch brings back data and insights that fuel the next hit, making each turn of the loop faster, smarter, and more likely to win. AI supercharges this process, running through everything we do, from everyday tasks to our guiding principles.  
  
What powers the loop is talent density. 220+ people from 30+ nationalities, bringing expertise from the world’s best studios and companies. We uphold ambition, curiosity, humility, and focus, and deliver with speed, excellence, and candor. Since the start, we’ve raised $165M from Headline, Northzone, Eurazeo, Bpifrance, and the founders of King, Sorare, and Spotify, people who’ve built and backed the games and platforms we admire, now supporting our drive to create the next ones.  
  
At Homa, we are building the next billion-player experiences from the ground up and shaping the future of entertainment.

**Mission**

As a **Lead Product Manager** on our RPG games, you'll play a key role in defining and owning the product roadmap for our live RPG games portfolio end-to-end, starting by turning one of our current strongest live titles into a franchise players stay with for years. You'll start with one game, and as our RPG portfolio expands, so does your scope, more titles, and a real hand in the product strategy behind them. You're shaping how Homa runs RPG as a whole.

Your main responsibilities will include:

* **Define the product roadmap across one or more live RPG titles:** core loop, progression pacing, monetization, and meta systems such as gacha, PvP, seasons, and guild or pass structures, with the health of the in-game economy.
* **Own LiveOps end-to-end.** You'll define the calendar, the events, and the loop that brings players back by a real understanding of what the team can design, produce, and sustain sprint over sprint: ambitious, but grounded.
* **Lead your team.** You'll have a talented but small team of product, design, and economy experts to lead towards the same goal. Your job is to give them a clear plan, raise their level, and get the best out of them.
* **Oversee the monetization model.** Working closely with economy, you're accountable for leading how the game balances the IAP and ad revenue growth together rather than at each other's expense.
* **Drive growth, in partnership with UA.** You're responsible for how the game scales on the acquisition side: working hand-in-hand with the UA team so that the player data, creative learnings, and campaign performance shapes the product roadmap.
* **Cross-functional excellence.** You'll work hand-in-hand with Publishing and the studios, through logic and shared KPIs, which means understanding how a game gets built and shipped end-to-end, from concept to launch.
* **Set the bar.** Bring genre benchmarks and proven best practices into every major call, so the team always has a clear, shared sense of what great looks like in this genre.
* **Stay hands-on when it counts.** This is a leadership role, but you'll stay close enough to the data and the systems to go deep personally on whatever matters most that month, rather than directing only from a distance.

This is a great opportunity to take a genuinely exceptional game and decide what it becomes: full ownership of the product, the economy, and the LiveOps of a title Homa is betting on, real autonomy over how you get there, and a clear path to leading product across our whole RPG portfolio as it grows.

 **Requirements**

We are looking for someone with **several years of product experience on live mobile games, especially RPG,** with genuine end-to-end ownership of an economy, progression system or monetization roadmap, and the humility, curiosity, ambition, and drive to make an impact fast. You're a great fit if you have:

**Product & RPG expertise**

* P**roduct experience on live F2P mobile games**, ideally RPG/midcore, with end-to-end ownership of major features, progression, monetization or product roadmaps.
* Strong fluency in **RPG mechanics and meta systems:** progression, power curves, collection, PvP/social, seasons and passes, and strong mobile marketability instincts.
* Ideally, you’ve taken a title **from concept/pre-launch through launch and LiveOps**, or shaped product direction across multiple titles.

**LiveOps & Execution**

* Deep **LiveOps experience**, understanding how events, content, progression and monetization work together to drive engagement and repeat spend.
* Strong track record **owning features end-to-end**: identify, build, ship, measure and iterate, with a practical understanding of **what a live team can realistically ship and maintain**, balancing ambition with feasibility.

**Leadership & Ways of working**

* Strong **cross-functional leadership**, able to align Design, Publishing, Data, Economy, UA, Growth and external studios around the product direction.
* A **strategist and builder**: able to set direction and lead others, while remaining highly hands-on with the game, systems and data.
* Thrives in **lean, fast-moving, high-autonomy teams** with quick tests, short feedback loops and high ownership

**Our Culture**

At Homa, we prioritize talent, energy, and determination over traditional credentials. We’re building a global community of brilliant, driven people who think boldly, move fast, and push boundaries. We believe true innovation comes from diverse perspectives, deep collaboration, and curiosity without limits. Our culture is grounded in four core values:

* **Ambition**: We strive for the best - we don’t settle for “good enough.”
* **Humility**: We recognize that we are always learning, we can always improve and grow.
* **Curiosity**: We continuously seek the “why” behind the “what”.
* **Focus**: Our curiosity takes us deeper, not wider - we dive deep into the details.

  
**Benefits**

Building great games starts with building a great place to work. Here’s what you can expect:

* **Comprehensive Benefits:** Depending on your location, you’ll enjoy a range of perks such as insurance, meal vouchers, public transport, gym memberships, and more.
* **Paris HQ Access:** Enjoy a desk at our private office in a well-located WeWork building that will give you access to WeWork perks like rooftop view and designed coworking spaces.
* **Coworking Access:** You will have access to WeWork spaces throughout Europe, along with all their perks and professional office environments.
* **Global Team:** Collaborate in English with top-tier talent from 35+ countries, spanning Europe, the UK, the US, and more. Diversity fuels our creativity and innovation.
* ✈️ **Team Gatherings:** We value time together beyond the screen. Join us for occasional team gatherings, off-site retreats (Workations as we name them) to connect, recharge, and celebrate.
* **Performance Reviews:** We’re committed to your growth. Every six months, we reflect on your progress, recognize your achievements, and align on clear development goals.
* **Equipment Support:** From day one, we’ll provide everything you need to do your best work, including a home office setup allowance if you're working remotely.

Where We Hire

Our HQ in Paris is a vibrant hub of creativity, collaboration, and connection. From rooftop lunches and coffee chats to after-work apéros and community events, we’ve designed a space people genuinely enjoy - all within a cozy WeWork filled with good energy (and snacks).

We also have incredible team members across Europe - from Spain and Turkey to Germany, North Macedonia, Poland, the UK, and more. Whether you’re working from a sunny WeWork in Barcelona or your home setup in Warsaw, you’re fully part of our culture. To keep collaboration smooth, we primarily hire within European time zones (UTC to UTC+3). If you're based there - or planning to be - we’d love to hear from you!

*Please note: this is one remote position open to multiple countries, not multiple openings.*

title: Product Owner, Xsolla Partner Network
description:
**About You**
-------------

We are looking for a **Product Owner** to join the team behind Xsolla Partner Network (XPN). The role is based in the US, and we're open to strong candidates globally. Partner Network connects game publishers with content creators to drive discovery, engagement, and revenue.  
  
XPN is a two-sided marketplace. We help publishers run creator marketing campaigns (xsolla.com/partner-network), and we give creators a way to join those campaigns, along with tools to manage and grow their channels (xsolla.com/for/creators). Each side has its own users and goals, and each shapes the other. Helping both sides succeed together is what makes this role so interesting.  
  
You'll work closely with customers on both sides and with a collaborative team that's building something new in the creator economy. You'll bring what you learn back to the Product Director and the team, help shape where the product goes, and then work alongside design and engineering to bring it to life.  
  
This is a hands-on role that mixes customer conversations, product definition, and day-to-day delivery. If you enjoy turning what you learn from customers into shipped features, and you like doing it with a team that moves fast and supports each other, we'd love to meet you.

### **About Us**

Xsolla is a global commerce company with robust tools and services to help developers solve the inherent challenges of the video game industry. From indie to AAA, companies partner with Xsolla to help them fund, distribute, market, and monetize their games. Grounded in the belief in the future of video games, Xsolla is resolute in the mission to bring opportunities together, and continually make new resources available to creators. Headquartered and incorporated in Los Angeles, California, Xsolla operates as the merchant of record and has helped over 1,500+ game developers to reach more players and grow their businesses around the world. With more paths to profits and ways to win, developers have all the things needed to enjoy the game.

For more information, visit xsolla.com.

### **Responsibilities:**

* **Research and discovery.** Get to know both sides of the XPN marketplace: the game publishers running creator campaigns and the creators bringing those campaigns to life. Talk with customers, gather insights, and keep up with trends in the creator economy and gaming. What you learn shapes where the product goes next.
* **Coordinate the roadmap.** Work with the Product Director to turn insights into priorities. Bring ideas and recommendations, balance publisher and creator needs, and help build a roadmap the whole team is excited about.
* **Write product requirements.** Turn ideas into clear, well-scoped PRDs that give design and engineering what they need to build with confidence.
* **Manage delivery.** Organize the work in Jira and keep design, engineering, and QA aligned and moving from kickoff through release.
* **Track what matters.** Define and follow the metrics that show how XPN is working for publishers and creators, and use them to guide what we build next.
* **Keep everyone connected.** Be the hub for product communication. Share project status, research, and customer insights with the product team. Keep Business Development, Customer Success, and Marketing up to date on what's shipping and what it means for our partners.

### **Requirements:**

* **Product experience.** 3+ years in product management or product ownership, shipping software alongside a dedicated engineering team.
* **Customer insight.** You enjoy talking with customers and turning those conversations into insights that shape product decisions. You're comfortable serving more than one type of user and finding solutions that work for everyone involved.
* **Clear writing.** You write product requirements that are easy to follow and help the team get aligned quickly.
* **Engineering partnership.** You work closely with engineers day to day, making scope and sequencing decisions together, and you're comfortable managing the backlog and tracking work in Jira.
* **Cross-team communication.** You enjoy keeping people across the company informed and being a go-to resource for product questions.
* **Adaptability.** You're energized by a fast-moving, globally distributed team and comfortable making progress while the picture is still coming together.
* **Video game marketing.** You understand how games find and grow their audiences, including user acquisition, community building, and influencer campaigns. We prefer candidates with experience in the creator economy or influencer marketing.
* **Creator platform familiarity.** You know how creators work on YouTube, Twitch, TikTok, or Kick, including their analytics, audience growth, and monetization tools.

### **Nice-to-Have:**

* **Marketplace or platform experience.** You've worked on two-sided marketplaces or platform products.
* **Partner commercial models.** Experience with revenue-share or performance-based partner programs.
* **Campaign attribution.** Experience with tracking links, conversion attribution, or measuring marketing performance.
* **Data comfort.** You can pull and explore your own data with analytics tools.

Salary range based on US location only. This position is open for global remote. Salary will be determined based on location and experience.

**Benefits:**  
We are passionate about fostering a supportive environment for our team, so we prioritize the physical, mental, and emotional well-being of our employees and their families through a comprehensive Benefits Program. This includes 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision plans, unlimited Flexible Time Off, and a personalized career roadmap for each employee. By investing in professional development through training and educational opportunities, we ensure that our team thrives both personally and professionally. Together, we’re not just building a business; we’re cultivating a community that values creativity, collaboration, and the transformative power of play.

title: Senior Director, Operational Strategy - Oncology
description:
**Company Description**

Medicine moves forward here. So will you.

Ergomed is a specialist clinical research organization focused on rare disease and select oncology indications. We focus on the most complex trials, the studies where experience, judgement, and rigorous operational accountability make the biggest difference. We partner with small to midsize biotech companies to move promising therapies through early phase development, so they reach the patients sooner.

We choose complex work on purpose. Rare disease and oncology trials carry real operational risk, and our people are experts at reducing it, protecting timelines, data quality and the experience of sites and patients at the same time. It is demanding, meaningful work, and no one here forgets that patients cannot wait.

That is why culture matters to us as much as capability. We have built a collaborative, international team where people share ideas, grow their careers and are trusted to take ownership early. With colleagues across North America, South America, Europe, Asia and Australia, we value teamwork, flexibility and a real commitment to work-life balance, because good science comes from people who feel supported.

If you want work with purpose, the agility to make an impact and a team that cares about the people behind the work as much as the work itself, we would love to hear from you.

* Responsible to coordinate and develop competitive and flexible strategies for potential awards in oncology and oncology-related indications, leveraging expertise, operational capabilities, and technologies to ensure client needs are addressed in the pre-award activities.

**Additional Information**

When you join Ergomed Group, you make a difference by helping to bring safe and effective pharmaceutical treatment to patients around the world. You’ll join a passionate and collaborative team of experts in clinical research, pharmacovigilance, and quality consulting.

title: Test Manager – Quality Assurance | Europe | Fully Remote
description:

We are seeking a highly motivated Test Manager to lead Quality Assurance for a AAA game development team. You will lead embedded testing teams, and partner with cross-functional leadership to balance quality, schedule, and risk in a complex development environment.

  

**What we will do together:**

  

QA Strategy & Leadership

* Define global QA strategy, test objectives, quality gates, and risk-based testing methodologies for major project milestones.
* Integrate QA into early development planning to ensure quality is a core part of the feature lifecycle rather than just final validation.

  

People Management

* Mentor and develop a high-performing team of QA Leads and testers, fostering a culture of ownership and collaboration.
* Manage both internal and external QA resources effectively to meet project demands.

  

Test Planning & Execution

* Oversee comprehensive test execution across functional, gameplay, performance, stability, multiplayer, and platform certification areas.
* Monitor defect trends and quality risks, ensuring critical issues are prioritized and driven to resolution.

  

Defect & Risk Management

* Communicate emerging quality risks and technical assessments clearly to Production and project leadership.

  

Milestone & Release Management

* Establish QA schedules and deliverables for major milestones, providing objective assessments of build stability and release readiness.

Platform Certification

Cross-Functional Leadership

**What you will bring:**

title: Product Manager
description:
**CapsLock** builds exceptional marketing solutions for large partners in the home improvement industry. We don’t just advertise our clients’ products or services - we build long-term marketing solutions within the context of permanent partnerships.

Our people are the backbone of everything we do and are our most valuable asset. Our business model demands top talent across the board, and we aim to create conditions that attract and retain the best individuals globally.

**﻿Role Overview**

We are expanding our Product team, and this role owns a slice of the internal product ecosystem our teams run the business on.

Your starting focus is the Media Buyer Automation Platform — the rules engine, pacing logic, spend controls, alerting, and workflow tooling that let a small team of buyers manage budgets that would otherwise require significantly more headcount. From there, your scope extends across the internal tools that support the wider acquisition engine: marketing automation, reporting and analytics workflows, creative operations, and the new tooling we build as the business shifts. We expect the exact portfolio to evolve, and we are hiring someone who wants that rather than someone looking for a single fixed product.

This is a hands-on builder role rather than a coordination role. Your users are colleagues, the feedback loop is short, and your work shows up in CPA, ROAS, wasted spend, and hours returned to the team. You will report to the Head of Product and work daily with Engineering, Data, Media Buying, Creative, and Operations.

**Responsibilities**

**﻿**

**﻿1. Product Strategy & Roadmap**

* Own the end-to-end roadmap for the Media Buyer Automation Platform, including discovery, prioritization, specifications, delivery, adoption, and iteration.
* Take on additional internal products as the portfolio grows, sequencing work across marketing automation, reporting and analytics, creative operations, cross-platform account management, and data reconciliation while maintaining focus on the core platform.

**2. User Needs & Automation**

* Work closely with media buyers to understand their workflows and translate their operational needs into reliable automation for budget pacing, anomaly alerts, spend guardrails, bulk actions, and approval flows.
* Identify manual processes that are consuming capacity across the business and evaluate whether they should be automated through internal development, external solutions, or left unchanged.

**3. Product Development & Delivery**

* Write clear product specifications that engineers can build from, including edge cases, failure modes, rollback behavior, and a defined bar for completion.
* Prototype ideas and build lightweight automations where this can accelerate alignment or address smaller workflow needs without relying on the engineering roadmap.

**4. Adoption, Measurement & Collaboration**

* Drive product adoption through onboarding, enablement, documentation, and continuous feedback loops that ensure tools remain actively used and valuable.
* Define and track meaningful product metrics, ensuring they are properly instrumented and visible, while partnering with Data on event taxonomy, attribution challenges, and measurement trade-offs.

**5. Experimentation & Optimization**

* Run experiments and staged rollouts to validate changes, particularly for functionality that affects advertising spend, before deploying them across full budgets.
* Continuously evaluate and iterate on products based on performance data, user feedback, and evolving business needs.

  
Requirements:
  

* 4+ years in Product Management, with 2+ years owning data-heavy or workflow-heavy products end-to-end.
* Proven track record of building internal or B2B tools for colleagues and driving high adoption.
* Skilled in KPI design, event taxonomy, dashboarding, and turning numbers into decisions.
* Active use of AI tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Lovable, n8n, custom scripts) to build prototypes and automate workflows. *(Examples will be requested).*
* Practical understanding of LLM limitations, probabilistic feature evaluation, and fallback logic.
* Comfortable running multiple workstreams at once and making confident calls on what to ship first.
* Strong track record of launching small, frequent releases rather than big-bang updates.
* Excellent written/verbal English—creates clear specs, explicit trade-offs, and transparent status updates.
* Experience collaborating effectively across global time zones.

**Nice-to-Haves**

* Experience with paid acquisition platforms (Meta, Google, TikTok), rules engines, budget pacing, or creative testing workflows.
* Computer Science, Computer Engineering degree, or experience managing complex SaaS products with multi-platform API integrations.
* Hands-on experience with A/B testing frameworks, feature flagging, or staged rollout systems for spend-affecting logic.

**﻿Why do we deserve your attention?**

Not only do we offer fair and competitive pay, but we also provide perks and benefits that support your well-being and growth. Here are some of them:

**Remote Work**

We are a truly remote-first company. You choose where you feel the most productive and comfortable to make an impact.

**Paid Time Off**

Work-life balance matters to us, and we support it with paid time off for rest, personal time, or simply doing what makes you happy.

**Ongoing Learning**

We believe in curiosity and growth. That’s why we support continuous learning with workshops, online courses, conferences, and certifications.

**Home Office**

We help you set up your perfect workspace by covering equipment and furniture expenses, so you can do your best work from home.

**Physical Well-Being**

From gym memberships and yoga classes to home workout equipment or even a bicycle, we give you the flexibility to stay active your way.

**Unlimited Sick Days**

Your health matters. Take the time you need to rest and recover - we’ll be here when you’re ready to return.

**Medical Coverage**

We support you and your family with reimbursement for medical insurance and health-related expenses, including dental care and psychological support.

**Co-Working Space**

If you sometimes crave a change of scenery or more social interaction, we’ll cover the full cost of a co-working space.

**Fun Stuff**

From gaming nights and fitness challenges to annual retreats at world-class resorts, we make sure there’s never a shortage of fun and connection.

title: Data Product Engineer, Data & Analytics
description:

description:

Standard (Mon-Fri)

Office

**Job Description**

**Position:** Executive Director, Global Site Strategic Network

**Location:** EMEA, remote

**Type:** Full Time

The **Executive Director, Global Site Strategic Network** is accountable for defining and leading the global strategy for strategic site engagement and partnerships within Global Clinical Operations. The role establishes the strategic architecture, operating principles, governance, portfolio priorities, and performance framework that connect Therapeutic Business Unit (TBU) strategy and Global Clinical Operations priorities with regional and country activation and local site engagement.

The Executive Director shapes how the business identifies, prioritizes, develops, and activates relationships with investigators, health systems, strategic sites, and research networks to improve access to patients, accelerate clinical development, strengthen study delivery, and create differentiated value for customers and TBUs. The role leads the global Site Strategy & Collaborations organization, provides strategic direction through regional Site Network leadership and matrix partners, serves as an executive sponsor for priority partnerships, and advises senior leadership on network strategy, partnership investment, external ecosystem trends, and future capability needs.

**Essential Functions and Other Job Information:**

  

* Define and own the global Site Strategy & Collaborations vision, multi-year strategic roadmap, and priorities aligned with Global Clinical Operations objectives and TBU portfolio strategy.
* Translate TBU therapeutic and portfolio priorities into a differentiated global site-network strategy, defining where, with whom, and how Thermo Fisher should build strategic site relationships to support current and future clinical development needs.
* Establish the global strategic framework for site partnerships, including partnership segmentation, value propositions, engagement principles, governance, decision rights, escalation pathways, and standards for relationship development and activation.
* Lead the global operating model that connects enterprise and TBU strategy with regional Site Network Leads, Feasibility & Site Selection (FSS), Country Operations, and local site teams, enabling one connected strategy with clear ownership and accountability.
* Create a closed-loop mechanism through which regional and local site intelligence informs global and TBU strategy, while global portfolio priorities are translated into practical country and site engagement plans.
* Own global prioritization of strategic sites, health systems, investigators, and research networks using portfolio needs, patient access, performance data, market intelligence, customer strategy, and emerging capability requirements.
* Partner with TBU leaders, Clinical Operations, Medical, Commercial, Business Development, FSS, and Country Operations to embed site strategy early in portfolio planning, customer strategy, proposals, bid defenses, and strategic account discussions.
* Define and govern a global performance framework and differentiated KPIs that demonstrate the operational, strategic, customer, and business value of site partnerships, including proof points that inform investment and prioritization decisions.
* Use data, analytics, external market intelligence, and network insights to identify strategic opportunities, anticipate risks, inform network design, and recommend changes to partnership strategy and operating model.
* Champion innovative partnership models, digital capabilities, data-sharing approaches, and collaboration mechanisms that strengthen site engagement and differentiate Thermo Fisher in the clinical research ecosystem.
* Lead organizational transformation and change initiatives that position Site Strategy & Collaborations as a strategic enterprise capability rather than a transactional or support function.
* Advise senior and executive leadership on site ecosystem trends, strategic partnership opportunities, competitive dynamics, investment choices, and organizational capabilities required to support future growth.
* Represent Thermo Fisher externally at executive customer engagements, strategic partnership discussions, investigator forums, industry events, and other high-level engagements that advance the company's position as a preferred clinical research partner.
* Perform other duties as assigned based on business needs.

**Job Knowledge**

Applies expert knowledge of global clinical operations, strategic site engagement, feasibility, portfolio strategy, investigator and institutional partnerships, clinical trial delivery, and external ecosystem dynamics to shape global strategy and investment priorities. Recognized as an enterprise thought leader who integrates TBU strategy, customer needs, market intelligence, and site-network capabilities to influence organizational design, partnership models, and future business direction.

**Job Complexity**

Leads a global capability at the intersection of TBUs, Global Clinical Operations, regions, countries, and the external site ecosystem. Resolves ambiguity and competing priorities across therapeutic areas, geographies, customers, and functions while making strategic choices that influence network design, partnership investment, organizational capability, and measurable business outcomes.

Leads highly complex initiatives requiring strategic thinking, executive influence, and cross-functional leadership

**Supervision Received / Freedom to act**

Operates with broad strategic autonomy and significant independent judgment in establishing regional priorities, developing strategic partnerships, and executing organizational objectives. Regularly advises executive leadership on site engagement strategy, organizational capabilities, and market trends.

**Interactions / Business Relationships**

Builds and maintains executive relationships with TBU Leaders, Global Clinical Operations leadership, Regional Site Network Leads, FSS leadership, Country Operations, Commercial, Medical, Business Development, Finance, and other cross-functional partners. Externally, engages senior investigators and leaders of strategic research institutions, health systems, and site networks, representing Thermo Fisher as an executive strategic partner.

**Qualifications:**

**Education and Experience:**
-----------------------------

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent and relevant formal academic/vocational qualification. Advanced degree (MBA, MS, MPH, PharmD, or equivalent) preferred.
* Previous experience that provides the knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the job (typically comparable to 15+ years), including significant leadership experience in global clinical operations, site strategy, feasibility, strategic partnerships, project delivery or related areas.
* Demonstrated experience leading director-level and global cross-functional organizations, translating portfolio strategy into operating priorities, establishing strategic external partnerships, and influencing enterprise-level decisions is strongly preferred.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:**

  

* Global strategy development and enterprise-level strategic thinking
* Therapeutic expertise and portfolio strategy translation into site-network priorities
* Strategic site partnership architecture, segmentation, and governance
* Deep understanding of global clinical operations, feasibility, and the investigator/site ecosystem
* Executive influencing, decision framing, and stakeholder management
* Ability to lead leaders and high-performing teams across complex global and matrix organizations.
* Data-driven decision making, performance analytics, and value demonstration
* Operating model design, governance, and organizational transformation
* Commercial acumen, customer strategy, and business development engagement
* Strong business, financial, and resource-allocation acumen
* Ability to drive talent strategy, succession planning, and high-performing team development
* Excellent executive communication, storytelling, and presentation skills
* Executive leadership and organizational transformation
* Ability to travel globally as required.

**Policy & Strategy:**

* Defines and leads the Global Site Strategic Network aligned with Global Clinical Operations and TBU priorities. Establishes the strategic partnership framework, operating model, governance, decision rights, performance standards, and investment principles that guide global, regional, country, and site-level engagement.
* Translates TBU portfolio strategy into site-network direction and uses local and regional intelligence to inform enterprise decisions. Recommends and leads strategic changes that influence clinical operations capabilities, external partnership strategy, and future business direction.

**Management Role:** Leads a global organization through direct leaders and matrix partnerships. Accountable for organizational strategy, performance, talent and succession, resource planning, capability development, and execution of global business objectives.

Establishes clear accountability across global, regional, and country interfaces and develops high-performing leaders who can translate strategy into consistent local activation and measurable value.

The role is performed in a home office or office environment with regular interaction across global teams utilizing digital collaboration technologies.

**Physical Requirements**

* Frequent use of computer systems and digital technologies.

* Travel by air or ground transportation.
* Ability to lift and carry light materials consistent with normal business travel.

About McGaw

**Our Mission at McGaw.io is to help companies of all sizes realize their customer data is their most valuable business asset, and we help them realize that through customer data infrastructure, high power analytics, marketing automation, personalization, and funnel optimization.**

McGaw.io supports businesses with analytics, marketing automation, customer data platforms, data piping, websites, AB testing, and all sorts of marketing operations. As we derive insights from these technical efforts, we also inform & execute growth strategies that routinely move the needle for our clients.

Our track record is impeccable, and our leadership has supported some of the fastest-growing companies in the world. McGaw.io’s core client base sells online and has complex data and marketing practices that drive our team to dig deeper every day.

Mission
-------

Own technical delivery across your accounts. Design the stack, build the hard parts, direct the technical team, and keep projects on schedule and profitable.

Why this role exists
--------------------

Our clients are spread across North America and Europe, but our technical bench is not. European accounts wait a day for answers and North American accounts compete for the same people. This role adds senior technical capacity in a time zone that covers both.

  

Responsibilities
----------------

**Architecture and design**

* Design end-to-end customer data stacks: CDP, analytics, marketing automation, CRM, warehouse, pipelines, tag management, testing.
* Lead taxonomy design. Define events, properties, and naming before implementation, not after.
* Solve identity resolution across web, app, offline, and CRM.
* Write ecosystem docs that show where data moves and what breaks if it stops.

**Hands-on build**

* Build. This is not an advisory seat: you will be in the CDP, the warehouse, GTM, and the code.
* Write and review tracking, server-side integrations, and reverse ETL pipelines.
* Run QA to our two-person standard. Check every property in both the CDP and the destination, with a recorded walkthrough.

**Directing the team**

* Turn client requirements into scoped, sequenced tasks for engineers and contract developers.
* Review their work before it reaches a client. You are the quality gate.
* Unblock people. When a build stalls, you get it moving.

**Keeping delivery on track**

* Run the cadence: two-week sprints, a groomed backlog, and a roadmap with three or more months of planned work.
* Flag budget pacing early. Never surprise a client on budget.
* There are no free scope changes. Every change gets estimated, documented, and confirmed in writing before work starts.

**New business**

* Write technical specs for new opportunities. What gets built, in what order, and what it depends on.
* Produce level of effort estimates accurate enough that Sales can price without a rebuild.
* Join pre-sales calls when a prospect needs a technical answer in the room.
* Say when a prospect is not ready, and what would make them ready.

Skills and experience
---------------------

**Required**

* Fully fluent in English. That is the company's working language.
* 6+ years designing and integrating marketing and customer data technology. At least 3 in an agency, consultancy, or professional services with multiple clients.
* Understand how CDPs drive marketing, with working knowledge of Segment, Hightouch, or RudderStack. No preference among them. Know one and you can learn the others.
* Proficient in JavaScript and SQL. Comfortable in a shared repo.
* Designed at least three full stacks, not just operated tools someone else picked.
* GDPR and consent handled as part of the build.

**Systems**

Depth in at least three groups, working familiarity with the rest:

* Customer data platforms: Segment, Hightouch, RudderStack
* Analytics: Amplitude, Mixpanel, GA4
* Lifecycle and marketing automation: Braze, Customer.io, HubSpot, Marketo, Iterable
* Warehouse and transformation: Snowflake, BigQuery, dbt
* Tag management: Google Tag Manager, server-side GTM
* CRM: Salesforce, HubSpot
* Consent management: OneTrust, Cookiebot, Didomi

**Preferred**

* Multilingual with professional working proficiency in English as well as German, French, Spanish, or Italian.
* Server-side tracking under EU consent rules.
* Work across both European and North American clients.

What you get out of this
------------------------

* Many stacks in a year instead of one stack in five. Different industries, scale, and failure modes.
* The customer data layer is changing right now. Warehouse-native patterns, composable CDPs, and reverse ETL are replacing a decade of assumptions. You build on the new pattern.
* We work across the full client stack, not just individual systems or specific vendors. You see how it all fits together, which is where the hard problems are visible.
* Both European and North American markets from one seat.

Observable indicators
---------------------

**Month 2**

* Onboarded to every tool in your accounts' stacks.
* Time tracked in Harvest weekly, without reminders.
* QA to the two-person standard on 100% of what you ship.

**Month 4**

* Running technical delivery on two or more accounts independently.
* Every account has three or more months of planned roadmap.
* Zero undocumented scope changes.

**Month 6**

* Labor efficiency ratio of 2.5 or better across your projects.
* 90% of client objectives hit within the project timeline.
* Client approval for a case study or testimonial on at least one account.
* New business specs and estimates accepted by Sales without rework 80% of the time.

**Month 9**

* Leading technical discovery without US support on the call.
* One expansion opportunity per quarter, surfaced with an estimate attached.

What this role is not
---------------------

* Not account leadership. You will not own the relationship, the renewal, or the P&L.
* Not a sales seat. You write specs and estimates and are paid a bonus on the result. You do not prospect.
* Not people management. You direct technical work. No direct reports at hiring stage.
* Not advisory. If you want to stop building, this is the wrong role.

Values
------

* Never Settle, Be Amazing. Fix it properly, not just enough to close the ticket.
* Get Better Every Day. Ask for feedback and change what you do when you get it.
* Give Context and Set the Stage. Nobody on your project is surprised by what you already knew.
* Let the Data Create Transparency. Recommendations come with evidence. So does bad news.
* Show Hospitality to Build Trust. Clients and teammates get proactive, responsive treatment.

Plus extreme ownership. Own outcomes, surface blockers early, and never hand a problem back to the person who gave it to you.

Benefits
--------

* Flexible PTO
* Flexible hours
* Work remotely
* Monthly per diem for premium health, dental, and vision coverage if not already available
* Maternity and paternity leave
* Retirement contribution of 3% of salary annually.
* Company laptop, monitor, and remote setup equipment
* Federal holidays off for US citizens, national holidays off for international contractors
* Radically transparent workplace
* Room to act on your own ideas

The job in practice
-------------------

McGaw is a customer data and revenue operations consultancy. Clients come to us with traffic, tools, and data, and no system connecting them. We find where revenue leaks across acquisition, conversion, and retention, then we fix it with our hands on the keyboards.

The CDP is the center of most of our work. We build on Segment, Hightouch, and RudderStack, chosen per client. We work across the full client stack, not just individual systems or specific vendors.

Our clients are in North America and Europe. Your portfolio will be a mix.

**Month 1.** Learn our clients, cadence, and tooling. Shadow live accounts. Run QA on other people's work to see our standard from the inside. Start owning tasks on one account.

**Months 2 and 3.** Take technical ownership of your first accounts. Build the roadmaps. Run the sprints. You still have support on client calls.

**Months 4 to 6.** Run delivery independently across accounts. Direct the resources assigned to you. Start writing specs for new business.

**After 6 months.** You are a technical authority across the portfolio. You lead discovery, scope new work, and set the standard new hires learn from.

**What is hard?** Accounts run at the same time and the work is billable by the hour, so time tracking is not optional. A portfolio across two continents splits your day in half. You will sometimes be the only person awake when a pipeline breaks.
