description:
Madrid, Spain | Full time | Home-based | R1573009

  

**Instrument Licensing Solutions and Patient & Site Strategy** helps organizations understand how patients feel and function in clinical research and routine care. The team develops and manages the instruments used to capture patient experience, oversees permissions and licensing, and guides the evolution and integration of patient- and site-facing technologies with electronic health records.

  
  

**Patient Science, Instrument Development and Thought Leadership**
------------------------------------------------------------------

Patient Science, Instrument R&D and Thought Leadership develops new clinical outcome assessment instruments and expands or enhances existing instruments, with emphasis on priority therapeutic areas and market gaps. Drawing on deep expertise in instrument development, scientific consulting, and delivery, the team supports client engagements in collaboration with Patient and Clinical Technology (PACT), IQVIA Laboratories, digital-measure scientists, imaging-measurement scientists, COA managers and therapeutic-area centers of excellence. The team also advances thought leadership through white papers, peer-reviewed publications, books, posters, and podium presentations, working closely with clients, regulators, patient advocacy organizations, industry experts, and other stakeholders.

  
  

**Position**

Composite and companion measures represent an important advance in measuring what matters to patients. By integrating multiple sources of evidence, they help move health care and clinical research beyond measures of service utilization toward a more complete understanding of meaningful outcomes.

This role leads the strategic, scientific, and regulatory development of laboratory- and genomic-enabled composite and companion measures in partnership with IQVIA Labs and external partners. These solutions are designed for use by biopharmaceutical and medical-device organizations in clinical trials and real-world studies, as well as by health care professionals in routine clinical practice.

The Senior Director ensures that the patient perspective is rigorously measured and incorporated into drug-development strategy, laboratory and genomic research, clinical outcome assessment endpoint strategy, regulatory submissions, and commercialization through the application of behavioral and measurement science.

  
  

**Role Overview**
-----------------

The Senior Director Composite Measures Science & Integration leads the design, development, validation, and implementation of scientifically rigorous composite and companion measurement solutions in partnership with IQVIA Labs and external partners. The role supports corporate strategy, client requirements, global clinical trials, real-world research, and patient-facing care by integrating clinical outcome assessments, digital measures, laboratory and genomic data, and emerging technologies into meaningful endpoints and scalable service offerings aligned with market needs and the IQVIA solutions portfolio.

  
  

**Strategic and Scientific Leadership**
---------------------------------------

Set the strategy, scientific direction, and operating model for Laboratory & Genomic composite and companion measure development.

Partner with IQVIA Labs scientific team and external partners on scientific evolution and market needs.

Assess the feasibility and value of applying measurement science, laboratory methods, digital technologies, and novel data sources to products and services.

Align measurement research and development priorities with corporate strategy, business objectives, client needs, regulatory expectations, and market dynamics.

Maintain expert knowledge of developments in drug development, clinical outcome assessment, digital health technology, laboratory science, genomics, patient care, and relevant regulatory guidance.

Serve as a recognized internal and external scientific authority and as the primary technical contact for complex, cross-functional contracts and projects.

  
  

**Core Responsibilities**
-------------------------

* Direct the end-to-end development, validation, integration, and delivery of composite measures that combine laboratory, genomic and other clinically relevant data with patient-reported, clinician-reported and digital outcome data.
* Ensure that COA data collection, digital-measure data, laboratory operations, and associated deliverables meet applicable scientific, quality, privacy, and regulatory requirements.
* Lead research design and execution, including validation protocols, analytical methods, technical reports, troubleshooting strategies, and short- and long-term project goals.
* Oversee the evaluation and validation of relevant laboratory measurement instruments and methods, including installation, operational, and performance qualification documentation, as appropriate in collaboration with IQVIA Labs and external partners.
* Ensure the high-quality, timely delivery of clinical research and health care solutions while maintaining exceptional standards of client service.
* Use performance indicators, process analysis and AI to improve efficiency, scalability, cost control, resource utilization, and readiness for growth.
* Lead cross-functional initiatives and collaborate with therapeutic-area experts, consulting teams, regulators, clients, patient advocacy organizations, industry thought leaders, technology partners, and other stakeholders.

**Innovation, Publications, and Partnerships**
----------------------------------------------

* Translate scientific and technological advances into differentiated service offerings for clinical research and patient-facing care.
* Advance scientific literature and industry dialogue through peer-reviewed manuscripts, abstracts, posters, podium presentations, white papers, books, patent applications, and scientifically accurate marketing materials.
* Lead or support the development of intellectual property, vendor agreements, research collaborations, and strategic partnerships.
* Identify proactive client solutions that create scientific value, strengthen market differentiation, and support sustainable revenue growth.
  

  

**People and Operational Leadership**
-------------------------------------

* Build, lead, and develop a high-performing multidisciplinary team through effective recruitment, onboarding, training, mentorship, performance management, and succession planning.

* Establish and manage operating budgets, resource plans, cost-control standards, and capacity strategies.

* Manage staff in accordance with organizational policies and applicable regulations, including work planning, assignment, professional development, employee relations, and appropriate human-resources actions.
  

  

**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant scientific discipline required; advanced degree preferred.
* At least 15 years of relevant experience, including substantial experience in scientific method development, clinical laboratory or drug-development solutions, and people leadership.
* Comprehensive knowledge of scientific principles, measurement theory, method development, drug development, and relevant state-of-the-art instrumentation and technologies.
* Demonstrated ability to influence across organizational boundaries, lead multiple workstreams, manage complex projects, and communicate effectively with clients and senior leaders.
* Strong organizational, interpersonal, analytical, presentation, and client-management capabilities, with the ability to translate scientific insight into practical, scalable, and commercially relevant solutions.

title: Senior Technical Product Manager - Keet (100% Remote)
description:
***Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance***

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

***Innovate with Tether***

**Tether Finance:** Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, **USDT**, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

**Tether Power:** Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

**Tether Data:** Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like **KEET**, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

**Tether Education**: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

**Tether Evolution**: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

***Why Join Us?***

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

**Are you ready to be part of the future?**

**About the job**

Keet is a fully peer-to-peer messaging and video calling app built on Holepunch's P2P stack. There are no servers, no middlemen, and no data harvesting. People talk directly to each other, with end-to-end encryption by design.

We are looking for a **Senior Technical Product Manager** to own the vision for Keet and lead it to a billion users, competing head-on with WhatsApp and Telegram. This is not a maintenance role. You will define where Keet goes, convince the board and the team that it is the right direction, and then drive the execution that gets it there.

You are a rare combination of three things. You are a product visionary who has shipped consumer chat or calling apps at scale. You are a technologist who can go deep on P2P architecture and the Pear / Holepunch stack (docs.pears.com). And you are a hands-on builder who uses AI tools to prototype and prove concepts in days, not months. You set the bar high, move at incredible speed, and lead from the front.

You will also be the person who catches what others miss. The PM who thrives here reads every ticket, tracks every dependency, asks the uncomfortable question before it becomes a launch incident, and keeps five workstreams moving simultaneously without losing the thread on any of them.

If you prefer a PM role where you set strategy and delegate execution, this is not the right fit. If you want to build something that ships to real users, moves markets, and carries your fingerprints from concept to production, we want to hear from you.

**Responsibilities**

**Vision & Strategy**

* Own and articulate the long-term product vision for Keet as the world's leading private, peer-to-peer communication app, with a clear path to 1 billion users.
* Analyze WhatsApp, Telegram, Signal, LINE, WeChat and emerging competitors to identify where P2P gives Keet an unfair advantage, and build the roadmap around it.
* Present product vision, strategy, metrics and progress to the board and executive leadership with clarity and conviction.

Define a growth strategy across acquisition, activation, retention and virality, with measurable targets at every stage.

**Technical Product Leadership**

* Develop a deep working understanding of the Holepunch P2P stack (Pear runtime, Bare, Hypercore, Hyperswarm, HyperDHT, Autobase, Hyperbee) and translate its capabilities and constraints into product decisions.
* Partner with core engineering on hard P2P problems at scale, including NAT traversal, offline sync, multi-device support, large groups, push notifications, and battery and data efficiency on mobile.
* Own the real-time calling experience (1:1 and group voice and video, plus screen sharing) to a quality bar that matches or beats Google Meet and Zoom.
* Define clear feature tiers with explicit labels for stable versus experimental functionality.

**Rapid Prototyping with AI**

* Use AI coding and design tools to build working prototypes and demos that prove concepts before committing engineering resources.
* Turn ideas into something the team, users and the board can see and touch within days.

**Execution & Team Leadership**

* Lead the product team and run the sprint cadence end to end, covering planning, prioritization, standups, reviews and retrospectives.
* Own deliverables from conception through release, testing and post-launch iteration, ensuring core functionality works reliably every time.
* Maintain issue trackers and roadmaps that accurately reflect priorities and sprint commitments.
* Coordinate across engineering, QA, design, marketing and business stakeholders, and manage cross-team dependencies across the Holepunch and Tether ecosystem.
* Provide transparent updates on status, risks and timeline changes, and hold direct conversations about accountability when needed.

**Mobile & Distribution**

* Own the mobile release process across iOS and Android. This includes App Store and Google Play submissions, review guidelines, compliance, store listings, ratings and release management.
* Oversee desktop distribution and installers across macOS, Windows and Linux.
* Build crash reporting, debugging and analytics systems, privacy-preserving by design, that turn user reports into actionable engineering data.

**Mandatory:**

* 8+ years of product management experience, including significant time in a senior or lead role owning a consumer product end to end.
* Strong product sense, with a proven track record of setting product vision and driving it to measurable outcomes at scale (tens of millions of users or more).
* Experience leading engineers who ship products, including running sprint cadences with predictable delivery across cross-functional teams.
* Deep JavaScript and React skills. You can read and write production code, review pull requests, and build working prototypes yourself.
* Intuition for distributed and local-first systems. You don't need P2P expertise, because our core abstracts it away, but you should be able to reason about sync, offline behavior and consistency trade-offs.
* Hands-on experience shipping and scaling mobile apps on iOS and Android, with deep familiarity with App Store and Google Play logistics, review processes and release management.
* Experience with real-time voice and video calling products (such as Google Meet, Zoom, FaceTime or WhatsApp calls) and the quality, latency and reliability trade-offs involved.
* Demonstrated ability to use AI tools to rapidly prototype and demonstrate product concepts.
* Exceptional communication skills, with experience presenting vision and strategy to boards, executives and investors.
* A strong understanding of urgency versus importance, and the judgment to make fast, high-quality decisions with incomplete information.
* You thrive in a high-intensity, fast-moving environment, set an exceptionally high bar, and are willing to go above and beyond, including extended hours, when the mission demands it.
* Excellent written and spoken English.

**Nice to have:**

* Product leadership experience at a major messaging app such as WhatsApp, Telegram, LINE, WeChat, Signal, Viber or KakaoTalk.
* Experience with peer-to-peer technologies, distributed systems or decentralized protocols. Prior exposure to Holepunch, Pear or Hypercore is a strong plus.
* Experience growing a product in emerging markets or across multiple regions and languages.
* A background in privacy, encryption or security-focused products.
* Familiarity with Electron, React Native or similar cross-platform frameworks, as well as installer systems, boot performance and Linux packaging (Snap, AppImage, Flatpak).
* A solid understanding of testing approaches (unit, integration, end-to-end), test automation and performance testing.
* An engineering background or computer science degree.
* Experience with Git, issue trackers and modern collaboration tools.

**Why this role:**

The next billion-user communication app will not run on someone else's servers. If you want to be the person who defines it, presents it to the board, prototypes it yourself, and then leads the team that ships it, we want to hear from you.

In your application, include a link to a product you have shipped or a prototype you have built, along with a few sentences on how you would take Keet to 1 billion users.

**Important information for candidates**  
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

* **Apply only through our official channels.** We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/
* **Verify the recruiter’s identity.** All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
* **Be cautious of unusual communication methods.** We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
* **Double-check email addresses.** All communication from us will come from emails ending in **@**tether.to **or @**tether.io
* **We will never request payment or financial details.** If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

**When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.**

Being part of **LOEWE** gives you the opportunity to learn something new every day while working alongside passionate people in a fast-moving and ambitious company.

Our **Special Projects department** is looking for an **Architect** to join the team and support the design, production and implementation of LOEWE offices and special projects. This is an exciting opportunity to work across high-profile projects within a leading luxury fashion house, combining architecture, design, creativity and technical expertise.

### **Job responsibilities**

**About your role:**

* Support the Project Manager in the conceptual design and layout development of LOEWE offices and special projects, ensuring proposals are feasible in terms of execution, budget and timing.
* Develop 2D and 3D technical drawings, prototypes, moodboards and presentations to communicate project concepts and solutions effectively.
* Support the production and implementation of projects, ensuring the highest quality standards while monitoring budgets, timelines, materials and deliverables.
* Coordinate with internal teams, architects, suppliers, contractors and other external partners throughout all project phases.
* Follow up on orders, budgets, materials and samples to ensure smooth and timely project execution.
* Conduct site visits to monitor progress, resolve technical issues and ensure compliance with design specifications and safety standards.
* Support office projects across LOEWE locations, including the Paris offices, the new Centro de Excelencia in Getafe, the new Barcelona site and other office adaptations.
* Support special projects such as the LOEWE Showroom and Craft Prize, working closely with teams including Marketing, PR, Events, Retail, Merchandising and the LOEWE Foundation.
* Contribute to technical research and the implementation of innovative solutions related to space optimization, materials, energy efficiency, acoustics and sustainability.
* Research and source new materials, furniture and innovative techniques, keeping up to date with developments in architecture, design, art and fashion.

### **Profile**

**About you:**

* 3–5 years of experience as an architect and/or project manager, with a strong focus on office design and project delivery.
* Experience in ephemeral architecture, museography and/or retail projects will be highly valued.
* Master’s degree in Architecture.
* Excellent project management, organizational and coordination skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong technical knowledge and experience coordinating suppliers, contractors and external partners.
* Excellent graphic representation skills, including 2D drawing and 3D modelling.
* Proficiency in AutoCAD and 3D software such as SketchUp, 3D Studio or Rhino.
* Strong knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Photoshop, Illustrator and InDesign.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, especially Excel.
* High level of both Spanish and English, spoken and written.
* Strong interest in fashion, art, culture, architecture and design.
* Creative problem-solver with strong analytical and organizational abilities.
* Excellent communication skills and a strong team-oriented approach.
* Creativity, innovation and attention to detail are highly valued. A portfolio will be appreciated.

### **Additional information**

**About us:**

Founded in Spain in 1846, LOEWE is the second-oldest luxury fashion house in the world. Since 2025, the House is under the creative direction of Jack McCollough and Lazaro Hernandez, guided by a rich artistic sensibility and an imaginative exploration of craft. This new chapter builds on core sensibilities of LOEWE: an intellectual and playful approach to fashion, the vibrant spirit of Spanish lifestyle, and unmatched leather expertise.

At LOEWE we are committed to a culture that welcomes all, regardless of gender, ethnicity, socioeconomic background and abilities, including people with disabilities of all types. Our aim is for everyone to feel valued, included, and empowered to contribute their best.

***LOEWE*** 
**MAISON**
-----------------------

Steeped in art and historical references, rooted in craft and tradition, Loewe has been reinventing leather craftmanship for almost 200 years. From its birth in Madrid in 1846 to its latest collection dedicated to the elegance of Chinese monochrome ceramics, the Maison’s journey has been defined by its core values: energy, creativity, and a thoroughly modern approach blended with traditional techniques.
  
Craft at Loewe is unconditionally bound up with art, an endless source of inspiration: from the British Arts & Craft masters to the whimsical world of Studio Ghibli, art is at the heart of every collection – and the House is committed to supporting the artists and creators informing its work.
  
Today, Loewe’s master artisans combine their craft knowledge, accumulated over generations, with new technologies to produce iconic objects presenting both instant appeal and enduring style: true incarnations of Loewe’s ideals and vision.
  
Radical and ever-evolving: here’s to another 200 years of Loewe history
  
Since 2013, Jonathan Anderson, Loewe’s Creative Director, has been carrying this vision ever further. One of the leading designers of his generation, Anderson has spearheaded a major rejuvenation of the House.
  
Through a redesign of the brand identity, a modern articulation of its commitment to craft (with the launch of the Loewe Foundation Craft Prize, for instance), and a series of critically acclaimed and genre-defining Women’s and Men’s collections, Loewe has been further elevated as an influential and global cultural force.
  
At the intersection of fashion, craft and culture, Loewe’s ambition is to be radical and ever-evolving. Craft and luxury are inextricably linked, and at Loewe, the one makes the other feel more accessible and tangible. By showing how the collections are made and honouring the complex artisanal processes behind them, it becomes possible to see their value and their merit. And by adding a cultural dimension – involving fine arts, film, dance, etc. –, Loewe has become a vibrant force for creativity and innovation, ensuring the brand’s durability for another 200 years… and more.

This is a mid-level role requiring equal emphasis on self-led technical and analytical delivery and collaborative facilitation across teams, business units, and external partners. The role covers both mobility innovation development and ITS/tolling technical support. Programming and AI-augmented working is the default method, not an afterthought.

  

This position will report to the ITS Lead or directly to the Head of CoE. From time-to-time, as needed, the role may be assigned to specific projects that require a more complex matrix management structure.

The working place is as per above, but the role may require travelling during short periods of time to other places nationally or internationally. There might also be opportunity/requirement for 2 – 6 month long secondments in other territories, including the US.

**Key Responsibilities**

  

**Business Unit Partnership**

* Partner with BU teams to identify innovation opportunities, co-develop initiatives, and support operational adoption.

* Represent CoE4M in workshops, project briefings, and stakeholder outreach, translating BU needs into requirements.

* Coordinate with wider Ferrovial Innovation team to align initiatives and cross-pollinate findings across business lines.

* Brief stakeholders on initiative status/outcomes as needed; represent Ferrovial at external industry events and forums.

**Prototyping & Technical Delivery**

* Run hands-on data analysis, technology assessments, and prototypes end-to-end, from concept to proof-of-value.

* Use AI tools/platforms as core working practice for tech dev/integration, modelling and structured deliverables.

* Build business cases (revenue, cost, and risk models) to support scoping and prioritization decisions.

* Scope and coordinate resources (internal & external) where a prototype/initiative requires additional capability.

**ITS/Tolling Technical Support**

* Provide technical design input, cost estimates, and budget quotes for ITS and tolling supporting bids and concessions.

**Market Intelligence & Scouting**

* Monitor and synthesize developments in data-driven, automated, and autonomous ITS/Tolling/mobility into insights.

* Evaluate vendors/OEMs/products against defined business priorities; initiate and manage engagement as required.

* Capture knowledge, contacts, and ideas from workshops/events/meetings into written summaries for internal reuse.

* Produce technology briefs, white papers, bid content, and presentation materials from the above intelligence.
* **Knowledge Sharing**
Contribute findings and outputs to the Ferrovial Innovation Community, ensuring visibility across business lines.  

**Qualifications**

  

**Required**

* Degree in Engineering, Computer/Data Science, or equivalent quantitative/technical discipline or experience.

* 2+ years working directly with transport technologies and infrastructure — e.g., ITS, tolling systems (open-road/all-electronic tolling, interoperability standards), traffic management systems or C-V2X/V2X connected-vehicle platforms.

* Proven advanced level programming experience, preferably Python, C/C++ or similar

* Practical, hands-on fluency with AI tools beyond consumer chat interfaces — e.g., using LLM APIs or agentic platforms (Anthropic, OpenAI, Copilot Studio) to build structured workflows, using AI-assisted coding for data pipelines or prototypes (Python/SQL preferred), or applying AI to geospatial data/imagery analysis for infra monitoring.

* Fluent in MS Office 365 (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams, Copilot).

* Able to engage credibly with stakeholders at manager/director level.

* Excellent English required; professional Spanish highly desirable.

Willingness to travel periodically (domestic and international). Valid passport and driving licence.(B1).  

  

**What are we looking for**

* Technically & commercially grounded: genuine curiosity about how data/tech/AI is reshaping mobility and able to engage with both technical and commercial dimensions and stakeholders.

* Digitally fluent: you actively seek and utilize digital/AI tools that improve the quality and speed of your outputs.

* Analytical communicator: able to synthesise complexity into clear, structured outputs for varied audiences.

* Dual-mode contributor: equally effective as an independent technical contributor and as a collaborative facilitator.

Pragmatic and delivery-focused: entrepreneurial mindset with a clear bias toward action and tangible output.  

  

**Desirable**

* Knowledge for the design and deployment of communications networks

* Hands-on experience on the usage of development boards (e.g. arduino, raspberry-pi)

* Hardware configuration, management and integration (e.g. cameras, lidars, switches, servers)

* Experience in an innovation, digital, technology, AI, or data-focused role within a corporate or consulting environment.

* Working knowledge of mobility data standards and formats relevant to analytics and system integration.

* Demonstrated interest and working knowledge of connected/autonomous mobility, digital tolling, or mobility analytics; able to speak to eco-system, technologies, and where the sector is heading, not just historical context.

* Track record of project delivery with tangible outputs combining self-led technical work (data analysis, prototyping, modelling) and cross-team collaboration.

* Comfort working across corporate, startup, public sector, or innovation-ecosystem, adapting delivery style accordingly.

* Experience with Earth Observation data (satellite/SAR imagery, platforms like Google Dynamic World or Sentinel Hub) for infrastructure risk, construction monitoring, or asset management use cases.

* Familiarity with Demand Responsive Transport (DRT) systems and/or dynamic/managed-lane management.

* Experience with advanced comms infrastructure (5G, satellite comms) or IoT sensor networks as applied to transport/infrastructure monitoring.

* Exposure to VR/XR for training, simulation, or stakeholder visualization; or early-stage familiarity with quantum computing applications in optimization/logistics.

* Business development, venturing, or financial modelling experience or formal training.

* International professional experience.

**Seize the challenge. Move the world together!** Innovative, creative, respectful, and diverse are some of the ways we describe ourselves. We are motivated by challenges, and we collaborate across our business units to move the world together. Your journey to a fulfilling career starts here!

We treat all jobs applications equally, regardless of gender, color, race, ethnicity, religion, national origin, age, disability, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, covered veteran status or protected genetic information (each, a “Protected Class”), or any other protected class in accordance with applicable laws.

title: Senior Auditor - Property & Casualty Actuarial (Hybrid; m/f/x/d), Madrid (M, ES)
description:
**Location:** Madrid, M, ES

Are you a qualified or nearly qualified Property & Casualty Actuary looking to leverage your technical expertise in a role with broad organisational impact? Join our Group Internal Audit team in Madrid, where you'll help protect Swiss Re's assets, reputation, and sustainability through independent risk assessment and insightful recommendations. This role offers exceptional visibility across the business and a genuine opportunity to influence topics of organisational significance.

**About the Role**

As a Senior Auditor specialising in Property & Casualty actuarial topics, you'll be at the heart of Swiss Re's risk assurance function — leading audits across the (re)insurance value chain with a focus on reserving, pricing, and risk management. You'll evaluate control effectiveness, identify emerging risks, and engage with senior stakeholders to drive meaningful improvements. This is a role where your actuarial expertise meets strategic impact.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Lead and deliver** a portfolio of audits across the Property & Casualty (re)insurance value chain, owning engagements end-to-end and ensuring timely, high-quality, risk-focused outcomes.
* **Evaluate the effectiveness** of governance, controls, and risk management practices across actuarial topics, including reserving and pricing.
* **Identify and assess** key and emerging risks within the P&C actuarial domain, keeping Swiss Re ahead of the curve.
* **Engage and challenge** senior stakeholders, fostering transparent and constructive discussions that support effective risk management and sound decision-making.
* **Coach and support** team members, sharing your expertise and contributing to a collaborative, high-performing audit team.
* **Contribute to a strong, forward-looking risk culture** at Swiss Re, reinforcing the value of independent, objective assurance.

**About the Team**

Group Internal Audit (GIA) provides independent and objective assurance to support the Board of Directors and Group Executive Committee in protecting Swiss Re's assets, reputation, and sustainability. GIA's vision is to advance Swiss Re's resilience by delivering risk-responsive assurance and providing innovative insights that strengthen the control environment and support the achievement of business objectives. As part of this team, you'll work alongside talented professionals who are passionate about making a real difference to the organisation.

**About You**

You're a detail-oriented Property & Casualty (P&C) actuary with strong analytical skills and the confidence to challenge established practices. You excel at translating complex actuarial concepts into meaningful business insights and can communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels. You're passionate about risk management and eager to contribute to Swiss Re's resilience through independent, objective assessment.

**We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:**

* Nearly qualified or fully qualified P&C actuary
* 7+ years of experience in the insurance and/or reinsurance industry
* Strong experience in P&C reserving and/or pricing methodologies
* Solid understanding of emerging risks and trends in the P&C (re)insurance industry
* Solid understanding of IFRS 17 and/or US GAAP governance, processes, and controls

**These are additional nice to haves:**

* Experience in internal audit or risk management functions
* Knowledge of regulatory frameworks applicable to (re)insurance companies
* Experience with data analytics tools and techniques
* Project management skills and experience leading small teams

For Spain, the base salary range for this position is between 56 000 EUR and 94 000 EUR for a full-time role.

The specific salary offered considers:

* The requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role
* The applicant's own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience

In addition to your base salary, Swiss Re offers an attractive performance-based variable compensation component, designed to recognise your achievements. Furthermore, you will enjoy a variety of global and location specific benefits. Eligibility may vary depending on the terms of Swiss Re policies and your employment contract.

**Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week.**

**Please upload your CV in English.**

**About Swiss Re**

Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.
  
  
Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.
  
  
If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.

It is our practice to recruit, hire and promote without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, pregnancy, sexual orientations, marital status, military status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Decisions on employment are solely based on an individual's qualifications for the position being filled.

title: Machine Learning Artist / Technical Director – VFX
description:
**Company Description**

Built on legacy. Driven by what’s next.

At El Ranchito, our work comes to life through the unique talent, creativity, and imagination of our people. From our studios in Madrid and Barcelona, we bring some of the biggest stories in film and television to screens everywhere through world-class visual effects.

As part of the Pitch Black network, El Ranchito brings its distinctive creative expertise to a global community of studios, diverse talent, technology, resources, and possibilities.

Join us and help craft the moments audiences remember.

 **Job Description**

El Ranchito is looking for a Machine Learning Artist / Technical Director who combines strong visual judgement with coding and applied machine-learning skills.

Reporting to the Machine Learning Supervisor, this is a hands-on, production-facing role focused on using ML to solve real VFX challenges. The position sits between artistry, pipeline development and applied machine learning: understanding how high-quality visual effects are created while having the technical ability to build, adapt and troubleshoot the tools behind them.

This is not a role focused solely on generating images with existing tools. We are looking for someone who can understand a production problem, investigate possible technical solutions, build or adapt a workflow, evaluate its limitations and help artists use it successfully on real work.

Candidates may come from any VFX department—including compositing, FX or Lighting. Professional experience as a production VFX artist or artist-facing TD is strongly preferred.

Exceptional ML candidates without a traditional VFX background may also be considered if they demonstrate outstanding technical depth, strong visual judgement and highly relevant work in image, video, 3D or other areas directly applicable to VFX production.

The role is open to candidates based in Spain.

 **Qualifications**  

* Professional production experience as a VFX artist or artist-facing TD in at least one department is strongly preferred.
* A strong reel, portfolio or body of work demonstrating visual judgement and technical problem-solving.
* Practical experience applying machine learning, computer vision or generative models to image, video, geometry or related media.
* Strong Python skills and experience creating maintainable production tools.
* Familiarity with Git, APIs, package and environment management, and reproducible development practices.
* Experience with an ML framework such as PyTorch or equivalent.
* A working understanding of model inference, datasets, evaluation, fine-tuning and GPU-based processing.
* Experience integrating tools into at least one major VFX application or production pipeline is highly valued.
* A solid understanding of production imagery, including colour, dynamic range, resolution, compositing requirements and temporal consistency.
* Strong visual judgement and the ability to respond constructively to creative direction.
* A generalist mindset and the ability to move comfortably between creative, technical and pipeline challenges.
* The ability to explain technical ideas and limitations clearly to artists, supervisors and production teams.
* Full professional fluency in spoken and written English, with confidence collaborating across international teams and time zones.
* Candidates must be based within the European Union for the duration of the role. Spain is preferred but not essential.

Candidates without a traditional VFX background may still be considered if they demonstrate an exceptional track record in relevant applied ML work, together with a strong visual portfolio and a clear understanding of the quality and control required for professional image production.

**Valuable Additional Experience**

* Nuke, Houdini, Maya, Blender, Unreal Engine or other VFX and DCC applications.
* ComfyUI or other node-based ML workflow systems.
* OpenCV, Diffusers or related computer-vision and generative-media frameworks.
* C++, CUDA or model and inference optimisation.
* Linux, containers, cloud or render-farm infrastructure.
* USD, OpenColorIO, ACES, EXR and high-dynamic-range image workflows.
* Segmentation, matting, tracking, depth estimation, reconstruction, inpainting, relighting, denoising or upscaling.
* Video generation, optical flow and temporal consistency techniques.
* Dataset preparation, model training or distributed inference.
* Artist-facing UI or web development.
* Open-source contributions, publications or research with a clear application to VFX production.

  
**Additional Information**

Please include a CV, reel or portfolio, and examples of relevant technical work.

These may include code samples, open-source contributions, tools, workflow demonstrations or concise case studies explaining the production problem, your individual contribution, the approach taken, its limitations and the final result.

We understand that production work is often confidential. Please do not share restricted material; a clear written breakdown of your role and approach is equally valuable.

**Need Accommodation?**

We are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruitment experience.

**Privacy Notice**

Your personal information will be collected, used, and stored for recruitment purposes in accordance with applicable privacy laws.

**Pitch Black is an Equal Opportunity Employer**

At Pitch Black, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, skills, experience, and business needs. We provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, colour, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national or ethnic origin, ancestry, disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital or family status, pregnancy, veteran or military status, citizenship, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, provincial, or local law.

title: Executive Associate- [Open to Tier 0, 1 and 2 applicants]
description:
**Tiered Approach**

In line with the commitment to safeguard capacity and support personnel already in the Organization, a majority of UNDP UNCDF/UNV vacancies are advertised using a tiered application process whereby:

* **Tier 0:** UNDP/UNCDF/UNV IP staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments, whose posts will be abolished, or contracts will be terminated or not renewed during 2026.
* **Tier 1:** Other UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments
* **Tier 2:** UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding temporary appointments (TA), personnel on regular PSA contracts, and Expert and Specialist UN Volunteers
* **Tier 3 or no tier indicated:** All other contract types from UNDP/UNCDF/UNV and other agencies, and other external candidates

Please make note of the Tier(s) indicated in the vacancy title, if any, and ensure that you satisfy the eligibility to apply.

**Background**

UNDP is the knowledge frontier organization for sustainable development in the UN Development System and serves as the integrator for collective action to realize the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). UNDP’s policy work carried out at HQ, Regional and Country Office levels, forms a contiguous spectrum of deep local knowledge to cutting-edge global perspectives and advocacy.

The Bureau for Policy and Programme Support (BPPS) has the responsibility for developing all relevant policy and guidance to support the results of UNDP’s Strategic Plan. BPPS’s staff provides technical advice to Country Offices; advocates for UNDP corporate messages, represents UNDP at multi-stakeholder fora including public-private dialogues, government and civil society dialogues, South-South and Triangular cooperation initiatives, and engages in UN inter-agency coordination in specific thematic areas. BPPS assists UNDP and partners to achieve higher quality development results through an integrated approach that links results-based management and performance monitoring with more effective and new ways of working. BPPS supports UNDP and partners to be more innovative, knowledge and data driven including in its programme support efforts in close coordination and thematic synergy with the Crisis Bureau (CB).

The Front Office of BPPS is responsible for the smooth and seamless management of the substantive flow of information to and from BPPS, coordinating effective internal communications with BPPS teams, other Bureaus, the UNDP Executive Office, as well as communications with external partners. The Front Office plans and coordinates the BPPS Director and BPPS Deputy Director’s internal and external interactions and interventions based on priorities and agendas, in close collaboration with technical teams and other Bureaus as needed, ensuring the Director and Deputy Director’s successful provision of political leadership, strategic guidance, and managerial as well as programmatic priorities in full compliance with UNDP’s mandate.

With the opening of a new UNDP office in Madrid, where the BPPS Deputy Director and a number of BPPS teams will be relocating in the course of 2026, the Executive Associate will play a key role in supporting the establishment and smooth running of the new office, and its efficient interactions with the two other main BPPS locations (New York and Bonn).

**Position Purpose:**

Under the direct supervision of the BPPS Deputy Director and in coordination with their Special Assistant, the Executive Associate ensures that the Deputy Director receives the immediate administrative and operational support needed to execute their managerial functions. The incumbent works closely with both the Special Assistant and the Executive Associate of the Assistant Administrator and Director of BPPS, to strengthen coordination and complementarities in the Office of the Director and contribute toward the overall operations of the Front Office.

As one of the first points of contact with the Bureau for senior UNDP/UN staff and the full range of representatives of UNDP’s constituencies, the Executive Associate must deal with a heavy volume of requests and a wide range of highly sensitive matters under heavy time pressure.

Given the demands of protocol and interaction, often at high levels, the Executive Associate is required to perform the role with a calm demeanor under stressful circumstances, demonstrating efficiency and effectiveness in personal communication, knowledge of protocol, discretion and independent judgment, motivation and proactive attitude.

**The key functions of the Executive Associate are to ensure:**

* Effective and efficient functioning of the office of the Deputy Director of BPPS;
* Effective communications support to the office of the Deputy Director of BPPS;
* Support for effective relationship management by BPPS Directorate;
* Support the establishment and management of the new UNDP Office in Madrid

UNDP adopts a portfolio approach to accommodate changing business needs and leverage linkages across interventions to achieve its strategic goals. Therefore, UNDP personnel are expected to work across units, functions, teams, and projects in multidisciplinary teams in order to enhance and enable horizontal collaboration.

**Duties and Responsibilities**

**1. Ensures effective and efficient functioning of the office of the Deputy Director, focusing on the achievement of the following results:**

* Coordination and maintenance of calendar of meetings and activities of the Deputy Director, including organizing meetings, confirming the Deputy Director’s participation in senior and high-level meetings and events, drafting replies to invitations and meetings and implementing protocol procedures;
* Management of the Deputy Director’s missions and representation schedule, including travel arrangements, communications with meeting organizers/country offices on logistics; itinerary, travel requests in Quantum, follow-up on authorization, clearances, visas, accommodation, and tickets necessary for travel;
* Ensuring compliance with respect to administrative procedures, rules, regulations and systems,;
* Use of automated office management systems for effective functioning of the Deputy Director’s office; maintenance of contact lists and rosters of high-level partners;
* Follow up on deadlines, commitments made, actions taken and coordination of collection and submission of the reports to the Deputy Director;
* Finance/accounts management support (i.e. processing payment requests, requisitions and claims pertaining to travels and retreats/ events) to the Deputy Director and Directorate;
* Support daily management of requests for reviews, approvals and clearances by the Deputy Director via email and DocuSign;
* Coverage and backstopping for the Executive Associate to the Director during peak times and absences

**2. Ensures effective communications support to the office of the Deputy Director of BPPS, focusing on achievement of the following results:**

* Effective monitoring and screening of correspondence arriving in and/or leaving the Deputy Director’s office. Review of incoming correspondence for the Deputy Director’s attention and prioritizing of documents according to action required; review, proofreading, and editing of all correspondence for proper clearance prior to the Deputy Director’s signature;
* Presentation of proposals to the Deputy Director and/or Special Assistant to streamline office procedures between the BPPS front office and other Headquarters units;
* Drafting and preparation of correspondence, directives, comments on behalf of the Deputy Director for their signature and ensuring follow-up as needed;; and
* Appropriate filing, including through automated filing systems, and ensuring safekeeping of confidential materials.
* Acts as secretary to meetings as requested by the Deputy Director, including drafting minutes, follow-ups, and reporting;
* Supports liaison with local counterparts in Spain, including the front offices of local/ federal Ministry officials and other UN agencies.

**3. Supports effective relationship management by BPPS front office, focusing on achievement of the following results:**

* Collaborate with the Special Assistant to the Deputy Director and broader BPPS front office in facilitating the Deputy Director’s interactions (in sensitive, political, diplomatic, and other instances) with various external partners of BPPS, such as ambassadors, donor country delegations, parliamentarians and high-level senior officials, as well as the Administrator and his office;
* Assist the Special Assistant to the Deputy Director in the research, obtaining and analysis of background materials for the preparation of presentations, talking points, briefings, meetings, official missions and appointments;
* Assist in the preparation of public information materials and folders, as requested;
* Support the organization of BPPS events such as townhalls, retreats or workshops, both at Headquarters and off-site; management of procurement of services, logistics, travel, visa, etc.
* Process the Deputy Director’s travel requests and post-travel functions in UNAll, in line with UNDP POPP, including calculation of DSA entitlements and claims and ensuring the timely settlement of claims.
* Process the Deputy Director’s travel fares in coordination with the local travel service (e.g. AMEX) in advance of missions.

**4. Supports the establishment and smooth running of the new UNDP office in Madrid, in collaboration with the BMS focal point in Madrid, focusing on achievement of the following results:**

* Office management, including coordinating with BMS for the necessary inventory of the Deputy Director’s office supplies and IT needs, and ensuring the readiness or usability of office/ meeting/ event spaces (e.g. good connection of video conferencing equipment for hybrid meetings);
* Orientation for BPPS colleagues relocating to Madrid in collaboration with the BMS focal point in Madrid, including advising on necessary local registrations (e.g. to obtain the TIE [foreign ID card]), support for obtainment of UN Grounds Pass, and office security registrations;
* Act as liaison with New York and Bonn BPPS offices in order to optimize the new configuration of BPPS across three main offices;
* Act as point of contact to prepare visits from UNDP leadership, including coordinating with Headquarters on the visit programme, facilitating the necessary travel documents for visas, support to secure UN Grounds Pass where needed, and liaising with counterparts/ Ministries in Spain on logistics and the needful security protocols.
* Acts as logistics coordinator for events involving the Madrid office staff and/or premises (e.g. preparation for official meetings or events hosted in the Madrid office, procurement of services or meeting supplies etc.).

**5. Facilitate knowledge building and management.**

* Provide sound contributions to knowledge networks and communities of practice.
* Organize specialized training as required.

The incumbent performs other duties within their functional profile as deemed necessary for the efficient functioning of the Office and the Organization.

Supervisory/Managerial Responsibilities: None

**Competencies**

* **Achieve Results:** LEVEL 1: Plans and monitors own work, pays attention to details, delivers quality work by deadline
* **Think Innovatively:** LEVEL 1: Open to creative ideas/known risks, is a pragmatic problem solver, and makes improvements
* **Learn Continuously:** LEVEL 1: Open-minded and curious, shares knowledge, learns from mistakes, asks for feedback
* **Adapt with Agility:** LEVEL 1: Adapts to change, constructively handles ambiguity/uncertainty, is flexible
* **Act with Determination:** LEVEL 1: Shows drive and motivation, able to deliver calmly in the face of adversity, confident
* **Engage and Partner:** LEVEL 1: Demonstrates compassion/understanding towards others, forms positive relationships
* **Enable Diversity and Inclusion:** LEVEL 1: Appreciate/respect differences, aware of unconscious bias, confronts discrimination

**Cross-Functional & Technical Competencies:**

* **Administration & Operations-Travel Policy and Procedures:** Knowledge of travel policy and procedures; ability to interpret travel policy, the Staff Rules, administrative circulars, and financial regulations and rules on travel-related matters.
* **Administration & Operations-Events management (including retreats, trainings & meetings):** Ability to manage events, including venue identification, accommodation, logistics, catering, transportation, and cash disbursements, etc.
* **Administration & Operations-UN Travel Documents:** Knowledge of the ERP regulatory frameworks and processes related to UN Travel and Expense Module Documents; ability to facilitate the issuance of UN travel documents for UNDP and provide help desk support to UNDP and other UN agencies; processing of visas, and ensuring oversight and endorsement
* **Administration & Operations-Off-boarding of personnel:** Knowledge of policy and procedures on administrative on- and off-boarding, including necessary clearance forms for returning office equipment, office ID, UNLP, cancellation of visa issued by host country, deletion of office email and Argus profile
* **Administration & Operations-Utilization of Corporate Credit Card:** Ability to ensure proper use of corporate credit card for official use; knowledge of relevant policy and procedures
* **Procurement -Procurement Management:** The ability to acquire goods, services or works from an outside external source
* **Business Direction & Strategy-Systems Thinking:** Ability to use objective problem analysis and judgement to understand how interrelated elements coexist within an overall process or system, and to consider how altering one element can impact on other parts of the system.

**Required Skills and Experience**

**Education:**

* Secondary Education is required with specialized secretarial training.

OR

A University degree (bachelor’s degree) in Business or Public Administration, Economics, Political or Social Sciences will be given due consideration, but is not a requirement.

**Experience:**

* Minimum 7 years (with secondary education) or 4 years (with bachelor´s degree) of progressively responsible administrative or programme experience is required at the national and/or international level.
* Experience using IT software packages (MS Word, Excel, etc.) and spreadsheet and database packages is required.
* Experience in handling web-based management and using ERP systems (i.e., Quantum) systems is required.
* Experience in logistics for workshops, travel arrangements, and office management is required.
* Experience conducting targeted research, analysis, and synthesis to support senior‑level decision‑making is desirable.
* Experience supporting senior leadership in a front office or similarly fast‑paced environment is desirable.
* Familiarity with the host country’s national administrative rules and processes, especially with regard to visas, travel, protocol, and other procedures that impact the Office of the Deputy Director, is an asset.
* Demonstrated experience in liaison, coordination, or maintaining professional relations with government officials, international organizations, NGOs, and/or external partners is highly desirable

**Language:**

* Fluency in English and Spanish is required.
* Working knowledge of other UN official languages is an asset.

**Equal opportunity**

As an equal opportunity employer, UNDP values diversity as an expression of the multiplicity of nations and cultures where we operate and, as such, we encourage qualified applicants from all backgrounds to apply for roles in the organization. Our employment decisions are based on merit and suitability for the role, without discrimination.

UNDP is also committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all personnel are empowered to contribute to our mission, are valued, can thrive, and benefit from career opportunities that are open to all.

Sexual harassment, exploitation, and abuse of authority

UNDP does not tolerate harassment, sexual harassment, exploitation, discrimination, and abuse of authority. All selected candidates, therefore, undergo relevant checks and are expected to adhere to the respective standards and principles.

**Probation**

For all new UNDP fixed-term appointments (FTA), including for staff members being transferred or seconded to UNDP under the Inter-Organization Agreement concerning Transfer, Secondment or Loan of Staff, on an appointment of more than one year, continuation of the appointment beyond the initial 12 months is contingent upon the successful completion of a probationary period.

**Right to select multiple candidates**

UNDP reserves the right to select one or more candidates from this vacancy announcement. We may also retain applications and consider candidates applying to this post for other similar positions with UNDP at the same grade level and with similar job description, experience and educational requirements.

* Proactive, flexible, and solutions-oriented, with a collaborative mindset.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, InDesign, Illustrator).
* Fluent English; Spanish is a plus.

### **Additional information**

**About us:**

Founded in Spain in 1846, LOEWE is the second-oldest luxury fashion house in the world. Since 2025, the House is under the creative direction of Jack McCollough and Lazaro Hernandez, guided by a rich artistic sensibility and an imaginative exploration of craft. This new chapter builds on core sensibilities of LOEWE: an intellectual and playful approach to fashion, the vibrant spirit of Spanish lifestyle, and unmatched leather expertise.

At LOEWE we are committed to a culture that welcomes all, regardless of gender, ethnicity, socioeconomic background and abilities, including people with disabilities of all types. Our aim is for everyone to feel valued, included, and empowered to contribute their best.

  

If you think this role is made for you, please send us your CV!

***LOEWE*** 
**MAISON**
-----------------------

Steeped in art and historical references, rooted in craft and tradition, Loewe has been reinventing leather craftmanship for almost 200 years. From its birth in Madrid in 1846 to its latest collection dedicated to the elegance of Chinese monochrome ceramics, the Maison’s journey has been defined by its core values: energy, creativity, and a thoroughly modern approach blended with traditional techniques.
  
Craft at Loewe is unconditionally bound up with art, an endless source of inspiration: from the British Arts & Craft masters to the whimsical world of Studio Ghibli, art is at the heart of every collection – and the House is committed to supporting the artists and creators informing its work.

Through a redesign of the brand identity, a modern articulation of its commitment to craft (with the launch of the Loewe Foundation Craft Prize, for instance), and a series of critically acclaimed and genre-defining Women’s and Men’s collections, Loewe has been further elevated as an influential and global cultural force.
  
At the intersection of fashion, craft and culture, Loewe’s ambition is to be radical and ever-evolving. By showing how the collections are made and honouring the complex artisanal processes behind them, it becomes possible to see their value and their merit. And by adding a cultural dimension – involving fine arts, film, dance, etc. –, Loewe has become a vibrant force for creativity and innovation, ensuring the brand’s durability for another 200 years… and more.

title: Power Systems Innovation Lead
description:
**Join Ferrovial: Where Innovation Meets Opportunity**
======================================================

Are you ready to elevate your career with a global leader in infrastructure solving complex problems and generating a positive outcome on people’s lives? At **Ferrovial** , we are not just a company; we are a community of innovators and trailblazers. Ferrovial is also leading the development of the New Terminal One at JFK International Airport. Ferrovial shares trade under the ticker symbol FER on two stock markets: Nasdaq in the U.S. (Nasdaq100 Index) and the Spanish Stock Exchanges (IBEX 35). Ferrovial is included in globally recognized sustainability indices such as the Dow Jones Best-in-Class Index. We operate in more than 15 countries and have a workforce of over 22,000 professionals worldwide. Ferrovial’s activity is carried out through our business units, including Highways, Airports, Construction, and Energy.

  

Our **Corporate** organization oversees business activities, providing strategic planning, communication, legal, finance and human resources services to the business units. As a member of our corporate organization, you will have a broad view of our company, further supporting your career development.

  

**Why Ferrovial?**

* **Global presence, local impact** : Be part of a company that is shaping the future of infrastructure worldwide, with challenging roles and projects that make a real difference.
* **Collaborative excellence** : Work alongside talented professionals in a collaborative environment where your ideas and contributions are valued.
* **Inclusive Culture:** Thrive in an innovative and respectful workplace that values every voice, celebrates what makes us unique and turns differences into innovation.
* **Career growth** : Benefit from global and cross-business unit mobility, with development processes designed to ensure your professional growth.
* **Compelling benefits and employee wellbeing** : Enjoy a comprehensive benefits package that rewards your hard work and dedication and take advantage of initiatives designed to support your physical and psychological health.
* **Productivity tools** : Utilize cutting-edge tools like Microsoft Copilot to enhance your productivity and efficiency.

  

**Job Description:**
====================

**About The Role**

  

*What if your next project didn't end up as a slide in a deck, but as technology actually running in an airport, a highway, a solar or wind power plant, or a data center?*

  

We are looking for a hands-on technical innovation leader who can work where energy strategy becomes real infrastructure: storage, grid connection, microgrids, electrification, critical power, resilience and renewable generation. You will assess emerging technologies with rigor, shape practical use cases and lead them through testing and validation, building the evidence the business needs to decide whether to invest, scale or stop.

  

You will join Corporate Innovation and work across Ferrovial’s businesses: Airports, Cintra, Ferrovial Energy and Digital Infrastructure. Success in the role requires strong engineering judgement, the ability to distinguish genuine breakthroughs from incremental improvements, and the credibility to engage technical and business stakeholders alike—translating complex challenges into well-structured pilots, clear investment decisions and scalable business opportunities.

  

This is a unique opportunity to influence the future of infrastructure by bringing cutting-edge technologies from concept to real-world deployment across a global leader in the sector. Experience in mission-critical environments, including data centers, is a plus, but not essential.

  

**Key Responsibilitie** s

* Lead energy, sustainability and resilience projects from technology identification through pilot, business case and scale-up recommendation
* Design and run proofs of concept with business units, OEMs, engineering partners, research centers and startups — setting your own KPIs and decision gates
* Bring real engineering judgment to grid connection, electrification, storage, microgrids, critical power, energy management and renewable generation infrastructure (solar and wind plants)
* Translate complex technical options and uncertainty into clear business cases for senior leadership
* Explore emerging low-carbon technologies — carbon capture and utilization, green molecules, hydrogen, e-fuels, biogenic routes — and assess their real potential
Optionally contribute to projects on low-carbon materials, embodied carbon and circularity  

  

**Qualification** s

* Hold an engineering or equivalent technical degree, ideally in electrical, energy, mechanical, industrial, civil or building-services engineering
* 8–12 years of experience in corporate innovation, technical office roles, or critical asset operations (energy, renewables, infrastructure, data centers)
* Real engineering judgment, not just strategic vision — you can defend a technical decision, not just frame one
* Relevant knowledge of energy and infrastructure systems—including grid connection, electrification, efficiency, storage, microgrids, controls, critical power or energy management—and how they interact with thermal, water and resilience requirements
* Familiarity with low-carbon materials, carbon technologies, embodied carbon, circularity and lifecycle value, with sound judgement on when to involve Ferrovial’s specialist teams
* Ability to build effective relationships across business units and with operators, OEMs, engineering partners, startups, universities and investors, acting as a connector rather than an operational owner
* Ability to move across asset classes: what you learn on a wind farm should be useful on an airport, a highway or a data center
* A drive to see things through: you don't stop at validation — you want to see the technology scale
* Comfort working with uncertainty and with very different stakeholders — from an OEM engineer to a business director

We are not looking for a purely strategic profile without hands-on engineering. Someone who prefers staying in day-to-day operations rather than pushing change forward. Someone who wants to specialize in a single asset class.

**Seize the challenge. Move the world together!** Innovative, creative, respectful, and diverse are some of the ways we describe ourselves. We are motivated by challenges, and we collaborate across our business units to move the world together. Your journey to a fulfilling career starts here!

Ferrovial is an equal opportunity employer. We treat all jobs applications equally, regardless of gender, color, race, ethnicity, religion, national origin, age, disability, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, covered veteran status or protected genetic information (each, a “Protected Class”), or any other protected class in accordance with applicable laws.

description:
**About the School - The British School of Barcelona (Castelldefels):**  
The British School of Barcelona (BSB) is a great school in a wonderful location. We are an HMC school and were judged by a recent BSO (British Schools Overseas) inspection to be outstanding in every area, including quality of education, safeguarding, pupil welfare and academic outcomes.
  
  
BSB is a large, very popular school for children aged 3 to 18. Our curriculum is based on the English National Curriculum, and we offer a wide range of GCSEs, A levels, BTEC and the International Baccalaureate Diploma (IB), all alongside a significant enrichment programme.
  
  
Approximately 2350 students from more than 74 nationalities attend the school and over 375 staff work at BSB. We are based in three locations, two just outside the city of Barcelona – in Castelldefels, where we have a Primary, Secondary and Pre-University campus, and in the cosmopolitan town of Sitges, where we have another Primary campus. There are two more campuses in Barcelona, located in the heart of the city and featuring a Foundation campus, BSB Esperanza, which offers EY and Year 1 (opened in September 2021), as well as a brand-new main campus, BSB Luca, which offers Primary, Secondary, and Pre-University education and opened in September 2023.
  
  
In September 2026 we opened another campus, initially for EYFS and Primary-aged students, north of Barcelona, in the Maresme area.
  
  
The growth of the school has been accompanied by significant investment over recent years, including the building of a state-of–the art Pre-University Centre (Nexus), a full-sized 4G rugby and football pitch, dedicated STEAM facilities and the new BSB City and Maresme campuses.
  
  
Barcelona is a wonderful place to live, combining an amazing city with beaches and mountains nearby. The quality of life is excellent with a mild climate and year-round sunshine.
  
  
The school now has an exciting opportunity for an experienced **Head of Secondary** to join our fantastic team.
  
  
**About Cognita:**  
Cognita is a global leader in independent education. Founded in 2004, we are a growing community of 90 schools in 20 countries - in Europe, North America, Latin America, Asia and the Middle East - serving more than 100,000 students. Each of our schools are proudly unique, however our collective purpose is to create an environment where everyone can, "Thrive in a rapidly evolving world".
  
  
At Cognita, we know every student is unique. We nurture their distinct personalities and strengths. We support them academically, socially, and emotionally, wherever they are in the world, wherever they’re starting from. And each and every one of our schools is unique too.
  
  
We protect what’s special about them, while offering them rich knowledge, opportunities, and best practices. And they get to be part of something bigger. We open their classrooms to the collective wisdom of over 90 schools in 20 countries, ensuring every child gets an education that’s, quite literally, world class.
  
  
It’s an individual approach that empowers every school, teacher and student to focus on what they do best and thrive.
  
  
**About the Role:**  
We are seeking an exceptional and inspirational leader to join our Senior Leadership Team as Head of Secondary, Castelldefels. This pivotal role is responsible for leading our Secondary School across both the Main Site and Nexus Sixth Form, ensuring outstanding academic achievement, student wellbeing, and personal development for all learners from Years 7 to 13. Working closely with the Executive Principal and senior colleagues, you will drive strategic school improvement, lead and develop high-performing teams, oversee the quality of teaching and learning, and ensure excellence in day-to-day operations. The successful candidate will champion a positive and inclusive school culture, strengthen student recruitment and retention, and play a key role in delivering a holistic educational experience that prepares students for success both in school and beyond.  
  
  
**Who We Are Looking For:**  
We are looking for an outstanding educational leader with significant senior leadership experience and a proven track record of driving academic excellence and sustained school improvement. The successful candidate will be a qualified teacher with a degree and recognised teaching qualification, combining strategic vision with a genuine commitment to student wellbeing, safeguarding, and holistic education. An inspiring and collaborative leader, you will be skilled at coaching, motivating, and developing others, while building strong relationships across the school community. You will possess excellent communication skills, up-to-date educational knowledge, and the creativity to navigate challenges with confidence and positivity. Above all, you will demonstrate integrity, resilience, a strong work ethic, and a passion for creating an environment where both students and staff can thrive.
  
  
**Benefits at Cognita:**  
What we can offer you:
  

* A fantastic team of staff who are committed, supportive and collaborative.
* The wider support of BSB, including access to high level CPD and future career opportunities.
* The support of the Cognita network, including cross-school learning partnerships.

  
All positions are offered with attractive packages including competitive salaries, places for staff children in BSB, and other local benefits.

Complete this application before the closing date.

**First stage interviews:** Monday 5th November 2026 - Tuesday 13th November 2026
  
**Final stage interviews:** Friday 23rd November 2026

* Colaborar con el equipo de la tienda para implementar y mantener una cultura NIKE positiva.

* Dar ejemplo de cómo ofrecer nuestro servicio en la sala de ventas y animar la experiencia de los clientes.
