title: Video Producer
description:
**About Frontiers**

At Frontiers, our purpose is simple yet ambitious: to make science open. We believe open science empowers the global scientific community to accelerate discovery and develop the solutions needed for healthy lives on a healthy planet.

We are one of the world’s largest and most influential open-access research publishers. Every article we publish is peer-reviewed and quality-certified, ensuring research is accessible to everyone, everywhere. To date, Frontiers research has been viewed over 4 billion times, demonstrating the real-world impact of science without barriers.

Joining Frontiers means being part of a global, mission-driven organization at the intersection of science, technology, and innovation — working alongside passionate colleagues who care deeply about advancing knowledge for the benefit of society. To learn more about our impact and culture, please watch this video.

**About the role**

We're looking for a **Video Producer** to join our Visual Design team and work closely with the Senior Video Producer to expand and accelerate Frontiers' video storytelling. In this role, you'll take ownership of video productions from planning and filming through to post-production, creating interviews, talking-head content, b-roll, and studio shoots for company-wide communications and campaigns.

As a second videographer, you'll have the opportunity to lead independent shoots while also supporting larger productions led by the Senior Video Producer. You'll combine strong technical video skills with excellent organization, ensuring that shoots run smoothly, footage meets Frontiers' creative and technical standards, and media assets are efficiently managed throughout the production process.

You'll work closely with colleagues across Communications and Visual Design, as well as researchers, authors, employees, external contributors, and production partners. If you enjoy working both behind the camera and behind the scenes, solving problems on the go, and creating high-quality visual content in a fast-paced environment, you'll thrive in this role.

You'll also contribute to improving video production workflows by using technology, AI-powered tools, and consistent production practices to streamline scheduling, media management, transcription, subtitling, and post-production.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Coordinate video shoots end-to-end, including scheduling interviews, talking-head sessions, b-roll, and studio productions with internal and external stakeholders.
* Prepare and distribute call sheets, coordinate shoot logistics, and ensure crews and on-camera participants have clear information about locations, timings, requirements, and expectations.
* Scout and book filming locations, studios, and meeting spaces, coordinating travel arrangements and equipment transportation for shoots outside Lausanne.
* Prepare, test, organize, and maintain camera, lighting, audio, and studio equipment, ensuring all production kits are ready for each assignment.
* Independently film interviews, talking-heads, b-roll, and studio content, operating professional camera, lighting, and audio equipment to a consistently high standard.
* Work as a second camera operator and provide technical support on larger and multi-camera productions led by the Senior Video Producer.
* Welcome and brief on-camera participants, helping guests feel comfortable and confident throughout the filming process while ensuring required release forms and consent documentation are completed.
* Ingest, back up, organize, and archive raw footage following established folder structures, file-naming conventions, and media management practices.
* Support post-production by cutting and editing footage, applying colour grading and established brand guidelines, creating and using motion graphics, and preparing subtitles and AI-assisted transcriptions.
* Work with Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, and other relevant production tools to support high-quality video delivery.
* Collaborate with internal teams and external production partners, including freelance crew, studios, equipment suppliers, editors, and post-production specialists.
* Identify and resolve technical, logistical, and production challenges independently while maintaining quality, schedules, and production standards.
* Contribute to improving video production workflows, playbooks, and best practices, helping the team increase production capacity and deliver content efficiently.

  
**Requirements**  

* 2–3 years of hands-on experience in video production, videography, or a similar role, with experience taking video projects from production planning and filming through to post-production.
* Strong technical video production skills, including professional camera operation, lighting, and audio recording, with the ability to independently deliver high-quality footage.
* A strong portfolio or showreel demonstrating relevant camera, lighting, sound, editing, and/or studio production experience.
* Proficiency in video editing and post-production tools, particularly Adobe Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve, with experience in editing, colour grading, and Adobe After Effects/motion graphics.
* Strong production coordination and organizational skills, with experience managing shoot schedules, call sheets, locations, equipment, travel, production documentation, and digital media organization, including footage ingestion, file naming, folder structures, and backups.
* Experience with Microsoft 365 and project collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence, or similar platforms.
* Fluency in English, with strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively with internal teams, external production partners, and on-camera participants.
* A proactive and solutions-oriented approach, with the ability to troubleshoot technical and logistical challenges calmly and independently while maintaining production and brand standards.
* Familiarity with AI-powered tools for transcription, subtitling, or production workflows is an advantage.
* Willingness and ability to travel for filming assignments and flexibility to accommodate changing production schedules.
* A bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in Media Production, Film, Communications, or a related field is preferred, although relevant practical experience will also be considered.
* Experience in corporate communications, science communication, or event filming is an advantage.

  
**Benefits**  

* We prioritise office presence and emphasise in-person collaboration, but also offer appropriate adjustments where needed, in line with company policy
* Extra wellbeing days on top of your annual leave allowance
* Up to 3 paid volunteering days each year
* 24/7 confidential Employee Assistance Programme (wellbeing, mental health, legal & financial support)
* Learning & development support via the Frontiers Learning Hub

***Equal opportunity statement***

***Frontiers actively embraces diversity and is a safe and welcoming workplace. Recruitment is free from discrimination – including based on race, national or ethnic origin, age, religion, disability, sex, gender identity or sexual orientation. With employees from more than 50 different nations, our diversity creates vibrant teams and constantly challenges us to appreciate multiple perspectives.***

title: Sr. Director, Human Resources Business Partner
description:
**We Are Teva**
---------------

We’re Teva, a leading innovative biopharmaceutical company, enabled by a world-class generics business. Whether it’s innovating in the fields of neuroscience and immunology or delivering high-quality medicine worldwide, we’re dedicated to addressing patients’ needs now and in the future. Here, you will be part of a high-performing, inclusive culture that values fresh thinking and collaboration. You'll have the room to grow, the flexibility to balance life with work, and the opportunity to better health worldwide, together.

**Our Team, Your Impact**
-------------------------

Teva is seeking an experienced and forward-thinking Senior Director, Human Resources Business Partner (HRBP) to support our Global Quality and Global Strategy organizations.

This role serves as a strategic advisor to the Global Head of Quality and the Head of Strategy, partnering with executive leadership teams to shape and execute people strategies that enable business performance, organizational effectiveness, and long-term growth.

The HRBP will play a critical role in enabling Quality transformation, strengthening compliance and inspection readiness capabilities, building a pipeline of technical and scientific talent, and supporting strategic initiatives that accelerate Teva's Pivot to Growth agenda.

As Teva continues its Pivot to Growth journey, Quality and Strategy play critical roles in ensuring our ability to deliver trusted medicines, strengthen our global network, drive transformation, and accelerate enterprise value creation. This position sits at the heart of those efforts, translating business priorities into workforce, talent, leadership, culture, and organizational solutions.

The successful candidate will bring strong business acumen, executive presence, and the ability to influence at the highest levels while driving practical execution across a complex global environment.

**How You’ll Spend Your Day**
-----------------------------

Strategic Business Partnership:

Serve as a trusted advisor and thought partner to senior executives within Global Quality and Global Strategy.  
Align people priorities with business objectives, ensuring talent, organization, and workforce decisions support enterprise goals.  
Provide insight and challenge to leaders on organizational health, leadership effectiveness, capability needs, and workforce risks.  
Participate as a member of leadership teams, influencing business decisions through a people lens.

Organization Design & Transformation:

Act as the people lead for major transformation initiatives, ensuring leadership alignment, change readiness, communication effectiveness, and sustainable adoption.  
Lead organizational design initiatives that improve effectiveness, agility, accountability, and execution.  
Partner with leaders on transformation initiatives, operating model evolution, restructuring, and change programs.  
Anticipate organizational capability needs and develop strategies to build future-ready teams.  
Support enterprise priorities including growth initiatives, business transformation, productivity efforts, and M&A-related activities.

Talent, Succession & Leadership:

Enable leaders to successfully navigate ambiguity, organizational change, and transformation.  
Foster a positive employee experience that supports retention and performance.

Drive retention of critical talent through targeted talent interventions, career development, leadership effectiveness, and workforce planning strategies.  
Provide guidance on complex employee relations matters and organizational risk.  
Partner with Legal, Compliance, Labor Relations, and HR colleagues to ensure effective and compliant people practices.  
Support organizational decision-making while maintaining appropriate governance and risk management.

Data & Insights:

Leverage external talent market intelligence and competitive benchmarking to advise leaders on talent availability, organizational capability, workforce location strategy, and build versus buy decisions.  
Use data-driven insights to guide decision-making and improve business outcomes.  
Establish meaningful measures to assess organizational effectiveness, talent health, leadership strength, and workforce performance.

**Your Skills and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree required; Master's degree preferred.
* 12+ years of progressive HR experience, including significant experience as an HR Business Partner to senior executives.
* Experience supporting Quality, Regulatory, Compliance, Manufacturing, Strategy, Consulting, Corporate Development, or Transformation organizations preferred.
* Experience supporting global functional organizations in complex, matrixed environments.

**How We’ll Take Care of You**

title: Education Centre Director
description:
About Boundless Life

Boundless Life is redefining the way families live, work, and learn by empowering them to embrace a nomadic lifestyle that fosters deeper connections and personal growth. We provide family-friendly accommodations, an innovative education system that travels with you, and vibrant communities of like-minded individuals.

Since our founding in 2021, we’ve rapidly expanded to eight locations across Europe, Asia, and Latin America, bringing together over 200 team members from diverse backgrounds. Our growth reflects our commitment to transforming the experience economy and making a meaningful impact on how families integrate work, education, and exploration into their lives.

At Boundless Life, we believe in the power of community and the importance of a holistic approach to education. Our programs are designed to inspire curiosity, build resilience, and nurture a global perspective. We combine a project-based, place-based learning with the freedom to live and learn anywhere, for families who want more than a traditional school can offer. Our Education Centres are the heart of everything we do.

Role Overview

Estepona is one of our most established and beloved locations — a flagship of what the Boundless model is. The Education Centre Director who joins here will inherit something that is already working and will be responsible for taking it further.

This is a role for a leader who can come into an existing team, earn trust quickly, raise the bar through coaching and consistency, and build on strong foundations without disrupting what is already good. You are not here to reinvent. You are here to lead, deepen, and improve.

As Education Centre Director, you are the educational leader of the location. You are responsible for how the learning happens and how it is brought to life by your team. You know your educators deeply, coach them continuously, hold high standards, and ensure every cohort delivers on the Boundless promise.You will report directly to the General Manager, with a dotted reporting line to the Head of Education Excellence.

This structure allows you to focus primarily on pedagogical leadership, instructional coaching, and developing your educator team, while the General Manager owns the broader location operations. The role demands someone who is energised by that scale, not overwhelmed by it.

What You'll Do

*Educator Leadership and Team Development*

* Lead, coach, and manage an established team of educators through structured 1:1s, regular classroom observations, and direct, specific feedback
* Set clear expectations for performance and conduct from day one, address gaps independently, and build individual development plans for every member of the team
* Hold a high bar consistently — this means celebrating what is working and naming what is not, without waiting for a formal review cycle
* Build and maintain a team culture that is engaged and resilient through an intense cohort calendar and a demanding daily schedule
* Contribute to hiring decisions alongside the Head of Education Excellence when the team expands or changes

*Curriculum Execution and Educational Quality*

* Ensure the Boundless curriculum is implemented consistently and with fidelity to our global methodology and standards — you do not design the curriculum, you make sure it comes to life as intended
* Ensure project-based and place-based learning happen on the ground, incorporating the extraordinary context of the location meaningfully and in alignment with global curriculum standards
* Observe classes regularly and give educators specific, actionable feedback that leads to real change
* Surface implementation challenges to the global education team and bring solutions alongside them

*Family Relationships*

* Serve as a trusted, visible presence for families — including those who are returning to Boundless and have high expectations of the experience
* Handle family concerns and escalations independently and with confidence, without unnecessary escalation to global leadership
* Contribute to a strong admissions and intake experience that sets every cohort up well

*Running the Education Centre*

* Lead the essential day-to-day running of the Education Centre in close partnership with the General Manager and central teams.
* Own educator administration, family communication, safeguarding, and the smooth delivery of ECAs and field trips.
* Support local partners, systems and practical centre needs where required, while keeping educational leadership and people development as the priority.
* You will be involved in the Boundless Summer Camp cohorts, maintaining the same standards of team leadership and family experience.

Role Requirements

* You have meaningful leadership experience and have directly supervised, coached and developed a team of 8 - 10+ staff. Ideally, you will have led a microschool or similarly hands-on learning environment that requires a holistic view of people, pedagogy, families and day-to-day delivery.
* Experience in excellent curriculum execution.
* You can observe a learning environment, see clearly what is and is not working, and give an educator specific and honest feedback. You understand PBL and place-based learning as practices, not just frameworks.
* Proven experience in delivering high quality customer experiences. *You are exceptional with families.* The location has returning families who love this community. You can hold difficult conversations, manage high expectations, and maintain trust even when something has gone wrong.

You'll Also Be Valued For

* You bring an entrepreneurial spirit: resourceful, proactive and comfortable building solutions in a fast-moving environment without waiting for a complete playbook.
* You are aligned with non-traditional education and understand project-based and experiential learning in practice, not only in theory.
* *You are a people developer.* You have managed a team, conducted observations and given specific feedback, had hard performance conversations independently, and genuinely made the people around you better. Coaching your team is not a task on your list — it is the work.
* *You earn trust in established environments.* You do not arrive and immediately try to change everything. You listen first, build credibility, and lead from within the culture — while still being willing to raise the bar and name what needs to improve.
* *You are energised by scale and intensity.* Sixty to seventy students, an international team, a packed cohort calendar, and a community of families who are living and working alongside each other. This is the environment you thrive in.
* *Spanish language skills or a connection to Spain are a genuine asset for this role.*

What Success Looks Like

In three months: you have earned the trust of the team, completed a full round of classroom observations, every educator is clear on what is expected of them, and families feel the leadership of the EC is strong and present.

In the long term, success in this role is measured against three things:

* 85% or more of families report satisfaction with their overall Boundless Education experience, measured through our termly NPS and satisfaction survey
* 85% or more of educators and facilitators in the centre meet or exceed their role-specific impact metrics
* Staff turnover is low and staff engagement is high, with 80% or more of the team reporting high engagement in our termly pulse survey

Who You'll Work With

You report to the location General Manager, who owns location operations, with a dotted reporting line to the Head of Education Excellence, who leads educational quality and development across all Boundless locations globally.

Why Join Us

Estepona is one of Boundless Life's flagship locations: with its all year round appeal, it has a strong and returning family community, and a team that cares deeply about the work. You will have real responsibility, real autonomy, a platform that is already performing well and the chance to make it even better.

Beyond the work itself, joining Boundless means being part of a mission-driven team that genuinely believes education can be done differently. You will be part of a model that does not exist at scale anywhere else in the world — place-based, project-driven, and designed for families who have chosen a different kind of life. That is not a small thing to be part of.

You will also benefit from:

* A discount on Boundless Education tuition for your own children
* A global community of educators, families, and team members who care deeply about what they are building
* Real ownership of your location and your team's development
* The chance to grow as the organisation grows — this role has significant room to evolve

What to Expect Next1. Interview with our recruiter — initial alignment on experience, motivation and role non-negotiables (30 min)

2. Personality assessment

3. Panel interview with the COO & the Head of Education Excellence (60 min)

4. On-site evaluation for established locations where applicable.

5. References — structured conversations with people who have seen you manage and lead

*The process might change slightly as we go along, we will keep you posted at all times.*

Want to Know More? boundless.life

title: AI Project Manager
description:
At Sanoma Learning, we all share a deep-rooted passion for education and are committed to support teachers to help all students to reach their potential, so they can be at their best in class. We are proud of the impact we make together across Europe, local as well as international. As our teams and the scope of our impact grows, so do the opportunities for us to learn from each other – across country borders and areas of expertise. With over 3.000 colleagues, we work on seamlessly integrated print, digital and blended learning solutions to help teachers and schools develop the talents of every child. Our people are passionate and committed and always willing to go the extra mile for students, teachers, schools, our shareholders and each other.

We believe that Data and AI can uncover multiple opportunities for education, including both internal efficiencies and new product opportunities; currently AI is a priority theme for Sanoma Learning.

**AI Project Manager**

The AI Project Manager is part of the AI Enablement team – the small central team that makes AI work at Sanoma Learning possible: setting direction, building the foundations, and connecting the many parties involved. The team works as a flexible unit: members take ownership of the initiatives that matter most at a given moment, and capacity is redirected as priorities shift.

Within that team, this role carries a clear centre of gravity: it is the connection point between AI at Sanoma Learning and the outside world, and between the AI team and the functions that own communication and strategy. The role does not replace those functions. It makes sure they have the AI substance, the right experts and the right coordination to do their work well – and it turns what the AI teams do into something that colleagues, customers, partners and the wider education community can understand and engage with.

Reporting to the Senior Director, Head of Data and AI, the AI Project Manager works across operating companies and central functions – Communications, Strategy, M&A, Legal and the product and experimentation teams – and represents the AI agenda in those forums. This role also assumes matrix reporting into the Competence Lead of Project Management.

**Key Responsibilities**

**AI communication – internal and external**

Acting as the AI team’s counterpart to the Communications function: bringing the content, the context and the experts, and coordinating the AI side of delivery.

* **Own the editorial cycle of the AI update newsletter** – collect input from AI initiatives and opcos, shape the story, manage the calendar and the review loop with Communications.

* **Run the AI webinar and event series** – programme, speakers, preparation of presenters, logistics with the relevant functions, and follow-up.

* **Curate and maintain the AI Hub** – keep it current and usable, agree the content structure with contributing teams, and chase the contributions that make it worth visiting.

* **Coordinate AI content for the external website and corporate channels** – gather and quality-assure input from the AI teams, propose what should be told publicly, and work with Communications, who own publication.

* **Sync a shared communication calendar for AI with communications** – so that announcements, launches, webinars and external moments are sequenced rather than colliding.

**Thought leadership and external presence**

Working with the Strategy function, which owns Sanoma Learning’s thought leadership agenda, to ensure AI is represented with credible substance.

* **Build and manage a pipeline of external speaking opportunities** – identify the conferences and forums worth being at, manage submissions and deadlines, and match the right internal speaker to each.

* **Prepare speakers and material** – coordinate narrative, evidence and rehearsal so that colleagues representing Sanoma Learning externally are well equipped.

* **Drive the production of white papers and publications on AI in education** – coordinate authors, source the evidence from our own initiatives, and run the process to publication with Strategy and Communications.

* **Manage relationships with research institutions and academic partners** – keep the contacts warm, track joint work, and identify where research collaboration strengthens our position.

* **Track the external conversation on AI in education** – what peers, policymakers and researchers are saying – and feed that back into the AI agenda.

**AI partnership and M&A funnel**

Owning the front end of the AI partnership pipeline, feeding the teams that own the decisions and the transactions.

* **Build and maintain the funnel of AI-related partnership and acquisition opportunities** – sourcing, structured overview, status and next steps.

* **Run first-pass screening of candidates** – what they do, how it relates to our AI direction, what a fit would look like – and prepare the material that lets leadership decide what to pursue.

* **Organise the AI-side assessment** – pull in the technical, product, privacy and compliance expertise needed to evaluate an opportunity properly, and consolidate the view.

* **Coordinate with Strategy and M&A** , and with the business owners who would take on the partnership.

* **Maintain the relationship layer with active AI partners and vendors** – cadence, follow-up and internal visibility of what each partnership is delivering.

**Leading AI initiatives and projects**

As a member of a small, flexible team, taking direct ownership of initiatives where capacity and momentum are needed.

* **Lead assigned AI initiatives and projects end to end** – scope, plan, stakeholders, delivery and closure – across the full breadth of the AI agenda.

* **Step into initiatives that need to move** – taking over, unblocking or accelerating work as priorities shift, including topics outside the communication and partnership scope.

* **Bring structure to ambiguous work** – turn broad intentions into a plan with owners, milestones and a decision path.

* **Prepare and facilitate the forums that move decisions forward** – working sessions, steering updates and executive material.

* **Represent the AI Enablement team in cross-functional programmes** where AI is one of several contributing tracks.

**How this role works with others**

Communication and thought leadership are owned by dedicated functions at Sanoma Learning, and this role does not duplicate them. Its value lies in being the AI team’s connection into those functions: supplying substance and expertise, coordinating the AI-side contributors, keeping the AI agenda sequenced and visible, and making sure opportunities are not lost because no one on the AI side was joining the dots. The success measure is that Communications and Strategy are consistently well served by AI – not that AI does their work.

  

**A successful candidate will have the following:**

**Education**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Communications, Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field.

* Project management certifications (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2, Agile/Scrum) are a strong advantage.

Additional coursework or certification in AI/ML, communications, or digital transformation is a plus.  



**Experience**

* 4+ years of professional experience in project, programme or initiative management in a digital, technology or innovation context, with at least 2 years connected to AI, data or digital transformation topics.

* Demonstrated experience in corporate or B2B communication – for example newsletters, webinars, content platforms, website content or campaign coordination – working with or within a communications function.

* Experience preparing executive-level and external-facing material, and supporting senior colleagues in representing the organisation publicly.

* Exposure to partnership management, vendor evaluation, corporate development or M&A support activities.

* Experience working across multiple stakeholders and business units, preferably in multi-country or federated environments.

* Familiarity with AI concepts and the current AI landscape, sufficient to translate technical work into language a business or public audience understands.

* Hands-on experience with collaboration and project management tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence, SharePoint) and with content or intranet platforms.

Experience in education, publishing or EdTech, or with research institutions, is a plus.  



**Skills**

* Excellent written communication in English – able to turn technical and strategic material into clear, engaging content for different audiences.

* Strong stakeholder management, comfortable working as a connector between a specialist team and central functions without owning either side.

* Solid project management skills, able to run several parallel tracks with clarity on ownership, deadlines and status.

* Sound understanding of AI and data concepts, and the curiosity to keep that understanding current.

* Ability to structure ambiguous problems, facilitate alignment and drive decisions across teams.

* Strong sense for what is worth telling externally, and the judgement to know what is not.

* Comfortable with documentation, editorial process and governance that keep recurring communication running reliably.

Collaborative and proactive mindset, with an ability to connect the dots across organisational silos.  



**Personal Attributes**

* Proactive and positive “can-do” attitude, demonstrating initiative and resilience.

* Comfortable operating without formal authority, building influence through reliability and usefulness to others.

* Strong organisational skills, adept at managing multiple tasks simultaneously.

* Flexible and pragmatic – willing to pick up what the team needs at a given moment.

* Data-driven decision-making approach.

* Self-motivated, consistently seeking opportunities for improvement and innovation.

Passionate about the opportunities in the Data and AI space, and about education.  



**About Sanoma Learning**

How do you prepare students for the world, engage their curiosity and inspire them to grow? That is the main question of teachers all around the world. At Sanoma Learning, it has always been our mission to help to find and develop best-in-class answers to this question. If you join us, it means that you embark on an exciting journey to help shape the future of learning for primary, secondary and vocational education. We believe that your journey is our success as a company.
  
  
Sanoma Learning is a leading K12 European learning company, operating in 12 countries. Our learning products and services enable and support teachers and schools to develop the talents of every child to reach their potential. By offering printed and digital learning content, as well as digital learning and teaching platforms for primary, secondary and vocational education, we want to grow our positive impact on learning across Europe. With over 3000 employees, we help shape the future of education for 25+ million of students.
  
  
So, are you ready to start your journey to help shape the future of learning and help teachers to support all students to reach their potential?

description:
Global Security Architect
  
Purpose of the role
  
Infront builds and operates financial technology products for banks and asset managers across thirteen countries, on a technology estate that has grown by acquisition. Today, security is built in product by product: encryption, authentication, secrets handling and logging are solved differently in each, by whoever built it. The Global Security Architect owns how security is designed into Infronts products, replacing that patchwork with shared patterns the teams can adopt and reuse.
  
The role sits in engineering and reports to the Head of Information Security for mandate and standards. It spends its days with the teams that build the products, in the architecture forum, in design reviews, and alongside the Security Champions it coordinates. Success means new products and material changes are secure by design from the start.
  
Accountabilities
  
**Own the reference security patterns for Infronts products:** authentication and authorisation, encryption and key handling, secrets management, logging and telemetry, and secure service-to-service communication. Publish them, keep them current, and see them adopted.
  
Own the Secure Development Standard and the security gates in the build and deployment pipeline, including continuous scanning that covers components embedded in Infronts own software, not only what is installed on hosts.
  
Lead threat modelling and security design review for new products and material changes, proportionate to risk, and record the outcome so it is auditable.
  
Be the technical lead for identity architecture across the estate: the enterprise identity provider, the product authentication platform and the trading authorisation layer, including succession planning for platforms that today depend on a single person.
  
Own security architecture for the cloud estate, across multiple AWS accounts and Azure tenants, and for the boundary between shared and isolated platform instances.
  
Coordinate the Security Champions, one named engineer per product area, as a dotted-line community: set their agenda, give them patterns to apply, and use them to reach every team.
  
Represent security in the architecture forum and in the Cyber Resilience Act secure-by-design work, and translate regulatory expectations into engineering decisions.
  
Provide the application-layer input to vulnerability prioritisation and penetration test scoping, so that testing concentrates on the shared components most products depend on.
  
Experience and skills, essential
  
  
Substantial experience designing security into software products, in a company that builds and operates its own platforms, ideally financial technology or another regulated SaaS environment.
  
**Hands-on depth in application security and secure development:** threat modelling, OWASP-aligned secure coding, SAST, SCA and secrets scanning in CI/CD, and what it takes to get engineers to adopt them.
  
Cloud security architecture across AWS and Azure, including multi-account governance, container platforms and infrastructure as code.
  
**Identity and access architecture:** enterprise identity providers, single sign-on, OAuth and OIDC, and product-level authentication platforms of the Keycloak type.
  
**Cryptography applied in practice:** what to use, where, and how to manage keys and certificates, rather than theory.
  
The credibility to influence engineers without line authority, and the judgement to know when a pattern must be mandatory and when it can be guidance.
  
Fluent English is a must.
  
  
OWASP, SAST, SCA, CI/CD,Cloud security, AWS, Azure, OAuth, OIDC

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
**Who we are**

At Frontiers, our purpose is simple yet ambitious: to make science open. We believe open science empowers the global scientific community to accelerate discovery and develop the solutions needed for healthy lives on a healthy planet.

We are one of the world’s largest and most influential open-access research publishers. Every article we publish is peer-reviewed and quality-certified, ensuring research is accessible to everyone, everywhere. To date, Frontiers research has been viewed over 4 billion times, demonstrating the real-world impact of science without barriers

Joining Frontiers means being part of a global, mission-driven organisation at the intersection of science, technology, and innovation — working alongside passionate colleagues who care deeply about advancing knowledge for the benefit of society.

To learn more about our impact and culture, please watch this video:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jLJ7ZO3wOW4

**About the Role**:

Frontiers is seeking a Senior Product Manager to own a defined product, platform, or workflow area within our publishing ecosystem. The exact domain — submission, peer review, production, partnerships, AI, or another area — will be confirmed at the offer stage based on where the business need and the candidate's strengths best align. This description sets the bar and shape of the role common to all our Senior PM positions, so that candidates can be assessed once and matched to the right opening.

You will own your product end to end: understanding user and business needs, defining the roadmap, working with engineering, design and operational stakeholders to ship it, and being accountable for the outcomes it produces. You will operate within Frontiers' one-platform strategy — favouring shared, scalable workflows over bespoke, one-off solutions — regardless of which domain you land in.

You will not wait for a perfect brief. You will spot the problem, make a call with the data you have, and go find the rest. We want someone who treats a blocker as a puzzle to solve, not a reason to pause.

Key Responsibilities

* Roadmap ownership: Define and drive the roadmap for your product area, balancing user needs, business priorities, and platform constraints into a clear, sequenced plan.
* Requirements discipline: Gather, document, and reconcile requirements from multiple stakeholders — internal teams, partners, or end users — into a coherent, scalable product definition rather than a pile of one-off requests.
* Cross-team delivery: Work with and through engineering, design, and other product teams to ship your roadmap, tracking dependencies and resolving conflicts without necessarily having direct authority over every team involved.
* User- and stakeholder-facing discovery: Engage directly with the people who use or depend on your product — authors, editors, reviewers, partners, or internal teams — to uncover real underlying needs and validate that proposed solutions solve them.
* Creative, pragmatic solutioning: Where requirements conflict with simplicity or scale, propose solutions — configuration over customisation, shared workflows over bespoke branches — that satisfy the intent without fragmenting the platform.
* Evidence-led decisions: Steer your roadmap with data: define the metrics that matter for your area, track them, and show what you measured, what you changed, and what moved. Be ready to change course when the data says you were wrong.
* Quality and risk ownership: Hold the bar for whatever your product area delivers, and manage risk transparently when timelines, dependencies, or stakeholder expectations are under pressure. Define acceptance criteria, test with real users before release, and own post-launch quality.
* Product vision: Set a clear vision for your product area and connect it to Frontiers' one-platform strategy, so every roadmap choice traces back to a purpose.
* Business outcome ownership: Build and defend the business case for your product. Set the investment, expected return and payback, and answer for whether it was worth it.
* Team leadership: Lead your squad of engineers, designers and analysts toward shared goals. Coach, set direction and raise the bar, even without formal reporting lines.
* Managing up: Give the Head of Product and senior leadership regular, candid updates on progress, risks and trade-offs. Bring a recommendation with each decision you need.
* AI and automation: Find where AI agents and automation can remove manual work or improve outcomes in your area. Then scope, ship and measure them.
* Launch and adoption: Take your product from idea through launch to adoption. Plan rollout, train users, then track usage and iterate until the outcome moves.
* Resourceful problem-solving: When data, access or alignment is missing, say what you need, from whom and how you will get it. Keep moving in the meantime.

  
**Requirements**  

* Clarity of thought: You think critically and bring structure and clear rationale to ambiguous, cross-domain problems.
* Experience: 5+ years in Product Management, ideally including ownership of a multi-stakeholder, operations-heavy, or platform-level product.
* Requirements practitioner: Proven ability to gather, document, and unify requirements from multiple demanding stakeholders into a coherent product definition.
* Technical literacy: Comfortable discussing workflows, data, and system design with engineers, and reading the evidence behind a problem, without needing to be a domain specialist on day one.
* User-centric design: A track record of turning a complex process into an experience that different types of users can complete with confidence.
* Cross-team influence: Experience delivering through other teams and aligning multiple roadmaps toward a shared outcome, including without direct authority over every team involved.
* Outcomes: You can point to what you measured, what you changed, and what moved as a result of your product work.
* Ownership and agency: You take responsibility without being asked. When you hit an obstacle, you ask "how do I get this done?" and propose a path. You treat mistakes as information and move on quickly.
* Domain exposure: Background in academic publishing, SaaS platforms, multi-tenant B2B products, or AI/ML products is a plus, but strong learning agility can substitute for direct domain experience.

  
**Benefits**  

* We prioritise office presence and emphasise in-person collaboration, but also offer appropriate adjustments where needed, in line with company policy
* Extra wellbeing days on top of your annual leave allowance
* Up to 3 paid volunteering days each year
* 24/7 confidential Employee Assistance Programme (wellbeing, mental health, legal & financial support)
* Learning & development support via the Frontiers Learning Hub
* Competitive local benefits country dependent (e.g. healthcare and pension/retirement provision)

*Frontiers actively embraces diversity and is a safe and welcoming workplace. Recruitment is free from discrimination – including based on race, national or ethnic origin, age, religion, disability, sex, gender identity or sexual orientation. With employees from more than 50 different nations, our diversity creates vibrant teams and constantly challenges us to appreciate multiple perspectives.*

**Commercial Development**

* Define and execute the company’s commercial and go-to-market strategy.
* Develop new revenue streams and identify scalable business opportunities.
* Build and strengthen relationships with customers, strategic accounts and commercial partners.
* Develop a scalable business model capable of supporting international growth.
* Establish the foundations for expansion into new markets.
* Build a strong, performance-driven commercial culture across the organisation.

**Financial Management & Fundraising**

* Take overall responsibility for financial performance, budgeting, forecasting and cash management.
* Establish robust financial reporting and management-control processes.
* Prepare and regularly update the company’s business plan and financial projections.
* Lead fundraising initiatives in collaboration with founders and shareholders.
* Build credible relationships with investors, financial partners and other stakeholders.
* Prepare the company for future financing rounds and investor due diligence.
* Ensure capital is allocated efficiently and in line with strategic priorities.

**Technology & Innovation**

* Work closely with technology leadership to define the product and technology roadmap.
* Translate commercial and strategic requirements into clear technology priorities.
* Maintain a strong understanding of developments in artificial intelligence, digital platforms and emerging technologies.
* Identify technologies capable of improving scalability, efficiency and customer experience.
* Ensure technology investments support the company’s long-term competitive positioning.
* Encourage innovation while maintaining clear commercial and operational objectives.

**Building the Organisation**

* Build and lead a high-performing, multidisciplinary organisation.
* Recruit key executives, managers and specialist talent as the company develops.
* Define clear roles, responsibilities and performance expectations.
* Establish effective management processes and appropriate corporate governance.
* Develop a culture combining entrepreneurial agility with professional execution.
* Create an organisation capable of scaling internationally without unnecessary bureaucracy.

**Strategic Partnerships**

* Develop senior-level relationships across the digital media, technology, creative and cultural ecosystems.
* Identify and negotiate strategic commercial and technology partnerships.
* Explore opportunities for distribution, content, licensing and international collaboration.
* Build relationships capable of accelerating market access and business development.
* Represent the company with strategic partners and key industry stakeholders.

**What We Are Looking For**

The ideal candidate should have the ability to transform an ambitious strategic vision into a scalable international business :

* Significant experience as a **CEO, Managing Director, General Manager, Founder, senior COO** or comparable executive leader.
* Ideally **7+ years of senior management or leadership experience**.
* Demonstrated responsibility for business strategy, financial performance and operational execution.
* Experience developing and implementing business plans and growth strategies.
* Strong understanding of budgeting, forecasting, cash management and financial reporting.
* Experience leading multidisciplinary teams and building organisations through periods of growth.
* Demonstrated commercial and business-development capabilities.
* Experience working with founders, shareholders, boards and/or investors.
* Exposure to fundraising, financing rounds or investor relations would be particularly valuable.
* Experience with digital platforms, technology-enabled businesses or international expansion.
* Professional fluency in **French and English**; additional languages would be an advantage.

Relevant industry backgrounds may include **digital media, technology, AI, SaaS, marketplaces, creative industries, photography, digital commerce, licensing, fintech or platform businesses**.

Experience in the visual-content or stock-image industry would be valuable, but it is **not a prerequisite**.

The position is based in Lisbon, Portugal, with an international scope. The CEO will work with shareholders, partners and stakeholders across different markets and should be comfortable with international travel when required.

title: Director, Brand Marketing
description:
Beyond Meat, Inc., otherwise known as Beyond The Plant Protein Company™, is a plant protein company offering a portfolio of plant-based products made from simple ingredients without GMOs, no added hormones or antibiotics, and 0mg of cholesterol per serving. Founded in 2009, Beyond Meat’s core products are designed to have the same taste and texture as animal-based meat while being better for people and the planet.
  
  
The Company’s brand promise, Eat What You Love®, represents a strong belief that there is a better way to feed our future and that the positive choices we all make, no matter how small, can have a great impact on our personal health and the health of our planet. By shifting from animal-based protein to plant-based protein, we can positively impact four growing global issues: human health, climate change, constraints on natural resources and animal welfare.
  
  
**Job Description**
The
***Director, Brand Marketing***
will lead the development and execution of the annual marketing plan, drive brand growth through production innovation, and build consumer relevance through breakthrough campaigns. Reporting to the VP, Marketing, the
***Director, Brand Marketing***
translates consumer, customer and marketplace insights into winning marketing and product strategies, with responsibility for driving business and brand performance across revenue, market share, and profitability. This role blends strategic brand leadership with creative execution and operational oversight, making it ideal for a marketing leader who can align brand vision with business performance
  
  
**Tasks, Duties, & General Responsibilities**
MARKETING STRATEGY
  
  

* Develop and lead the annual marketing plan, setting strategic business goals and ensuring alignment across the organization. Influence and align senior leadership behind the brand strategy and annual marketing calendar, presenting recommendations and building the business case for major programs.
* Support product strategy and innovation priorities, identifying opportunities and barriers
* Drive brand awareness, strengthen differentiation, and convert brand equity into sales growth

BRAND & CAMPAIGN MANAGEMENT
  
  

* Direct creative briefs and campaign strategies for brand‑differentiating work
* Lead scalable marketing programs and tools usable nationally with retailers
* Collaborate with cross‑functional teams to produce compelling brand touchpoints (website, packaging, advertising collateral) and initiatives

OPERATIONAL & STRATEGIC DUTIES
  
  

* Manage marketing budgets, forecast costs, and report on KPIs
* Oversee brand messaging, and partner Creative on visual identity and packaging design
* Conduct market research, competitive analysis, and product positioning
* Mentor and develop team members, building the capability and structure needed to deliver against Beyond’s growth goals
* Partner cross-functionally with Culinary, R&D, Creative, Comms and Operations to foster collaboration and bring insight-based communications, packaging, and product innovation to life, measuring success against established KPIs
* Think big, be flexible, and be creative! We’re in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment with high expectations and big opportunities.
* Serve as a senior brand steward, continuously assessing the competitive landscape, consumer trends, and culture to keep Beyond ahead of what's next

SUPERVISORY DUTIES
  
  

* Lead an internal team including brand and shopper managers
* Responsible for annual team budgeting
* Accountable for developing talent through on-going performance feedback and career management coaching
* Conduct quarterly and yearly performance reviews of direct reports
* Mentor and develop team members, create succession plan, and identify/recruit key talent
* Set annual and quarterly department level KPIs

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree required, MBA Preferred.
* 8+ years of brand management, brand-building, and integrated marketing experience, ideally within food and beverage or consumer brands.
* 4+ years leading and developing marketing teams, including managing managers
* Strategic brand leader who can set a compelling vision and translate it into clear plans and priorities for the team
* Demonstrated track record owning brand strategy and delivering breakthrough, full-funnel go-to-market campaigns and product launches
* Proven people leader and coach who builds, develops, and inspires high-performing teams
* Strong financial and business acumen, with a spirit of ownership and comfort managing budgets and driving ROI
* Exceptional communicator and cross-functional collaborator who influences at all levels of the organization
* Ability to flex from high level strategic thinking and influencing senior level leadership to driving detailed execution of projects that are on budget and on time.
* Analytical skills to leverage and synthesize data and insights for decision-making while balancing urgency, bold thinking and willingness to take risks.
* Desire to make work fun and make products that can change the world!
* Curious and positively resilient in a fast-paced, high-growth environment

**WORK ENVIRONMENT**

* Onsite office environment in El Segundo headquarters five (5) days a week

\*\*Annual salary commensurate with experience\*\*
  
  
The starting annual base pay for this role is between USD $185,000 and $215,000. The actual base is dependent upon many factors, such as training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. The role may also be eligible for bonus and benefits.

Si quieres ser parte de **agencia boutique** que trabaja con estructuras flexibles, equipos pequeños y en crecimiento bajo un modelo de trabajo basado en la **autenticidad y la creatividad estratégica.**

**Combinada con el uso de tecnología y storytelling** como herramientas para **crear experiencias** para las marcas y conectarlas con las personas.

Hoy en día cuenta con un equipo diverso con colaboradores que aportan desde distintos países como: Argentina, Brasil, Perú **México.** El cual, **este último** se encuentra en etapa de crecimiento.

¡Actualmente estamos buscando fortalecer nuestro equipo de marketing! con el próximo/a/x: **Creative Copywriter.**

Valorarán que la persona cuente con una mente rápida, curiosa, obsesión por las ideas y sabiendo que una buena idea en redes puede caber en un hook de tres segundos.

* Explorar nuevas herramientas, tecnologías y formatos —incluyendo AI— como parte natural del proceso creativo.

* Excelente sensibilidad para el lenguaje, el tono y la cultura.
* Criterio para explicar **por qué una idea importa**, no solo cómo se ve.

description:
**Additional Information**  
**Job Number**26124869  
**Job Category**Sales & Marketing  
**Location**Palm West Beach Palm Jumeirah Road, Dubai 0, United Arab Emirates  
**Schedule**Full Time  
**Located Remotely?**N  
**Position Type** Management  

**JOB SUMMARY**

The Marketing and Communications Manager is part of an important team that creates and executes property-level communications to our customers. Under the leadership of the Director of Marketing and Communication, this role promotes on-brand messaging to customers through traditional, digital, and social media channels all with the goal of enhancing the image of the hotel. This role helps build direct marketing plans, targeted campaigns, and activated channels to the end of driving consumer awareness and preference, increasing market share, and building broader portfolio and brand awareness. This role focuses on showcasing Food and Beverage promotions, both to hotel guests and to local patrons. As part of the Marketing and Communication team, this role is fully connected into resources in their region; Marketing and Communication Managers liaise and build deep partnerships with their regional eCommerce and Marketing teams to verify all local, social, and digital marketing efforts are effectively integrated with the selling efforts for the organization. This role also gets to do a little bit of everything, from balancing traditional and digital marketing and eCommerce activities to contributing to public relations (PR) activities for the hotel. Success is measured by how well they help drive the sales and revenue strategy of the property, social media engagement and also by how effectively leveraged the resources around them are to create truly compelling marketing and communications campaigns.

**CANDIDATE PROFILE**

**Education and Experience**

**Required:**

* 2-year degree from an accredited university in Marketing, Public Relations, Business Administration or related major and 4 years experience in the sales, marketing, digital or related professional area; hospitality marketing or digital advertising experience preferred

OR

* 4-year bachelor's degree in Marketing, Public Relations, Business, or related major; 2 years experience in the sales, marketing, digital or related professional area; hospitality marketing or digital advertising agency experience preferred.

**CORE WORK ACTIVITIES**

**Hotel Marketing and Advertising**

* Executes annual marketing plan to budget, in consultation with the GM, Food and Beverage leader, Operations leaders, Director of Marketing Communications, and cluster marketing and ecommerce teams.

* Partners with Operations, Food & Beverage and Sales teams to execute promotions and campaigns to target in-house guests with promotions that drive incremental revenue to the hotel.

* Acts as the liaison between the marketing department and advertising agency on the tactical advertising campaigns' creative and media plans, particularly for food and beverage promotions.

* Manages F&B media schedules and verifies prompt settlement of accounts.

* Partners with property Revenue Management to verify correct offer loading, verifying advertisement targeting is correctly directed at relevant consumer groups

* Executes email marketing, and display advertising.

* Maintains frequent, active engagement with Cluster eCommerce manager to verify alignment, pull-through, and 2-way communication about the status, performance evaluation, opportunities, and issues related to online programs and initiatives.

title: Director, Global Network & Systems Design - NSD
description:
Fluence (Nasdaq: FLNC) is a global market leader delivering intelligent energy storage and optimization software for renewables and storage. Our solutions and operational services are helping to create a more resilient grid and unlock the full potential of renewable portfolios. With gigawatts of successful implementations across nearly 50 markets, we are transforming the way we power our world for a more sustainable future. For more information, please visit fluenceenergy.com .

**Job Description:**

Role Overview

The Director, Global Network & Systems Design (NSD) provides global technical, organizational and strategic leadership for the design, architecture, testing and delivery of network and systems solutions supporting Fluence’s utility-scale energy storage portfolio.

This role leads the Global NSD organization and is accountable for establishing the technical architecture, engineering requirements, global standards, and governance necessary to deliver secure, scalable, reliable, and repeatable solutions across Fluence’s global project portfolio. The Director leads a team of senior technical experts, including Principal Engineers and Architects, and provides technical direction across complex IT/OT environments spanning network infrastructure, cybersecurity, SCADA, controls, cloud connectivity, system architecture, testing, and validation.

The Director partners closely with Product, Engineering, Cybersecurity, Project Delivery, Commissioning, Services, Sales, and regional Customer Success teams to translate customer, product, grid, and regional requirements into scalable global solutions.

Global NSD retains technical ownership through from design through commissioning.. Following commissioning, solutions transition to Services for 24x7 operational support, with Global NSD providing advanced technical escalation and leading redesign or architectural changes when required. In addition, Global NSD to support services fleet reliability and optimization process by providing documentation, developing training and supporting Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) development.

* Key Responsibilities

Global Technical Strategy & Leadership

* Lead the Global NSD organization, including Principal Engineers, Architects, and other senior technical resources supporting Fluence’s global project portfolio.

* Establish and execute the long-term NSD technical strategy and roadmap in alignment with Fluence’s product strategy, Customer Success priorities, and business objectives.

* Define clear technical ownership, decision rights, engineering governance, and escalation paths across the NSD lifecycle.

* Build organizational capability and technical depth to support increasing project scale, complexity, and geographic expansion.

* Develop senior technical talent and establish appropriate career pathways, succession planning, and capability development.

* Establish resource and capacity planning practices that align specialized technical expertise with global project demand and business priorities.

Architecture, Standards & Governance

* Own and govern global reference architectures, engineering standards, design principles, and technical requirements across network and IT/OT infrastructure.

* Establish standardized approaches for secure network architecture, cybersecurity, SCADA and controls integration, cloud connectivity, testing, and system validation.

* Ensure global standards appropriately address customer requirements, grid codes, cybersecurity requirements, regulatory obligations, and regional technical standards.

* Drive reuse and standardization while establishing appropriate governance for customer- or project-specific design deviations.

* Establish engineering quality gates and technical design reviews throughout the project lifecycle.

* Ensure architecture and engineering decisions support system reliability, maintainability, cybersecurity, scalability, and long-term serviceability.

Project Delivery & Commissioning

* Provide global technical oversight of NSD solutions from requirements definition and architecture through engineering, delivery, testing, and commissioning.

* Ensure technical requirements and designs are sufficiently defined before execution and appropriately governed throughout delivery.

* Partner with regional project and commissioning organizations to resolve complex technical issues affecting schedule, quality, system performance, or customer acceptance.

* Establish clear technical readiness and acceptance criteria for transition from project commissioning to operational support.

* Ensure effective technical handoff to Services, including required architecture, configuration, documentation, and support information.

* Serve as the senior technical escalation point for complex network and systems issues requiring architectural decisions, redesign, or specialized engineering intervention.

Service Transition & Lifecycle Support

* Partner with Services to establish an effective process between Global NSD and the global 24x7 support organization.

* Define escalation pathways and technical engagement models for issues requiring Global NSD expertise following operational handoff.

* Lead or oversee network redesign and significant architectural changes arising from operational experience, customer requirements, product evolution, or cybersecurity needs.

* Incorporate field and service experience into continuous improvement of global architectures, standards, engineering practices, and future project designs.

Cross-Functional & Global Partnership

* Partner across Product, Engineering, Cybersecurity, Services, Project Delivery, Commissioning, Sales, and regional Customer Success organizations.

* Translate regional and customer-specific requirements into scalable global technical solutions while minimizing unnecessary customization.

* Partner with Product and Engineering to identify recurring field requirements and influence product roadmap priorities.

* Communicate complex technical risks, decisions, tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly to senior technical and business leadership.

* Support critical customer and project engagements where senior technical leadership is required.

* Required Qualifications & Experience

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.

* 12+ years of progressive experience in network engineering, systems architecture, IT/OT infrastructure, industrial controls, power systems, or a related technical field.

* 5+ years of leadership experience managing senior engineers, technical leaders, architects, or globally distributed engineering teams.

* Demonstrated experience leading architecture and engineering for complex, mission-critical industrial, energy, or critical infrastructure environments.

* Strong technical expertise in industrial networking and IT/OT architectures, including network design, segmentation, routing, switching, firewalls, secure remote connectivity, and resilient/high-availability architectures.

* Strong understanding of industrial cybersecurity principles and their application within critical infrastructure environments.

* Experience with SCADA, PLCs, plant controls, industrial communication protocols, and integration of control systems within complex operating environments.

* Demonstrated experience establishing technical standards, reference architectures, engineering governance, and design-review processes across multiple projects or regions.

* Experience leading technical delivery through design, implementation, testing, commissioning, and transition to operations.

* Strong understanding of system verification, validation, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and structured testing methodologies.

* Demonstrated ability to manage complex technical escalations and make sound decisions where system availability, cybersecurity, safety, schedule, or customer commitments may be at risk.

* Experience operating effectively within a complex global matrix organization across multiple geographies, cultures, and time zones.

* Strong executive communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to translate complex technical issues into clear business implications, recommendations, and decisions.

* Ability to travel internationally based on business and project requirements.

* Preferred Qualifications

* Advanced degree in a relevant engineering or technical discipline.

* Experience with utility-scale battery energy storage systems (BESS), renewable energy, power generation, transmission and distribution, or grid-connected infrastructure.

* Experience designing or supporting networks within utility, power generation, substation, or other critical infrastructure environments.

* Knowledge of applicable industrial cybersecurity frameworks and standards, including IEC 62443, NERC CIP, NIST, or comparable regional standards.

* Relevant professional certifications in networking, cybersecurity, cloud infrastructure, industrial control systems, or related disciplines.

* Experience building or scaling a global engineering Center of Excellence or specialized technical organization.

Experience establishing global engineering standards while accommodating regional grid, regulatory, customer, and cybersecurity requirements.  



**Our Culture**

At Fluence, our culture is the foundation that drives our ambitious growth strategy and fuels our mission to transform the future of energy. Our core cultural pillars empower us to innovate, collaborate, and lead with purpose, ensuring we continue to deliver unparalleled value to our customers and the world.

We believe every voice matters. We encourage openness, active listening, and decisive action to create a culture where everyone has the opportunity to contribute to our success. We foster an environment where diverse perspectives are heard and valued, driving innovation and progress.

title: Director of Design
description:
About Mendocino Farms
  
At Mendocino Farms, we do a lot more than just sell sandwiches and salads. We are a fast-casual restaurant brand on a mission to bring people together through fresh, culinary-driven food and unmatched hospitality. As we continue our aggressive growth trajectory across new and existing markets, we are seeking a dynamic, analytical, and hands-on leader to elevate our total rewards structure.
  
Our Core Values and Mantras
  

* Sell Happy: The foundational philosophy that goes beyond serving meals to actively uplifting and improving every guest's day.
* Food Should Make People Feel Good: A commitment to using high-quality, whole, and thoughtfully sourced ingredients that make eating well easy.
* Be Culinary Explorers: A passion for combining fresh ingredients and bold flavors in unexpected, gourmet ways.
* Turn the Ordinary into the Extraordinary: Treating every customer and team interaction as a chance to lift someone's spirits.
* Get Better Every Day (GBED): An internal mantra encouraging continuous learning, personal growth, and skill development.

**Job Title:** Director of Design
  
**Reports To:** VP, Design & Construction
  
**Location:** Dallas, TX or Remote, USA
  
**Salary Range:** $117k - $190k (Compensation is based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, skills, qualifications, and geographic location.)
  
  
**Summary:**  
Mendocino Farms is seeking a Director of Design to lead the evolution and delivery of our restaurant experience across new restaurants, remodels, refreshes, and strategic initiatives.
  
**This leader will own Mendo’s design function:** the restaurant prototype, design standards, internal and external design resources, and the systems that turn brand strategy into distinctive, functional, and scalable restaurants. You will partner closely with Operations, Culinary, Facilities, Construction, Real Estate, and Marketing to create environments that strengthen the guest experience while supporting efficient operations, disciplined investment, and growth.
  
This is an opportunity for a creative and operationally minded leader who can set a compelling design point of view, build a high-performing team and consultant network, and make practical decisions that balance quality, durability, speed, cost, and long-term unit performance as Mendocino Farms expands its restaurant footprint.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**  
Lead the design function
  

* Lead, coach, and develop internal designers and external design resources; set clear expectations, effective working rhythms, and a high bar for quality and accountability.
* Align internal and external design resources to the development pipeline, identifying when specialized expertise is needed.
* Serve as the senior design leader for complex, high-visibility, or high-risk projects and decisions.

Own the brand environment and design standards
  

* Own and evolve Mendo’s restaurant prototype, design standards, material palettes, finishes, furniture, fixtures, lighting, equipment integration, and reusable design details.
* Ensure every restaurant delivers a recognizable Mendo experience while adapting appropriately to site conditions, market needs, and business priorities.
* Use operating feedback, field learning, and market insight to keep the brand environment relevant, differentiated, and scalable.
* Set and elevate Mendo’s creative design point of view, translating brand strategy into memorable, functional restaurant environments that feel distinctive across markets and formats.

Improve restaurant operations through design
  

* Maintain and evolve design standards that prioritize guest flow, ordering and pickup, digital and delivery activity, seating, accessibility, storage, serviceability, and day-to-day operations.
* Partner with Operations, Culinary, Facilities, Construction, and equipment vendors to improve kitchen planning, back-of-house flow, equipment integration, team ergonomics, throughput, food safety, and maintainability.
* Incorporate post-opening learning into future layouts, prototypes, and specifications.

Drive quality, clarity, and design delivery
  

* Oversee design delivery for new restaurants, remodels, and refresh programs from feasibility test fits and concepts through permit-ready documentation and design-related construction support.
* Establish practical design QA/QC and phase-gate practices that produce complete, coordinated, code-aware, and timely deliverables.
* Lead cross-functional reviews using clear agendas, advance pre-reads, recommendations, concise decision requests, and thoroughly documented follow-through.
* Translate stakeholder input into clear direction for internal teams and consultants, surfacing risks and tradeoffs early.
* Partner with Construction to protect design intent, improve constructability, and reduce design-related rework, RFIs, and change orders.

Manage partners and investment decisions
  

* Select, brief, manage, and evaluate architects, interior designers, engineers, and specialty vendors; set clear expectations for scope, quality, timing, communication, and accountability.
* Partner with Construction and Real Estate to understand design cost drivers and make value-engineering recommendations.
* Balance brand expression, operating performance, durability, cost, schedule, and long-term unit economics in design and specification decisions.
* Track design-function performance, capacity, risks, and priorities; use post-project reviews to improve standards, tools, and partner performance.
* Develop the annual design operating plan in partnership with Real Estate, including internal and consultant capacity, priorities, budget needs, and key risks; provide regular updates on design delivery.

How you’ll lead at Mendo
  
You lead with ownership, preparation, sound judgment, and a continuous-improvement mindset. You develop people and partners, create alignment through clear communication and decision-making, navigate tradeoffs constructively, and build confidence through reliable follow-through.
  
  
**What you’ll bring:**  

* 10+ years of progressive experience in restaurant, retail, hospitality, architecture, interior design, or another related built-environment discipline.
* Experience leading a design team, studio, function, or substantial network of external design partners in a fast-moving, multi-project environment.
* Significant hands-on experience with restaurant or similarly operationally intensive commercial design, including prototype development, new-unit growth, remodels, and site-specific adaptation.
* Strong command of restaurant operations and design, including FOH/BOH flow, kitchen equipment, labor and ergonomics, guest circulation and accessibility, pickup/delivery, food safety, storage, and maintainability.
* Experience managing architects, interior designers, engineers, and specialty vendors against quality, schedule, scope, and budget expectations.
* Working knowledge of construction documentation, design QA/QC, permitting, building and health codes, design detailing, accessibility, shop-drawing review, and constructability.
* Financial fluency with design budgets, cost drivers, value engineering, specification tradeoffs, lifecycle durability, and unit economics.
* Bachelor’s degree in Architecture, Interior Architecture, Interior Design, Environmental Design, Product Design, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
* Proficiency with Bluebeam Revu, Excel, PowerPoint, and project-management platforms; working knowledge of AutoCAD and/or Revit and SketchUp is preferred.
* Exceptional written, verbal, and visual communication skills, including the ability to develop concise recommendations and executive-ready presentations.
* Ability to travel occasionally for market visits, project milestones, and team meetings.

**Benefits include:**

Physical Requirements

**Responsibilities**

*Note: Items below referring to broad ownership should be interpreted as the director group’s collective responsibility to own team strategic direction. Individual levels of ownership for overarching items will vary based on expertise, interest, and workload.*

* Lead execution of the paid media department’s strategic direction across all accounts and verticals, ensuring account strategies ladder up to agency positioning

* Own the department’s budget allocation across teams, tools, and resources, and report financial performance and resource utilization to BU leadership

* Own targeting and audience strategy outcomes department-wide, including data partnerships, vendor relationships, and privacy compliance
* Own creative asset management standards and creative technology partnerships, and drive leadership-level alignment across Performance Creative, Integrated Media, Account Management, Ad Ops, and Analytics
* Own reporting standards and BI infrastructure across the department, and drive adoption of advanced analytics techniques such as MMM and incrementality
* Lead senior client conversations on measurement strategy, and mentor Associate Directors and Sr Managers on executive-level data storytelling
* Own the department’s platform expertise strategy and make final adoption decisions on emerging platforms and technology
* Manage strategic platform relationships, including access decisions, betas, and escalation pathways
* Own competitive intelligence standards department-wide and synthesize portfolio signals into vertical and industry insight for BU leadership
* Manage and develop all Associate Director and Sr Manager direct reports, and execute the departmental people strategy set by BU leadership
* Conduct and calibrate performance reviews across the leadership team, and ensure clear ownership and accountability at every level
* Serve as the senior paid media contact for the portfolio’s largest accounts, build VP and C-level relationships, and own department-level escalation resolution
* Lead the media component of major new business pitches in partnership with BU leadership
