title: Fractional Media Director
description:
**Overview**

We are seeking an autonomous, business-minded **Media Director** to take comprehensive ownership of our annual **$20M media budget**. As a $200-$250M omnichannel brand scaling rapidly, we are moving beyond pure-play performance to build a sophisticated, full-funnel media engine.

In this role, you will operate as a high-leverage individual contributor. Instead of managing a large internal team, you will wield full strategic control over media allocation and agency partners. You will be responsible for balancing traditional **DTC conversion media**, deploying our new **brand awareness initiatives**, and maximizing our presence across our core Retail Media Networks: **Amazon** and **Target**. Additionally, you will support us in hiring the right media agency/partner.

**Duties**

**1. Full Media Budget Ownership & Capital Allocation**

* Serve as the sole financial steward for the $XM media budget, fluidly shifting capital between performance, brand, and retail channels to maximize overall enterprise growth.
* Lead comprehensive media planning and scenario-modeling to present direct spending recommendations to executive leadership.

**2. Retail Media Network (RMN) Mastery (Amazon & Target)**

* Drive omni-channel velocity by building and scaling ad strategies on **Amazon Advertising** (Sponsored Ads, DSP) and **Target Roundel**.
* Align digital media plans with retail trade calendars to ensure digital media spend directly boosts physical shelf velocity and online market share.

**3. Full-Funnel Brand Awareness Strategy**

* Own the strategy, deployment, and optimization of upper-funnel brand equity campaigns across Connected TV (CTV), Digital Audio, Linear, and Programmatic video.
* Establish and track upper-funnel success metrics via brand lift studies, tracking share of voice (SOV), and baseline organic search growth.

**4. DTC Conversion & Performance Media**

* Maintain the efficiency of core performance channels (Meta, Google, TikTok) focusing on Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), Lifetime Value (LTV), and Blended Marketing Efficiency Ratio (MER). Recognizing this is the core of media planning and strategy today, this will be a strong foundation shift.
* Partner with internal creative teams to guide rapid asset testing based on performance data trends.

**5. High-Impact Agency Governance**

* Directly manage external media planning, buying, and performance agencies, acting as their primary point of contact and holding them to strict execution standards.
* Audit agency work continuously to eliminate media waste and ensure data-driven campaign optimizations.

**6. Advanced Attribution & Holistic Measurement**

* Partner with Data Analytics to interpret Media Mix Modeling (MMM) and Multi-Touch Attribution (MTA) readouts.
* Quantify the "halo effect" of brand and retail media spending on our direct-to-consumer website traffic and sales.

**Qualifications**

* **Experience:** 5–8 years of experience overseeing omnichannel media strategy, either brand-side or at a leading growth agency.
* **Budget Scale:** Direct experience managing or heavily influencing media budgets of **$20M+ annually**.
* **RMN Specialization:** Proven, deep expertise navigating **Amazon Advertising** and **Target Roundel** ecosystems.
* **Individual Contributor DNA:** Thrives as a self-directed operator who can command a $50M budget and steer agencies without needing a large internal team to delegate to.
* **Full-Funnel Native:** Demonstrated success deploying and measuring upper-funnel, non-linear brand awareness campaigns.
* **Analytical Rigor:** Highly proficient in interpreting MMM data, Google Analytics 4, and multi-retailer dashboard metrics.

Join us as a Fractional Media Director if you're ready to bring your strategic vision to life through impactful storytelling, innovative media outreach, and engaging digital campaigns!

Pay: From $150.00 per hour

Expected hours: 20.0 per week

Work Location: Remote

description:

title: Director, Product Design
description:
**About the role**
------------------

Cyberhaven is building Flow, a unified data security platform spanning Human Data Security, Agentic Data Security, and Data Security Posture Management. The people who use it are security analysts, insider-risk investigators, and data protection leaders — experts doing demanding work under time pressure, who live in our product all day. And increasingly they are not working alone: AI agents are becoming actors inside the enterprise and inside our product, which means the experience we design now has to serve both the human doing the judging and the agent doing the work.

We are looking for a Director of Product Design to lead our design team and own what Flow feels like to use. You will set the experience vision for the platform, define the interaction patterns for a generation of security work that is part human and part agentic, and lead the designers and researchers who make it real.

You will lead a small, talented team of designers and will partner directly with the CPO, product management, engineering, and customer experience, and you will operate as the design voice in the rooms where the roadmap and scope get decided. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will raise the craft bar and grow your team, and still be close enough to the work to have an independent point of view about what we should build.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Own the end-to-end product design experience across Flow, HDS, ADS, and DSPM from the analyst’s daily workflow to how the platform holds together as one product rather than three.
* Define the next-generation experience vision for the platform, including how humans and AI agents work together inside it: agent-assisted investigation, human-in-the-loop decisions, explainability, and the interaction patterns that let a security professional trust and override automated work.
* Lead, coach, and grow a team of product designers, and raise the standard for craft, critique, and how design decisions are argued and defended.
* Own the UX research function and make sure the team’s work is grounded in evidence customer interviews, usability testing, support and RFE signal, and product instrumentation rather than internal opinion.
* Partner with product management and engineering from the earliest stage of every major initiative, shaping the problem definition and scope rather than styling decisions that have already been made.
* Build and evolve the design system and the patterns that let a growing engineering organization ship a consistent experience at speed.
* Establish how design measures itself usability benchmarks, task success, time to resolution for core analyst workflows, adoption of new surfaces, support deflection and report against it.
* Drive the experience work behind platform migration, making sure the move to Flow is something customers want rather than something they endure.
* Represent the customer’s experience in executive forums roadmap reviews, business reviews, and planning with a clear and honest read on where the product stands.

**Who you are**
---------------

* 10+ years in product design, including 4+ years leading and developing designers, with a portfolio of shipped work you can walk through end to end.
* You have set an experience vision for a complex product and then delivered against it — not just a concept deck, but patterns and surfaces that shipped and held up.
* Experienced with complex, expert-user enterprise software — tools where the user is a professional doing demanding work, not a consumer. Security, IT operations, observability, data infrastructure, or similar domains.
* You have designed AI-powered or agentic product experiences and have a real point of view on trust, transparency, control, and what happens when the model is wrong.
* Strong systems thinker: you can hold a platform-level information architecture in your head, and you build design systems that make teams faster instead of slowing them down.
* You value and use research. You know how to run the function, ask the right questions of it, and act on what comes back.
* An exceptional communicator and influencer. You can tell a room of executives something they do not want to hear, ground it in the customer’s reality, and leave with a decision.
* A people leader first. You develop designers, give direct feedback, and build a team that does its best work.
* You operate with urgency and judgment in a fast-moving environment, and you are comfortable making progress before every input is in hand.
* Located in the US (SF Bay Area preferred).

**Bonus points if you have:**

* Worked in cybersecurity, or designed for security operations, insider risk, or data protection teams.
* Led design through a major platform migration or the consolidation of several products into one.
* Experience building a design function hiring, leveling, process, and the operating rhythm not just running one that already existed.

Joining Cyberhaven means joining the team building Data Security for the Agentic Enterprise. Traditional tools fall short. Cyberhaven traces the full lifecycle of your data, adapting protection to changing context, so protection moves with the way people actually work, not against it. AI Changed Work. We Protect It.  
Backed by $250M from leading investors like Khosla and Redpoint, our team includes leaders who built industry-defining technologies at CrowdStrike, Palo Alto Networks, Meta, Google, and more. This role lets you shape the future of data security, working alongside people driven to protect workflows, not just data, for customers who cannot afford to slow down to stay safe.

**AI Tools Disclosure:** As part of Cyberhaven's hiring process, we use recruiting tools that include AI-powered features to help with tasks like scheduling, note-taking, workflow automation, and other recruiting activities ("AI Tools"). The AI Tools may process information you provide during the application and interview process. When AI-assisted interview note taking is used, candidates are notified in advance and have the option to opt out of the AI-assisted interview note taking.

*Cyberhaven is committed to creating a diverse environment and is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.*

Compensation Range: $250K - $275K

title: Manager, FP&A
description:
### **The Opportunity**

Caraway Home is a direct-to-consumer cookware and home goods brand with a fast-growing retail and wholesale business. Our finance function is not a back-office group, it sets the demand plan that commits our inventory capital, owns pricing architecture, and partners directly with the Leadership Team on strategic financial decisions.

This role will report to and work alongside the Associate Director of FP&A across the full range of what the team owns: demand planning and inventory, pricing and unit economics, budgeting and reforecasting, and executive reporting. It's a hybrid role by design: you'll move constantly between units and dollars, between a SKU-level forecast and a channel P&L, because that movement is the core skill of the team.

### **Who You Are**

You're very detail-oriented. This role is a quality check on data and numbers other teams rely on, and small errors compound quickly across reporting, pricing QA, and partner forecasts.

We are looking for candidates from experience with a merchandise, inventory, or category planning background with real financial modeling depth, or an FP&A background built in a consumer or inventory-heavy business.

This is not a reporting production role. We need someone who interprets what the numbers say, forms a view, and brings it forward. This role is scoped to grow into category ownership. At Caraway, that means holding the full picture for a category: how the assortment is built and where it has gaps or redundancy, what each SKU earns on a unit basis, what demand looks like and what inventory it requires, how pricing and promotion should be structured, and what the category needs to do for the business next year. Demand planning is the largest piece of that, but a forecast is only as good as the assortment and pricing decisions underneath it.

### **Responsibilities**

**Reporting & Budgeting**

* Own monthly All Hands reporting and the underlying revenue/margin views by channel, product, and category — going beyond the standing package to flag what's moving, what isn't, and what leadership should be watching that they aren't today.
* Support quarterly board reporting and investor updates.
* Run the monthly department budget cycle (actuals, recodes, variance reporting), holding department leads to a quality bar on submitted forecasts, plus the annual budget and reforecasting in between.

**Demand & Retail Forecasting**

* Run monthly demand model actualization and build the variance commentary that explains the driver behind a miss, not just its size — this also feeds the broader demand planning process.
* Support partner-level retail and wholesale forecasting: real retail math, from inventory flow and units-to-dollars translation to promotional pricing and unit economics at the partner level.
* Own forecasting for long-tail/mature SKUs and for smaller or emerging channels (TikTok Shop, Canada, etc).
* Partner with Operations team to manage supplier capacity: prepare the monthly reorder pack, consolidate PO advancement requests, and factor any supplier constraints into the demand plan and reorder timing.

**Pricing & Promotional Analysis**

* Own pricing QA across site, Amazon, and retail surfaces, and build the assortment-and-pricing-by-partner tracking system that doesn't exist today.
* Own the standard post-mortem format for promotions, gift-with-purchase offers, and price tests, building the institutional read on how customers respond to discount depth and bundle structure.

### **Knowledge, Skills & Abilities**

**Required**

* 4–7 years in FP&A, strategic finance, merchandise or inventory planning, or category management, in a consumer, retail, or e-commerce business.
* Fluency moving between units and dollars: unit forecasts, landed cost, margin, and channel P&L, including how inventory moves through the business and how promotional pricing and unit economics play out at the partner level.
* Self-sufficiency in a BI tool, ideally SQL: you can find, pull, and validate your own data and build your own reporting. You shouldn't need the data team to build views for you; you should be able to specify what you need when the underlying model genuinely doesn't support it, and build everything else yourself.
* Strong Excel and independent modeling ability: you build models from scratch that others can follow, audit, and defend. This is a daily skill in this role, not an occasional one.
* Comfort working across departments: a large share of this role is with Growth, Merchandising, Retail, Supply Chain, Accounting, and Creative. You need to be effective with people who don't think in financial terms, and confident holding a standard with them.
* Familiarity with the GL, chart of accounts, financial statements, P&L structure, and budget-to-actuals reporting. Ownership of these isn't expected; fluency reading and working with them is.
* Comfort being visibly wrong: forecasting is a discipline of continuous revision; we need someone who reforecasts honestly rather than defending a prior number.

**Strongly preferred**

* SKU-level planning experience: assortment productivity, open-to-buy, receipt planning, or markdown and promotional planning.
* Exposure to inventory-constrained decision-making: supplier lead times, MOQs, capacity limits.
* Experience with an ERP (Fulfil, NetSuite, or similar) alongside a BI layer.

*The anticipated base salary range for this role is $110,000 - 130,000. Final compensation will depend on a variety of factors determining the base pay at offer, including but not limited to: skills, qualifications, experience. This range provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role.*

**Life at Caraway:**

**Who We Are:**

Caraway is a home goods brand on a mission to craft well-designed, non-toxic essentials that thoughtfully raises the standards of what you cook with. We’re passionate about creating elevated products, made without forever chemicals, that are better for you, your family, and the planet. We prioritize a holistic approach to the creation of Caraway products. We partner with ethical manufacturers where their employees are safe, paid fairly, given benefits, and work regulated hours. Our eco-friendly manufacturing process emits less CO2 than traditional non-stick coatings, and we use sustainable packaging practices and ship in packaging made from recycled materials. We pride ourselves on continuously striving to do and be better—for you and the planet—in every step of the process.

Since launching in November 2019, we’ve become one of the fastest growing digitally-native brands of the last decade and are now sold in retailers including Target, Bloomingdale’s, Crate & Barrel, The Container Store, Costco, Zola, and many more.

**A Little Bit About Our Team:**
--------------------------------

The Record to Report (RTR) Accounting Team serves as the central operational backbone for financial integrity, revenue recognition, cash management, and financial reporting across Warner Music Group.

Operating within our Shared Services / Global Business Services framework, the Recorded Music RTR team provides specialized accounting expertise, revenue assurance, and critical month-end closing support across WMG’s renowned domestic and international record labels. We work with the GBS Revenue Team translating complex data into accurate financial reporting under US GAAP.

**Your Role:**

As the leadRevenue Accountant for Recorded Music, you will serve as the technical subject matter expert (SME) for our recorded music revenue accounting life cycle. This role bridges technical accounting, data analytics, and financial systems design. You will take ownership of the end-to-end accounting for high-volume, multi-source revenue streams, drive compliance with **ASC 606**, spearhead systems automation, and unlock actionable financial insights through advanced data mining. In addition to technical execution, you will provide training and education to other members of the Recorded Music RTR team.

**Here you'll get to:**
-----------------------

* Lead the technical accounting, accrual modeling, and reconciliation for all Recorded Music revenue streams, including Digital Streaming Partners (Spotify, Apple, YouTube, Amazon), Digital Downloads, DMCA statutory royalties, Physical manufacturing and distribution (vinyl, CD, merch), Synchronization (film, TV, gaming, advertising), Master Licensing, and foreign affiliate distributions.
* Architect and maintain robust ASC 606 recognition schedules, monthly flash revenue accruals, deferred revenue tracking, and automated reversals based on consumption ingestion files vs. actual cash settlements.
* Query, clean, and analyze Revenue Operational Reporting datasets across disparate DSPs using Analysis for Office and Gemini AI Tools. Reconcile Multi-System Reporting from Source to Financial Ledger.
* Bridge consumption metadata (streams, downloads, play counts, tier rates) with transactional general ledger activity to detect anomalies, underreported royalties, missing catalog codes, and system mismatches.
* Conduct granular month-over-month (MoM) and quarter-over-quarter (QoQ) variance analyses; present variance drivers to label finance leaders.
* Serve as the RTR business lead for financial systems optimization across SAP (ECC / S/4HANA), BlackLine, and proprietary music revenue sub-ledgers.
* Design, test, and implement automated reporting simplify manual journal entries and compress the monthly close cycle.
* Direct the monthly and quarterly close deliverables for recorded music revenue, reviewing high-volume journal entries, complex accruals, and balance sheet reconciliations.
* Review work products prepared by staff accountants and offshore shared service partners (e.g., Shopify D2C sales tie-outs, DSP settlement matching, clearing account reconciliations), providing structured guidance and establishing standard operating procedures (SOPs).
* Actively investigate and resolve persistent balances in revenue clearing, suspense, and partner withholding accounts.
* Maintain and enhance internal control matrices under Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX 404), ensuring proper segregation of duties, automated validation checks, and data lineage documentation.
* Serve as primary revenue audit liaison for internal and external auditors (e.g., Big 4), providing PBC audit schedules, roll-forwards, sample testing support, and technical accounting memos.
* Partner proactively with Label Finance VPs/Directors, Commercial Revenue Operations, Business & Legal Affairs, IT/Data Engineering, and Corporate Royalty teams to align accounting treatments with evolving contract structures and deal terms.

**About you:**
--------------

* Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance, or related analytical field required.
* Active CPA license (or international equivalent) strongly preferred.
* Master’s Degree (MAcc, MBA) or coursework in Financial Data Analytics / Information Systems is a significant plus.
* 10 to 15+ years of progressive, hands-on accounting experience in Corporate Accounting, Shared Services, or Big 4 Public Accounting.
* Extensive specialization (7+ years) in high-volume revenue accounting, billing assurance, or royalty accounting within the music, digital entertainment, streaming media, or intellectual property/licensing sectors.
* Proven track record leading technical ASC 606 revenue recognition implementations or oversight for complex multi-element arrangements.
* Demonstrable experience directing and reviewing work performed by distributed, hybrid, or offshore delivery centers.
* Deep experience working with enterprise ERPs (specifically SAP FI/CO, S/4HANA) and automated balance sheet reconciliation tools (such as BlackLine or Cadency).
* Expert-level Microsoft Excel proficiency (SAP Analysis for Office, Power Query, dynamic arrays, VBA/macros, advanced nested logic).
* Experience with eCommerce and digital billing platforms (e.g., Shopify, DSP vendor reporting portals) is highly desirable.

**We’d love it if you also had:**
---------------------------------

* Ability to untangle intricate data anomalies and synthesize findings into clear executive summaries.
* Proactive drive to evaluate status-quo manual workflows and design scalable, automated alternatives.
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with the confidence to collaborate across label executives, data engineers, and external auditors.
* Proven capacity to manage high-pressure close deadlines and competing stakeholder requests with composure and precision.

As the home to 10K Projects, Asylum, Atlantic Music Group, East West, FFRR, Fueled by Ramen, Nonesuch, Parlophone, Rhino, Roadrunner, Sire, Warner Records, Warner Classics, and several other of the world’s premier recording labels, Warner Music Group champions emerging artists and global superstars alike. And our renowned publishing company, Warner Chappell Music, represents genre-spanning songwriters and producers through a catalog of more than one million copyrights worldwide. Warner Music Group is also home to ADA, which supports the independent community, as well as artist services division WMX. In addition, WMG counts film and television storytelling powerhouse Warner Music Entertainment among its many brands.

Together, we are **Warner Music Group: Independent Minds. Major Sound.**

Click the “Apply” link at the top of the page, or apply directly with your LinkedIn. Applying with LinkedIn will import all of the information you put in your profile, but will still allow you to upload a resume and cover letter.

Don’t be discouraged if you don’t hear from us right away. We’re taking our time to review all resumes, and to find the best people for WMG.

Thanks for your interest in working for WMG. We love it here, and think you will, too.

title: Research Director
description:
***Who We Are***

We are Bovitz Inc., a market research and strategy firm that puts people at the center of design, innovation, and growth. We believe in the value that companies of all shapes and sizes can bring to people’s lives, and it matters to us that they actually do it. As a company, our mission is to give real people a voice so powerful that their stories change the course of business decisions. So, we go out and talk to real people about what they need and want and then show companies what to do with that. Simply put, we’re in the business of improving people’s lives.

Bovitz was founded as a custom research agency in 2003, grounded in academic rigor & deep client-side experience. We now have a multi-disciplinary team of 35 full-time employees, including leaders in Market Research, Anthropology, Brand Strategy, Cognitive Science, Business Consulting, and Design. We are a fully remote company with available office space in Los Angeles when needed. Please visit www.bovitzinc.com to learn more about our team, the type of work we do, our culture, and our clients.

As a Research Director at Bovitz, your job is to own the strategy (of the project and of the story). You have a team working in support of you; they own bringing the relevant data and insights to you, which will allow you to architect the story and implications. You will partner with your team to make sure your story is supported by the correct data, and you will also interface with your team’s Account Manager to ensure that your story is actionable and impactful for the client.

**People**

* Lead a team of 2-4, mentoring/coaching junior and mid-level staff — sharing responsibility for their development and training roadmaps
* Manage resourcing for your team
* Involvement in company-wide talent-development initiatives

**Clients & Projects**

* Lead and deliver multiple research / insights engagements (both qual and quant) simultaneously
* Oversee all key stages of the project process from project kick-off to report presentation (survey/discussion guide development, analysis, storytelling, reporting)
* Act as “thought partner” to clients — crafting insights, developing actionable recommendations, maintaining client relationships, and supporting account growth
* Support MD & AMs in business development efforts

**Operations**

* Oversee the operational aspects of client engagements, ensuring projects are delivered on time, on budget, and to scope

* Identify and resolve operational bottlenecks, risks, or conflicts before they impact delivery
* Champion research excellence by ensuring quality control processes are consistently applied

* 7-10 years of marketing research experience (supplier side experience preferred)

* Genuine interest in better understanding consumer behavior
* Experience consulting clients/business executives on strategic and tactical insights
* Experience with and strong desire to manage and mentor junior employees, with direct management experience preferred
* Ability to work with teams in creative and analytical environments
* Ability to problem solve, make decisions, and take initiative
* Strong organizational, attention to detail, and time management/prioritization skills
* Outstanding communication skills, in both written and oral form
* Hands-on advanced knowledge of and proficiency with Microsoft PowerPoint, Word, Excel, and SPSS
* Hands-on advanced knowledge of and proficiency with Google Suite (Slides, Sheets, Docs) preferred

**Physical Requirements**

This position is primarily performed in a remote office environment. The employee is regularly required to sit for extended periods of time; use hands and fingers to operate a computer keyboard, mouse, and other office equipment; and communicate effectively via phone, video conferencing, and written communication. The employee may occasionally need to stand, walk, and lift or move items up to 15 pounds. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the role.

**What We Offer:**

Bovitz recognizes that employees are our most important asset. The competitive compensation package and broad range of benefits extended to our employees directly reflects the value placed on their importance to our success. Some of our benefits include:

* Remote work environment and a corporate hub for collaborating and company fun
* Medical, Dental and Vision plans (100% employee medical premium paid by the company)

You’ll help customers place orders, navigate our websites, answer questions about yarn, fabric, and crafting products, resolve shipping and payment issues, and ensure every interaction reflects our values of care and creativity.

  + Answer questions about knitting, crochet, and quilting tools, techniques, and patterns.

* Work remotely with a regular full-time schedule.
* Gain exposure to multiple well-loved craft brands and a wide variety of customer needs.
* Grow your skills in both customer service and the craft industry.

* **Familiarity with knitting, crochet, or quilting tools and techniques.**
* Strong computer and web navigation skills; quick learner of new systems.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office.
* Clear, accurate writing with strong spelling, grammar, and attention to detail.
* Collaborative, adaptable, and comfortable multitasking in a fast-paced environment.

* Experience with Ne**tsuite, Shopify** or other order management systems.

Our nationwide team of 200+ pairs pet health expertise with purpose-built technology to make care without compromise possible. Pumpkin’s deep understanding of the science and finance of veterinary care makes us an asset to our more than 10,000 nationwide veterinary professional partners and is one reason we are trusted by nine out of ten surveyed veterinarians.

Our consumers love us, too. We are the #1-rated pet insurance brand on Google, have a 4.9-star rating on TrustPilot and are one of the fastest-growing pet health companies in the US. We have insured over 230,000 pets and paid more than $176 million in claims since launch. Pumpkin also offers PumpkinNow, the only urgent pay service that can pay pet parents for eligible claims before they pay vet bills — making it one of the fastest claims experiences in pet insurance. Beyond accidents and illnesses, Pumpkin Wellness Club provides preventive care plans that help pay for everything from routine vet visits to grooming.

  

At Pumpkin, we believe pet parenthood is parenthood. While life with pets looks different than raising human children, the responsibility, commitment, and love run just as deep. That belief is why we exist: to help parents choose the best care for their loved ones – without compromise.

title: Senior Major Account Executive (New Logo)
description:
At Infoblox, every breakthrough begins with a bold **“what if.”**  
**What if** your ideas could ignite global innovation?
  
**What if** your curiosity could redefine the future?

We invite you to step into the next exciting chapter of **your** career journey. Bring your creativity, drive, your daring spirit, and feel what it’s like to thrive on a team big enough to make an impact, yet small enough to make a difference. Our cloud-first networking and security solutions already protect **70% of the Fortune 500** , and we’re looking for creative thinkers ready to push that influence even further. Join us and discover how far your bold “what if” can take the world, your community, and your career.

Here, how we empower our people is extraordinary: **Glassdoor Best Places to Work 2025, Great Place to Work-Certified in five countries, and Cigna Healthy Workforce honors three years running** — and what we build is world-class: recognized as **CybersecAsia’s Best in Critical Infrastructure 2024** — evidence that when first-class technology meets empowered talent, remarkable careers take shape. So, **what if** the next big idea, and the next great career story, comes from you? Become the force that turns every “what if” into “what’s next”.

In a world where you can be anything, **Be Infoblox** .

**Senior Major Account Executive - Chicago**

We have an opportunity for a *Senior Major Enterprise Account Executive* to join our Major Account Executive sales team *,* reporting to the Senior Director of Major Account Executives. In this pivotal role, you will focus on **acquiring** **new accounts** , generating new leads, and converting them into customers. This includes owning and coordinating all aspects of the sales cycle. Our most successful salespeople in this role have a hunter mindset and an entrepreneurial spirit while acting ethically and transparently. This role requires a proactive approach to sales, with a focus on generating new leads and converting them into customers. This includes owning and coordinating all aspects of the sales cycle, maintaining and expanding the customer base, and collaborating closely with the BDR, Field Marketing, Solutions Architecture, and West Sales Team with primary focus on Chicago metro. You’re the ideal candidate if you have a hunter mindset, and a proven track record of identifying and securing new business opportunities, cultivating relationships with prospects, and consistently achieving sales targets.

Be a Contributor — What You’ll Do Territory and Account Planning

* Collaborate with your local team to build and execute a comprehensive territory and account plan.
* Use AI-enabled sales intelligence and analytics tools to identify high-potential accounts, buying signals, whitespace opportunities, and priority personas across the territory.
* Apply data-driven insights to refine account strategies, improve territory coverage, and focus resources on the opportunities most likely to convert.

New Business Development

* Drive new business opportunities in networking, security, and cloud solutions.
* Leverage AI-powered tools to research target accounts, personalize outreach, identify relevant business challenges, and accelerate new-logo pipeline generation.

Prospecting

* Identify and pursue new opportunities through sales-specific actions, marketing programs, channel partnerships, and personally driven campaigns.
* Engage in 8–10 new-business customer interactions per week.
* Initiate contact with prospects across multiple personas, including networking, security, and cloud leaders, through cold calls, emails, social selling, and professional networking.
* Develop and execute strategies to generate new-business leads through a combination of marketing, channel, and individually driven campaigns.
* Utilize prospecting tools such as ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Highspot Digital Sales Rooms, and approved AI-enabled sales tools.
* Use generative AI responsibly to improve prospect research, personalize communications, prepare for meetings, and increase prospecting productivity while maintaining accuracy, confidentiality, and brand standards.

Deal Qualification

* Conduct expert discovery and apply the MEDDPICC deal qualification framework.
* Use AI-assisted call intelligence and opportunity insights to identify gaps in discovery, stakeholder engagement, competitive positioning, and deal qualification.
* Validate AI-generated insights through direct customer engagement and sound sales judgment.

Sales Recipes Adherence

* Follow established sales recipes, including workshops and assessments.
* Conduct one Security Workshop per month and seven Security Assessments per year.

Economic Buyer Engagement

* Reach the economic buyer by leveraging business value assessments and compelling business cases.
* Ensure all new-logo opportunities over $50,000 include a Business Value Assessment.
* Use AI-enabled research and analytical tools, where appropriate, to strengthen business cases, quantify customer outcomes, and tailor executive-level value propositions.

Partner Meetings

* Hold at least two partner meetings per week with resellers, hyperscalers, and technology-alliance partners.
* Leverage hyperscaler relationships and transact at least one deal per quarter through a hyperscaler marketplace.
* Apply account and partner intelligence to identify opportunities for co-selling, joint prospecting, and coordinated market engagement.

Accurate Forecasting

* Maintain forecasting accuracy within plus or minus 10%.
* Use CRM, forecasting platforms, and AI-generated opportunity insights to assess deal health, identify risks, and improve forecast accuracy.
* Maintain complete and accurate CRM data to ensure AI-supported recommendations and forecasts are based on reliable information.

Be Prepared — What You Bring

* 10+ years of successful technology sales experience, preferably in a hunter role focused on new-business acquisition.
* References from C-level executives at a minimum of three accounts where you successfully established relationships and introduced a portfolio of products.

Proven Track Record of:

* Meeting and exceeding sales targets.
* Opening Fortune 1000 or similarly sized accounts and closing six-figure ACV opportunities.
* Building trusted C-level relationships.
* Disrupting incumbent technologies and challenging the status quo by successfully selling emerging solutions that may not yet be part of an established market.
* Cultivating partner ecosystems across channel organizations, hyperscalers, and technology alliances.
* Selling a portfolio of products through complex, multi-stakeholder customer engagements involving economic buyers, CIOs, CISOs, Finance, Risk, SecOps, and other key decision-makers.
* Applying value-selling methodologies, including advanced Business Value Assessments and ROI models.
* Using AI-enabled sales tools, account intelligence, conversation intelligence, and data analytics to improve prospecting, account planning, pipeline development, deal execution, and forecast accuracy.
* Demonstrating curiosity and adaptability in adopting emerging AI capabilities that increase seller productivity and enhance the customer experience.
* Using generative AI responsibly, including protecting confidential information, reviewing AI-generated content for accuracy, and complying with company security, privacy, and ethical-use standards.
* Proficiency with CRM and sales technology platforms, including but not limited to Salesforce, Clari, Highspot, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, 6sense, and relevant AI-enabled sales applications.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate sales intelligence and AI-generated insights into clear, actionable account and opportunity strategies.
* Excellent written, verbal, and executive-level communication skills.
* Highly self-motivated, accountable, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial sales environment.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience.

**Be Successful — Your Path**

**First 90 Days:** Immerse in our culture, connect with mentors, and map the systems and stakeholders that rely on your work.

**Six Months:**

* Be confident delivering POC and webinars, as well as communicating our value proposition to new and existing customers
* Participate in 8-10 customer meetings a week, created through your individual prospecting, partner networking, and pipeline generation in conjunction with the Marketing and BDR team

**One Year:**

* Have built a target pipeline of 3X your current quota
* Deliver consistent quarterly results against quota attainment
* Have built a network of external champions across your territory and target accounts

**Belong—** **Your Community**

Our culture thrives on inclusion, rewarding the bold ideas, curiosity, and creativity that move us forward. In a community where every voice counts, continuous learning is the norm. So, whether you code, create, sell, or care for customers, you’ll grow and belong here.

**Be Rewarded —** **Benefits That Help You Grow, Thrive, Belong**

* Comprehensive health coverage, generous PTO, and flexible work options
* Learning opportunities, career-mobility programs, and leadership workshops
* Sixteen paid volunteer hours each year, global employee resource groups, and a “No Jerks” policy that keeps collaboration healthy
* Modern offices with EV charging, healthy snacks (and the occasional cupcake), plus hackathons, game nights, and culture celebrations
* Charitable Giving Program supported by Company Match

We practice pay transparency and reward performance. Offers reflect role location, internal equity, experience, skills, education, and certifications. Base salary for this position: $150K - $160K plus bonus or commissions.

Ready to **Be the Difference?**

title: Associate Director, Omnichannel Therapeutic Area Lead
description:
**Position Overview**

  

**About the Role:**

  

The Omnichannel and Content Operations team is dedicated to driving innovation, building and delivering capabilities that enhance Otsuka’s opportunity to positively impact the lives of patients we serve. We achieve this through our relentless focus on customer centricity and patient empathy in engaging customers to communicate disease education, awareness of management options, and access to our innovative treatments.

  

The Omnichannel Business Partner is a part of the Omnichannel and Content Operations team responsible for leading and being a champion of the adoption & integration of omnichannel capabilities across assigned therapeutic areas. This position acts as an embedded strategic advisor to Brand, Medical, and Commercial leadership teams, helping shape customer engagement strategies, omnichannel transformation initiatives, and data-driven business decisions. This role plays a key role in connecting brand strategy, analytics, and orchestration capabilities by translating business objectives into scalable customer engagement solutions and converting engagement insights into actionable business recommendations.

  

**Job Expectations/Responsibilities:**

  

* **Strategic Business Leadership**

* + Serve as a strategic thought partner to Brand, Medical, and Commercial leadership, contributing to the development of customer engagement strategy and plans informed by deep customer insights and analytics
  + Translate business objectives into data-driven and scalable omnichannel customer engagement strategies.
  + Influence senior stakeholders by bringing an outside-in perspective on customer needs, market trends, and commercial opportunities.

* **Customer Strategy, Measurement & Optimization**

* + Lead the development of customer engagement strategies aligned to brand objectives, customer journeys, and key moments that matter.
  + Design and execute integrated customer experiences across personal and non-personal channels.
  + Apply expertise in pharmaceutical marketing, digital engagement, CRM, and customer experience design to enhance customer interactions across channels.
  + Define measurement frameworks to evaluate and continually optimize engagement performance, business impact, and customer behavior change.

* **Cross-Functional Leadership & Execution**

* + Lead cross-functional initiatives across Brand, Medical, Analytics, Technology, and Omnichannel teams to operationalize customer engagement strategies.
  + Identify risks, remove barriers, and drive organizational adoption of new capabilities, processes, and ways of working.
  + Lead initiatives from concept through implementation while ensuring stakeholder alignment and delivery.

* **Leadership & Ways of Working**

* + Foster strong partnerships and collaboration across internal and external stakeholders.
  + Demonstrate strong judgment, accountability, and comfort operating in ambiguity.
  + Model Otsuka's ASPIRE competencies while maintaining a continuous learning mindset.

  

**Qualifications**

  

**Required:**

* 5+ years of experience in pharmaceutical marketing, omnichannel strategy, digital marketing, commercial operations, consulting, or related fields.
* Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and lead cross-functional teams within complex matrix organizations.
* Experience with AI-enabled targeting, decision engines, customer orchestration, or advanced customer engagement approaches.
* Knowledge of pharmaceutical regulatory, legal, and medical review processes.
* Strong communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills.
  

  

**Preferred:**

* Pharmaceutical brand marketing experience preferred.
* Launch/pre-launch commercialization experience.
* Experience designing operating models, transformation initiatives, or enterprise customer engagement frameworks.
* Specialty or rare disease experience.
* MBA or equivalent business experience.

  

**Competencies**  
**Accountability for Results -** Stay focused on key strategic objectives, be accountable for high standards of performance, and take an active role in leading change.
  
**Strategic Thinking & Problem Solving -** Make decisions considering the long-term impact to customers, patients, employees, and the business.
  
**Patient & Customer Centricity -** Maintain an ongoing focus on the needs of our customers and/or key stakeholders.
  
**Impactful Communication -** Communicate with logic, clarity, and respect. Influence at all levels to achieve the best results for Otsuka.
  
**Respectful Collaboration -** Seek and value others’ perspectives and strive for diverse partnerships to enhance work toward common goals.

The Director, HCP Marketing is responsible for developing and executing the healthcare provider (HCP) engagement strategy for [Centanafadine (CTN), Agitation Associated with Dementia (AAD), or Major Depressive Disorder/Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder (MDD/PTSD)]. This role ensures effective brand positioning, promotional execution, and omnichannel engagement to drive awareness, adoption, and utilization among HCPs.

The Director will work cross-functionally with sales, market access, medical affairs, and commercial operations to align on strategic priorities and ensure that HCP marketing initiatives support both short-term brand objectives and long-term market success.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **HCP Marketing Strategy & Execution:** Develop and execute a comprehensive HCP engagement strategy, ensuring alignment with brand objectives and competitive positioning.
* **Omnichannel & Non-Personal Promotion (NPP):** Lead the HCP omnichannel strategy, integrating digital, non-personal promotion (NPP), and personal engagement to maximize reach and impact.
* **HCP Engagement & Field Enablement:** Develop promotional tools, messaging, and training resources to empower the field sales team and optimize HCP engagement.
* **KOL Engagement & Speaker Programs:** Partner with medical and sales teams to identify and engage key opinion leaders (KOLs), oversee speaker programs, and manage congress presence. Develop and execute a comprehensive commercial KOL engagement plan
* **Market Insights & Competitive Intelligence:** Utilize market research, HCP insights, and competitive analysis to refine strategies and ensure agility in response to market dynamics.
* **Brand Positioning & Messaging:** Ensure brand messaging is differentiated, evidence-based, and compelling for target HCP audiences.
* **Market Access Pull Through:** Create market access pull through strategies, including but not limited to reimbursement support, patient access programs, and/or formulary positioning, into brand promotional efforts
* **Cross-Functional Leadership:** Collaborate closely with medical, regulatory, and commercial operations teams to ensure compliance and seamless execution of promotional initiatives.
* **Performance Measurement & Optimization:** Establish and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to assess HCP marketing effectiveness and optimize promotional investments.
* **Budget & Resource Management:** Oversee marketing budgets, ensuring efficient allocation of resources and maximizing return on investment.

**Qualifications & Key Competencies**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field; MBA preferred
* 8+ years of pharmaceutical marketing experience, with a focus on HCP engagement, omnichannel marketing, or field sales enablement
* Experience in CNS, psychiatry, neurology, or related therapeutic areas preferred
* Proven ability to develop and execute HCP engagement strategies, including non-personal promotion (NPP), field support, and speaker programs
* Omnichannel marketing expertise, including digital and traditional HCP engagement tactics
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to leverage data and insights to refine marketing execution
* Demonstrated ability to plan and manage large investments and marketing budgets to optimize overall ROI

description:
United States - Remote

**Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients**

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

**Director, Copay & Affordability (US Remote)**

**Live**
--------

**What you will do**

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world! The Director, Copay & Affordability capabilities leads the team responsible for managing the design, implementation and ongoing operations of Amgen’s pharmacy benefit co-pay programs. This team also develops new solutions to address patient affordability needs. It is part of the Patient Access and Reimbursement team and reports to the Sr Director Patient Access Copay & Affordability

Key Responsibilities:

* Lead development and execution of Amgen patient affordability strategies in alignment with brand strategic imperatives and financial goals
* Manage the design, implementation and ongoing operations of all affordability programs (most notably co-pay but inclusive of coupons, evoucher, cash pay etc) finding opportunities for program enhancements and optimization, based on performance and operational metrics
* Conduct periodic copay and financial assistance market landscape and competitor benchmark assessments
* Proactive partnership with Brand team to ensure clarity on performance, progress and opportunities related to affordability programs given P/L impact of programs
* Partner with legal, compliance and safety on Patient Support Program review and approval

title: Director, Global Trade Compliance
description:
**Overview of Position**

  

Reporting to the AVP, Connected Living Compliance, this position is responsible for leading Assurant's global trade compliance program and ensuring compliance with all applicable import, export, sanctions, and customs regulations. In addition to enterprise related trade activities, this role actively supports the movement of mobile devices, device components, service parts, accessories, and related technologies across global markets while enabling efficient customer, carrier, OEM, repair, refurbishment, and logistics operations.

  
  

The Director serves as a strategic advisor to Connected Living leadership and business stakeholders, balancing compliance obligations with customer commitments, operational efficiency, and commercial objectives.

  
  

This role will also partner, coordinate, and align global trade compliance activities and strategies with the Director, Global Supply Chain Compliance.

  
  

**What will my duties and responsibilities be in this job?**

  

**Global Trade Compliance Leadership (45%)**

  

* Develop, implement, and continuously improve Assurant's global trade compliance program.
* Establish governance, policies, procedures, and internal controls covering import, export, sanctions, and customs compliance.
* Ensure compliance with:
  + U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR)
  + OFAC sanctions requirements
  + U.S. Customs regulations
  + International customs laws and regulations
  + Foreign trade regulations in countries where Assurant operates
* Provide strategic guidance to executive leadership on global trade risks and opportunities.
* Identify and implement value-creation opportunities, including duty drawback, free trade agreements, foreign trade zones, tariff engineering, and other lawful duty mitigation strategies.

**Import Compliance and Customs Management (20%)**

  

* Oversee global customs compliance for mobile devices, service parts, accessories, and technology.
* Ensure accurate:
  + HTS classifications
  + Country-of-origin determinations
  + Customs valuation
  + Duty assessment
* Manage customs brokers and trade service providers.
  + Identify and implement duty savings strategies and opportunities.
* Support optimization of global supply chain costs and customs efficiency.
  

  

**Export Controls and Sanctions Compliance (20%)**

  

* Oversee export classification activities for devices, components, software, and technology.
* Ensure compliance with export controls.
* Lead restricted-party screening and sanctions compliance programs.
* Provide guidance regarding cross-border shipments, technology transfers, and international business transactions.
* Manage export licensing requirements and government authorizations when required.
* Drive global alignment for HTS classification, country of origin, customs valuation, and Export Control Classification Number (ECCN) determinations.
* Maintain awareness of export-controlled technology, software, encryption, and restricted-access information requirements applicable to Assurant operations.
* Assess and manage export control risks involving restricted destinations, restricted parties, military end users, military end uses, and controlled technologies, software, or technical data; develop procedures for end-use/end-user due diligence, escalation, licensing analysis, and transaction holds where required.

**Risk Management and Compliance Governance (10%)**

  

* Conduct enterprise-wide trade compliance risk assessments.
* Develop and maintain trade compliance controls and monitoring programs.
* Lead internal audits and compliance reviews.
* Establish compliance metrics, dashboards, and executive reporting.
* Investigate compliance incidents and manage corrective actions.
* Lead government audits, inquiries, disclosures, and remediation activities.

* Assists in remediating trade compliance issues as necessary, including but not limited to putting together project plans, connecting resources to find solutions, documenting resolutions, and documenting remediation plans.
* Supports internal compliance audits and assists with managing external audits or inquiries from government agencies Maintains accurate data and recordkeeping to include collecting and retaining records in response to third-party inquiries relating to Assurant compliance practices and business activities.

**Training and Culture (5%)**

  

* Develop and deliver trade compliance training and awareness programs.
* Ensure employees understand their responsibilities related to international trade activities.
* Maintain training records and support audit readiness.
  

  

**Number of Direct Reports**

  

* 1-2 including a Compliance Analyst
  

  

**Financial Responsibility**

  

* Signoff on responsible expenses, input on annual budget.
  

  

**What are the requirements needed for this position?**

  

**Experience**

  

* Minimum of 8 years of progressive experience in global trade compliance.
* At least 5 years of leadership experience.
* Experience supporting multinational import/export operations.
* Experience managing customs and export compliance programs.
* Experience supporting technology, telecommunications, consumer electronics, mobile device, repair/refurbishment, or logistics industries preferred.

  

**Education & Certifications**

  

* Bachelors’ degree required, Master’s or JD preferred

**Preferred Certifications**

  

* Licensed Customs Broker (LCB)
* Certified Export Specialist (CES)
* Certified Customs Specialist (CCS)

* Certified U.S. Export Compliance Officer (CUSECO)
  

  

**Preferred Technical Expertise**

  

* EAR
* OFAC sanctions compliance
* Customs valuation
* HTS classification
* Country-of-origin analysis
* Free Trade Agreements
* Duty drawback
* Foreign Trade Zones (FTZ)
* Reverse logistics operations
* Mobile device repair and refurbishment supply chains
  

  

**Leadership Competencies**

The candidate will be able to provide examples of successfully demonstrating the following leadership competencies:

  
  

* Internal client-orientation with a constructive approach to resolution of issues. A style which builds alliances within the organization.
* Ability to establish credibility with business owners, including senior and executive leadership, and influence through professional communication, work product, etc.
* Solutions-oriented, demonstrated growth mindset.
* Proven ability to build and maintain effective cross-functional relationships with clients, colleagues and stakeholders of various levels and areas throughout the organization.
* Ability to lead change efforts through effective communication and persuasion.
* Creative, resilient, and flexible style and approach to handling complex issues with high tolerance for ambiguity
* Demonstrated leadership experience on leveraging data to drive actionable insights for risk or compliance programs
* Clear written, visual and verbal communication skills, including ability to adjust messages dependent on audiences ranging from front-line employees to executive
* Cultural competency and executive-level presence to work with the business and regional leadership teams around the world
* Strong analytical, organizational, problem-solving, and follow-up skills. Ability to interpret rules and guidelines, and then conceptualize and implement into policies, procedures, and controls.
* Excellent and demonstrated project management skills, and attention to detail in leading projects and activities in a global organization. Ability to prioritize and simultaneously execute on multiple projects and ability to organize and analyze complex information and data
* Sound and independent judgment, and demonstrated prudence and maturity
* Commitment to driving a culture of ethics and integrity

* Cultivate a high-performing trade compliance team through coaching, mentoring, accountability, and development of trade compliance professionals.
  

  

**Skills**

  

The candidate will be able to demonstrate proficiency in the following skills:

  
  

* Proficiency in the Microsoft Office Suite with specific emphasis in Word, Excel, PowerPoint
* The ability to work in a fast-paced environment with several simultaneous deliverables
* Program of project management skills
  

  

**What other skills/experience would be helpful to have?**

  

* Experience in mobile or technology industries

* Supply chain and vendor risk management experience

**Company Overview**
====================

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

**Company Operating Rhythm**
============================

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

**About the role**

Deepgram's Brand Marketing is growing into a collaborative Brand Studio with dedicated creative leadership, an evolving design system, and clear ways of working. We're looking for a Senior Designer who pairs strong craft with sound judgment: someone who can move work forward independently, knows when a project calls for a fresh set of eyes, and thrives in a studio where ideas are explored together. You'll report to our Design Director and work closely with partners across Marketing and the wider company, turning business needs into polished, on-brand design.

* Bring big creative ideas and high impact execution. Look to push Deepgram’s creative bar and highlight the power of voice.

* Contribute to design challenges and parallel creative explorations, and fully support whichever direction the team moves forward with.
* Drive projects from brief to delivery by keeping momentum, setting milestones, identifying next steps, and surfacing risks and blockers early.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to understand their goals and requirements, then translate that context into design work aligned with Brand Studio direction.
* Execute confidently within our design system, brand guidelines, and templates, from slide decks and data tables to campaign assets.
* Recognize when work is new, high-visibility, or precedent-setting, and bring it to creative leadership for alignment at the right moment.
* Collaborate with fellow designers, contractors, and other creative resources on shared projects.
* Stay current as our design system and brand standards evolve, and help put new standards into practice.
* Use preference testing and other available data to inform design decisions.
* Use AI tools to speed up exploration, iteration, and production, from generating early concepts and variations to automating repetitive tasks, while keeping the final work to our brand and craft standards.
* Help the team try out new AI-assisted creative workflows and share what works.

**What we're looking for**

* 7+ years of experience in brand, marketing, or communication design, ideally in-house at a fast-growing technical B2B/SaaS company or relevant agency experience.
* A portfolio showing polished, production-ready work with strong typography, hierarchy, spacing, color, and attention to detail across print and digital.
* Experience working within and extending design systems and brand guidelines.
* Sound judgment about when to work independently and when to seek alignment, and comfort escalating early with context and proposed solutions.
* Strong prioritization skills and the ability to flag competing demands and trade-offs before they become problems.
* Clear, proactive communication about status, decisions, and risks.
* A collaborative mindset: you enjoy creative exploration, take feedback well, and incorporate direction accurately.
* Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders while keeping design direction coherent.
* Proficiency in Figma (and Figma Weave), Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator and After Effects), Presentation design software (Google slides)
* Hands-on experience with AI tools in a design workflow (for example, image generation, AI features in Figma or Adobe, or AI-assisted copy and layout), and a good sense of where they help and where human craft matters most.
* Curiosity about how AI is changing creative work, and the ability to adapt processes as the tools evolve.

**How we work**

We work as a collaborative studio. Multiple designers may explore the same problem, and projects often have several contributors. We measure success by craft, judgment, reliability, and collaboration, not by whose concept gets picked. Regular check-ins with your manager keep priorities clear and support your growth.

This position is a Hybrid position at our Corporate Office which is 3 days onsite and 2 days remote.

USD $180,000.00 - USD $210,000.00 /Yr.
  
  
**About Us**
OUR FOUNDER, MOMOFUKU ANDO
  
  
There is only one company that can rightfully claim the Pinnacle of Noodledom. Only one company whose founder, faced with a Japanese food shortage after WWII, invented instant ramen and sparked a 3-minute global revolution. Only one whose spirit of innovation continues to provide simple, nourishing delight to billions of people. Only one that has been loved around the world for more than 60 years. There is only one Nissin Foods.
  
  
NISSIN IN THE U.S.
  
  
On a trip to the U.S. in 1966, Mr. Ando noticed Americans curiously eating forkfuls of noodles out of cups, instead of using bowls and chopsticks. With that simple observation, the worldwide Cup Noodles® phenomenon was born. Shortly after, Nissin officially put down its roots in the U.S. In 1972, our Gardena, CA, plant started production of Top Ramen®—the first instant ramen manufactured and sold in the U.S. And ever since, Nissin Foods USA has launched a continuous stream of new and innovative products for hungry, noodle-loving Americans.
  
  
WHY NISSIN?
  
  
Nissin Foods celebrates diversity and inclusion both in our brands and how we do business. Why? Innovation is best driven by diverse perspectives, which create unique results. Respect, steady professional growth, and quality work make our team stronger. We welcome quality folks to join Team Nissin and fulfill our mission to “make people happy by creating delicious, convenient and value-oriented Asian-inspired meal solutions.” If you celebrate innovation and love noodles, you belong here!

### **Position Summary**

Michigan State University is seeking an experienced editorial leader to serve as Associate Director of Content within University Advancement Marketing and Communications (UA MarComm).

Reporting to the Director of Content, the Associate Director leads the day-to-day editorial program that brings University Advancement's content strategy to life. This position manages the story pipeline, writes and develops priority content, directs editorial assignments and resources, serves as editor for Spartan magazine, alumni eNews and other primary Advancement publications, and oversees editing, copy editing, proofreading, and editorial quality across the content function.

The Associate Director supervises writers, copy editing, proofreading staff, and student writers, providing coaching, feedback, assignments, and professional development. Working closely with the Director of Content, Project Management, and other UA MarComm functions, the Associate Director translates content pillars and storytelling priorities into coordinated, high-quality content across Advancement.

This role serves as the operational editorial leader for the content team, writing and shaping high-priority stories while guiding the work of other writers and contributors. The Associate Director ensures stories move from ideas to polished execution with strong editorial judgment, consistent voice, high standards, and effective collaboration with campus partners.

**Responsibilities will include:**

**Editorial and Storytelling Management -**

* Translate University Advancement content strategy, content pillars, and storytelling priorities into an actionable editorial program and story pipeline.
* Lead day-to-day editorial planning, including developing story angles, assigning writers and editorial resources, coordinating contributors, and maintaining visibility into upcoming content needs.
* Research, interview, and write compelling content for priority Advancement stories, publications, and communications, particularly projects requiring strong editorial judgment or complex storytelling.
* Supervise, coach, and evaluate writers, copy editing, proofreading staff, and student writers, including assigning work, setting expectations, providing feedback, and supporting professional development.
* Guide stories from concept through final editorial approval, ensuring strong storytelling, audience relevance, accuracy, consistency, and alignment with Advancement priorities.
* Collaborate with writers and partners to develop story concepts, conduct interviews, and identify compelling narratives that demonstrate the impact of philanthropy and engagement.
* Identify gaps, emerging story opportunities, and resource needs and bring recommendations to the Director of Content.
* Coordinate with campus communicators, subject-matter experts, development colleagues, and other partners to gather information, shape stories, and support collaborative content development.
* Partner with Project Management on schedules, workflows, approvals, and production coordination while retaining editorial ownership of story assignments, content quality, and publication readiness.

  

**Flagship Publications and Editorial Programming -**

* Serve as editor of Spartan magazine, alumni eNews, and other primary University Advancement publications and editorial products.
* Lead editorial planning, story selection, sequencing, assignment, and review for flagship publications.
* Ensure publication content reflects Advancement priorities, audience needs, content pillars, and a balanced mix of storytelling topics and voices.
* Coordinate with Creative Strategies, Digital Marketing, Social Media, Video and Project Management to extend stories across channels and maximize their value and reach.
* Identify opportunities to repurpose, adapt, and connect content across publications and platforms rather than treating stories as one-time assets.

**Editing, Standards and Quality Assurance -**

* Provide final editorial oversight for Advancement content, including editing, copy editing, proofreading, fact checking, and quality control.
* Maintain and apply University Advancement editorial voice, AP style, MSU editorial standards, accessibility practices and inclusive communications guidance.
* Establish and continuously improve editorial review processes, style resources, templates, and quality-control practices.
* Coach writers and contributors on structure, voice, clarity, accuracy, and audience-centered storytelling.

**Staff Development and Editorial Collaboration -**

* Develop a high-performing editorial team through clear expectations, regular feedback, coaching, and professional development.
* Facilitate editorial conversations, story planning, and collaborative brainstorming that strengthen content quality and cross-team awareness.
* Support onboarding, documentation, and editorial resources that help staff and contributors work effectively and consistently.

**About the Role**

IllFonic is seeking an Art & Animation Director to oversee the artistic direction, visual quality, and multidisciplinary art and animation teams for an exciting new title. In this role, you will lead and unify visual vision across Environment Art, Tech Art, Outsourcing, VFX, Tech Animation, Animation, Lighting, Characters, UI/UX, and Concept Art departments. **About the Company**

Founded in 2007, IllFonic is an independent video game developer and publisher with studios in Lakewood, Colorado and Tacoma, Washington. Our staff is composed of video game, music, and technology veterans redefining how indie and middle-market games are made and marketed. Current and past titles / collaborations include Halloween: The Game, Killer Klowns from Outer Space: The Game, Ghostbusters: Spirits Unleashed, Arcadegeddon, Predator: Hunting Grounds, Friday the 13th: The Game, Dead Alliance, Star Citizen, Evolve, Armored Warfare, and Nexuiz.
